from pydantic import BaseSettings, Field, validator

class Environment(str, Enum):
    """环境枚举"""
    DEVELOPMENT = "development"
    TESTING = "testing"
    PRODUCTION = "production"

class LogLevel(str, Enum):
    """日志级别枚举"""
    DEBUG = "DEBUG"
    INFO = "INFO"
    WARNING = "WARNING"
    ERROR = "ERROR"
    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"

class APISettings(BaseSettings):
    """API配置"""
    
    # 基础配置
    PROJECT_NAME: str = "Coze智能视频生成平台"
    PROJECT_VERSION: str = "10.1.0"
    API_V1_PREFIX: str = "/api/v1"
    ENVIRONMENT: Environment = Environment.DEVELOPMENT
    
    # 服务器配置
    HOST: str = "0.0.0.0"
    PORT: int = 8000
    WORKERS: int = 4
    RELOAD: bool = True
    
    # 数据库配置
    DATABASE_URL: str = Field(
        default="postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/coze_videos",
        env="DATABASE_URL"
    DATABASE_POOL_SIZE: int = 20
    DATABASE_MAX_OVERFLOW: int = 40
    
    # Redis配置
    REDIS_URL: str = Field(
        default="redis://localhost:6379/0",
        env="REDIS_URL"
    
    # 安全配置
    SECRET_KEY: str = Field(
        default="your-secret-key-here-change-in-production",
        env="SECRET_KEY"
    API_KEY_HEADER: str = "X-API-Key"
    JWT_ALGORITHM: str = "HS256"
    ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 30
    
    # 外部API配置
    CAPCUT_API_KEY: Optional[str] = Field(None, env="CAPCUT_API_KEY")
    CAPCUT_API_URL: str = "https://api.capcut.cn/v1"
    TTS_API_KEY: Optional[str] = Field(None, env="TTS_API_KEY")
    TTS_API_URL: str = "https://api.tts-service.com/v1"
    
    # 存储配置
    STORAGE_TYPE: str = "local"  # local, s3, oss
    UPLOAD_DIR: str = "./uploads"
    MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE: int = 100 * 1024 * 1024  # 100MB
    
    # 视频配置
    DEFAULT_VIDEO_DURATION: int = 60
    SUPPORTED_RESOLUTIONS: List[str] = ["720p", "1080p", "4k"]
    SUPPORTED_FORMATS: List[str] = ["mp4", "mov", "avi"]
    
    # 算法配置
    DEFAULT_AI_MODEL: str = "gpt-4"
    MAX_CONTEXT_LENGTH: int = 4000
    TEMPERATURE: float = 0.7
    
    # 日志配置
    LOG_LEVEL: LogLevel = LogLevel.INFO
    LOG_FORMAT: str = "%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s"
    LOG_FILE: str = "./logs/app.log"
    
    # 监控配置
    ENABLE_METRICS: bool = True
    METRICS_PORT: int = 9090
    HEALTH_CHECK_PATH: str = "/health"
    
    # 任务队列配置
    CELERY_BROKER_URL: str = Field(
        default="redis://localhost:6379/1",
        env="CELERY_BROKER_URL"
    CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND: str = Field(
        default="redis://localhost:6379/2",
        env="CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND"
    
    # 性能配置
    CACHE_TTL: int = 300  # 5分钟
    RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS: int = 100
    RATE_LIMIT_PERIOD: int = 60  # 1分钟
    
    # CORS配置
    CORS_ORIGINS: List[str] = [
        "http://localhost:3000",
        "http://127.0.0.1:3000",
        "https://coze-video-platform.com"
    
    @validator("DATABASE_URL")
    def validate_database_url(cls, v):
        """验证数据库URL格式"""
        if not v.startswith(("postgresql://", "mysql://", "sqlite://")):
            raise ValueError("不支持的数据库类型")
        return v
    
    @validator("SECRET_KEY")
    def validate_secret_key(cls, v, values):
        """验证密钥安全性"""
        if values.get("ENVIRONMENT") == Environment.PRODUCTION:
            if len(v) < 32:
                raise ValueError("生产环境密钥长度必须至少32位")
    
    class Config:
        env_file = ".env"
        case_sensitive = True
        validate_assignment = True

# 创建全局配置实例
settings = APISettings()

def get_settings() -> APISettings:
    """获取配置实例"""
    return settings

class VideoPlatform(str, Enum):
    """视频平台枚举"""
    DOUYIN = "douyin"           # 抖音
    KUAISHOU = "kuaishou"      # 快手
    WECHAT = "wechat"          # 微信视频号
    GENERAL = "general"        # 通用平台
    
class VideoStyle(str, Enum):
    """视频风格枚举"""
    TECH = "tech"              # 科技感
    LIFESTYLE = "lifestyle"    # 生活方式
    PREMIUM = "premium"       # 高端品质
    FUNNY = "funny"           # 搞笑幽默
    EMOTIONAL = "emotional"   # 情感故事
    
class VoiceStyle(str, Enum):
    """配音风格枚举"""
    PROFESSIONAL = "professional"  # 专业
    FRIENDLY = "friendly"         # 亲切
    ENERGETIC = "energetic"       # 有活力
    CALM = "calm"                 # 沉稳
    
class MusicStyle(str, Enum):
    """音乐风格枚举"""

    CORPORATE = "corporate"     # 企业
    EMOTIONAL = "emotional"     # 情感
    TRENDING = "trending"       # 流行
    
class TaskStatus(str, Enum):

    UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT = "UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT"

Pydantic数据模型 - 修复所有参数验证错误
from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any, Union
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, validator, HttpUrl, UUID4

from .enums import (
    VideoPlatform, VideoStyle, VoiceStyle, 
    MusicStyle, TaskStatus, VideoStatus, ErrorCode

class ProductFeature(BaseModel):
    """商品特点"""
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=50, description="特点名称")
    value: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=200, description="特点值")
    icon: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="图标")
    
class ProductReview(BaseModel):
    """商品评价"""
    content: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=500, description="评价内容")
    rating: int = Field(..., ge=1, le=5, description="评分(1-5)")
    author: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=50, description="评价作者")
    date: Optional[datetime] = Field(None, description="评价日期")
    
class ProductData(BaseModel):
    """商品数据模型"""
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100, description="商品名称")
    price: float = Field(..., ge=0, le=1000000, description="商品价格")
    original_price: Optional[float] = Field(None, ge=0, le=1000000, description="原价")
    description: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=1000, description="商品描述")
    
    # 修复: 确保features是列表且每个元素是字符串
    features: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list, 
        max_items=10,
        description="商品特点列表"
    
    selling_points: List[str] = Field(
        max_items=5,
        description="核心卖点"
    
    target_audience: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=200, description="目标受众")
    
    # 修复: 确保reviews是正确格式的列表
    reviews: List[ProductReview] = Field(
        description="用户评价"
    
    images: List[str] = Field(
        description="商品图片URL列表"
    
    @validator('features', 'selling_points')
    def validate_string_list(cls, v):
        """验证字符串列表"""
        if not isinstance(v, list):
            raise ValueError("必须是列表")
        for item in v:
            if not isinstance(item, str):
                raise ValueError("列表元素必须是字符串")
    
    @validator('price', 'original_price')
    def validate_price(cls, v, values):
        """验证价格"""
        if v is not None:
            if 'original_price' in values and values.get('original_price'):
                if v > values['original_price']:
                    raise ValueError("当前价格不能高于原价")

class VideoCustomization(BaseModel):
    """视频自定义配置"""
    voice_style: VoiceStyle = Field(default=VoiceStyle.ENERGETIC, description="配音风格")
    music_style: MusicStyle = Field(default=MusicStyle.UPBEAT, description="音乐风格")
    color_scheme: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=50, description="色彩方案")
    brand_logo: Optional[HttpUrl] = Field(None, description="品牌Logo URL")
    cta_text: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=100, description="行动号召文案")
    
    # 修复: 确保额外的自定义参数格式正确
    extra_params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="额外自定义参数"

class PlatformOptimization(BaseModel):
    """平台优化配置"""
    platform: VideoPlatform = Field(default=VideoPlatform.DOUYIN, description="目标平台")
    hashtags: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: ["#好物推荐", "#抖音带货", "#必买清单"],
        description="话题标签"
    
    # 修复: 确保hook_strategy是有效值
    hook_strategy: str = Field(
        default="curiosity",
        description="开场钩子策略"
    
    @validator('hook_strategy')
    def validate_hook_strategy(cls, v):
        """验证钩子策略"""
        valid_strategies = ["curiosity", "problem_solution", "benefit", "shocking_fact"]
        if v not in valid_strategies:
            raise ValueError(f"钩子策略必须是以下之一: {valid_strategies}")

class VideoGenerationRequest(BaseModel):
    """视频生成请求模型"""
    template_id: UUID4 = Field(..., description="模板ID")
    product_data: ProductData = Field(..., description="商品数据")
    
    # 修复: 确保customization是可选的且有默认值
    customization: Optional[VideoCustomization] = Field(
        default_factory=VideoCustomization,
        description="自定义配置"
    
    # 修复: 确保platform_optimization是可选的且有默认值
    platform_optimization: Optional[PlatformOptimization] = Field(
        default_factory=PlatformOptimization,
        description="平台优化配置"
    
    # 修复: 确保callback_url格式正确
    callback_url: Optional[HttpUrl] = Field(None, description="回调URL")
    
    priority: int = Field(default=5, ge=1, le=10, description="优先级(1-10)")
    
        schema_extra = {
            "example": {
                "template_id": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000",

class VideoTemplate(BaseModel):
    """视频模板模型"""
    id: UUID4 = Field(..., description="模板ID")
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100, description="模板名称")
    description: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=500, description="模板描述")
    platform: VideoPlatform = Field(..., description="目标平台")
    style: VideoStyle = Field(..., description="视频风格")
    duration: int = Field(..., ge=5, le=300, description="视频时长(秒)")
    aspect_ratio: str = Field(..., description="视频比例")
    preview_url: Optional[HttpUrl] = Field(None, description="预览图URL")
    
    # 修复: 确保placeholders是正确格式的列表
    placeholders: List[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(
        description="占位符定义"
    
    created_at: datetime = Field(..., description="创建时间")
    updated_at: datetime = Field(..., description="更新时间")
    
    @validator('aspect_ratio')
    def validate_aspect_ratio(cls, v):
        """验证视频比例"""
        valid_ratios = ["9:16", "16:9", "1:1", "4:5"]
        if v not in valid_ratios:
            raise ValueError(f"视频比例必须是以下之一: {valid_ratios}")

class VideoTask(BaseModel):
    """视频任务模型"""
    task_id: UUID4 = Field(..., description="任务ID")
    status: TaskStatus = Field(..., description="任务状态")
    progress: int = Field(0, ge=0, le=100, description="进度百分比")
    
    # 修复: 确保video_id是可选的
    video_id: Optional[UUID4] = Field(None, description="生成的视频ID")
    
    estimated_completion: Optional[datetime] = Field(None, description="预计完成时间")
    current_step: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="当前处理步骤")
    
    # 修复: 确保error是正确格式的字典
    error: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(None, description="错误信息")

class VideoResult(BaseModel):

    video_url: HttpUrl = Field(..., description="视频文件URL")
    
    # 修复: 确保thumbnail_url是可选的
    thumbnail_url: Optional[HttpUrl] = Field(None, description="缩略图URL")
    
    duration: int = Field(..., ge=1, description="视频时长(秒)")
    file_size: int = Field(..., ge=1, description="文件大小(字节)")
    format: str = Field(..., description="视频格式")
    resolution: str = Field(..., description="分辨率")
    
    # 修复: 确保metadata是正确格式的字典
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = Field(
        description="视频元数据"
    

class PerformanceMetrics(BaseModel):
    """性能指标模型"""
    view_count: int = Field(0, ge=0, description="观看次数")
    engagement_rate: float = Field(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="互动率")
    completion_rate: float = Field(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="完播率")
    click_through_rate: float = Field(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="点击率")
    conversion_rate: float = Field(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="转化率")
    
    @validator('engagement_rate', 'completion_rate', 'click_through_rate', 'conversion_rate')
    def validate_rate(cls, v):
        """验证比率值"""
        if not 0.0 <= v <= 1.0:
            raise ValueError("比率必须在0.0到1.0之间")
        return round(v, 4)

class PerformanceAnalysis(BaseModel):
    """性能分析模型"""
    metrics: PerformanceMetrics = Field(..., description="性能指标")

    comparison: Dict[str, Any] = Field(
        description="对比数据"

            raise HTTPException(

        return SuccessResponse(
            success=True,

            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,

        # 使用产品图片或默认图片

    def _adjust_duration(self, shot_list: List[Dict], target_duration: int) -> List[Dict]:
        调整镜头时长
        
        修复: 确保总时长符合要求
        current_duration = sum(shot["duration"] for shot in shot_list)
        
        if current_duration == target_duration:
            return shot_list
        
        # 计算调整比例
        ratio = target_duration / current_duration
        
        # 调整每个镜头的时长
        adjusted_shots = []
        for shot in shot_list:
            adjusted_duration = max(2, int(shot["duration"] * ratio))  # 最少2秒
            adjusted_shot = shot.copy()
            adjusted_shot["duration"] = adjusted_duration
            adjusted_shots.append(adjusted_shot)
        
        # 再次检查总时长
        final_duration = sum(shot["duration"] for shot in adjusted_shots)
        
        if final_duration != target_duration:
            # 微调最后一个镜头
            duration_diff = target_duration - final_duration
            if adjusted_shots:
                adjusted_shots[-1]["duration"] += duration_diff
        
        return adjusted_shots
    
    def _validate_visual_plan(self, visual_plan: Dict):
        验证视觉规划
        
        修复: 确保规划符合所有要求
        
        # 检查总时长
        total_duration = visual_plan.get("total_duration", 0)
        shot_duration = sum(shot.get("duration", 0) for shot in visual_plan.get("shot_list", []))
        
        if total_duration != shot_duration:
            errors.append(f"总时长不匹配: 规划{total_duration}秒, 镜头总计{shot_duration}秒")
        
        # 检查平台规范
        platform = visual_plan.get("platform", "douyin")
        
        if total_duration > platform_specs["max_duration"]:
            errors.append(f"时长超过平台限制: {total_duration} > {platform_specs['max_duration']}")
        
        # 检查镜头类型
        shot_types = [shot.get("type") for shot in visual_plan.get("shot_list", [])]
        
        if platform_specs["hook_required"] and "hook" not in shot_types:
            errors.append("该平台要求必须有开场钩子镜头")
        
        # 检查文字区域
        text_shots = [shot for shot in visual_plan.get("shot_list", []) 
                     if shot.get("text_overlays")]
        
        if len(text_shots) / len(visual_plan.get("shot_list", [])) > platform_specs["text_ratio"]:
            errors.append(f"文字镜头占比超过平台限制: {platform_specs['text_ratio']}")
        
        if errors:
            raise ValueError(f"视觉规划验证失败: {', '.join(errors)}")

URL管理器 - 解决Inconsistent API URL prefix问题
from urllib.parse import urlparse, urljoin



    URL管理器 - 统一管理API URL前缀和路径
    
    def __init__(self, base_url: Optional[str] = None):
        self.base_url = base_url or settings.API_V1_PREFIX
        self._validate_base_url()
        
        # 支持的API端点
        self.endpoints = {
            "videos": "/videos",
            "templates": "/templates",
            "tasks": "/tasks",
            "analytics": "/analytics"
    
    def _validate_base_url(self):
        验证基础URL
        
        修复: 确保URL格式正确
        if not self.base_url:
            raise ValueError("基础URL不能为空")
        
        # 确保以/结尾
        if not self.base_url.endswith('/'):
            self.base_url = self.base_url + '/'
        
        # 验证URL格式
            result = urlparse(self.base_url)
            if not all([result.scheme, result.netloc]):
                # 如果是相对路径，添加默认协议和主机
                if not self.base_url.startswith('http'):
                    self.base_url = f"https://api.coze.com{self.base_url}"
            raise ValueError(f"无效的URL格式: {self.base_url}")
    
    def get_url(self, endpoint: str, endpoint_type: str = "videos") -> str:
        获取完整的API URL
        
        修复: 确保URL一致性
        # 获取端点路径
        endpoint_path = self.endpoints.get(endpoint_type)
        if not endpoint_path:
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的端点类型: {endpoint_type}")
        
        # 清理端点路径
        endpoint = endpoint.strip('/')
        
        # 构建完整URL
        full_url = urljoin(self.base_url, f"{endpoint_path}/{endpoint}")
        
        # 验证URL
        self._validate_url(full_url)
        
        return full_url
    
    def get_video_url(self, video_id: str) -> str:
        """获取视频URL"""
        return self.get_url(f"videos/{video_id}")
    
    def get_task_url(self, task_id: str) -> str:
        """获取任务URL"""
        return self.get_url(f"tasks/{task_id}", "tasks")
    
    def get_template_url(self, template_id: str) -> str:
        """获取模板URL"""
        return self.get_url(f"templates/{template_id}", "templates")
    
    def get_analytics_url(self, video_id: str) -> str:
        """获取分析URL"""
        return self.get_url(f"performance/{video_id}", "analytics")
    
    def _validate_url(self, url: str):
        验证URL
        
        修复: 确保URL符合规范
            result = urlparse(url)
            
            # 检查协议
            if result.scheme not in ['http', 'https']:
                raise ValueError(f"不支持的协议: {result.scheme}")
            
            # 检查主机名
            if not result.netloc:
                raise ValueError("URL缺少主机名")
            
            # 检查路径格式
            if '//' in result.path:
                raise ValueError("URL路径包含重复的斜杠")
            
            raise ValueError(f"无效的URL: {url}, 错误: {str(e)}")
    
    def normalize_url(self, url: str) -> str:
        规范化URL
        
        修复: 确保URL格式统一
            
            # 确保路径以/开头
            path = result.path
            if not path.startswith('/'):
                path = '/' + path
            
            # 清理路径中的重复斜杠
            path = re.sub(r'/{2,}', '/', path)
            
            # 重建URL
            normalized = result._replace(path=path).geturl()
            
            return normalized
            
            # 如果解析失败，尝试修复
            return self._attempt_url_repair(url)
    
    def _attempt_url_repair(self, url: str) -> str:
        尝试修复URL
        
        修复: 自动修复常见的URL问题
        # 修复缺少协议的问题
        if not url.startswith(('http://', 'https://')):
            url = 'https://' + url
        
        # 修复重复斜杠
        url = re.sub(r'(?<!:)/{2,}', '/', url)
        
        # 修复缺少路径的问题
        if '://' in url and '/' not in url.split('://')[1]:
            url = url + '/'
        
        return url
    
    def validate_url_consistency(self, urls: List[str]) -> List[str]:
        验证URL一致性
        
        修复: 检测并报告不一致的URL
        
            normalized = self.normalize_url(url)
            
            # 检查是否使用相同的基础URL
            if not normalized.startswith(self.base_url):
                inconsistent_urls.append({
                    "original": url,
                    "normalized": normalized,
                    "expected_base": self.base_url
        
    
    def extract_endpoint(self, url: str) -> Optional[str]:
        从URL提取端点
        
        修复: 正确解析端点路径
            # 规范化URL
            
            # 移除基础URL部分
            if normalized.startswith(self.base_url):
                endpoint = normalized[len(self.base_url):]
                return endpoint.strip('/')
            
            
    
    def is_valid_endpoint(self, url: str) -> bool:
        检查是否是有效的端点
        
        修复: 验证端点路径
        endpoint = self.extract_endpoint(url)
        if not endpoint:
        
        # 检查端点格式
        # 端点应该类似于: videos/123 或 tasks/456
        parts = endpoint.split('/')
        
        if len(parts) < 2:
        
        # 检查端点类型
        endpoint_type = parts[0]
        if endpoint_type not in self.endpoints:
        
        # 检查资源ID格式
        resource_id = parts[1]
        if not self._is_valid_resource_id(resource_id):
        
    
    def _is_valid_resource_id(self, resource_id: str) -> bool:
        检查资源ID格式
        
        修复: 验证UUID等资源ID格式
        # UUID格式检查
        uuid_pattern = r'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
        if re.match(uuid_pattern, resource_id, re.IGNORECASE):
        
        # 数字ID检查
        if resource_id.isdigit():
        
        # 字母数字ID检查
        if resource_id.isalnum():
        
    
    def create_api_documentation_urls(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        创建API文档URL
        
        修复: 生成一致的文档URL
        docs = {}
        
        for endpoint_type, path in self.endpoints.items():
            # API端点URL
            api_url = urljoin(self.base_url, path)
            docs[f"{endpoint_type}_api"] = api_url
            
            # 文档URL
            docs_url = api_url.replace('/api/', '/docs/')
            docs[f"{endpoint_type}_docs"] = docs_url
            
            # OpenAPI规范URL
            openapi_url = api_url + '/openapi.json'
            docs[f"{endpoint_type}_openapi"] = openapi_url
        
        return docs
src/utils/validators.py
数据验证器 - 解决Invalid params错误
from fastapi import UploadFile, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import ValidationError

from src.models.schemas import APIError, ErrorCode


def validate_product_data(data: Dict) -> Dict:
    验证商品数据
    
    修复: 全面验证商品数据格式
    
    # 1. 检查必需字段
    required_fields = ["name", "price"]
            errors.append(f"缺少必需字段: {field}")
    
    # 2. 验证名称
    if "name" in data:
        name = data["name"]
        if not isinstance(name, str):
            errors.append("商品名称必须是字符串")
        elif len(name.strip()) < 1:
            errors.append("商品名称不能为空")
        elif len(name) > 100:
            errors.append("商品名称不能超过100个字符")
    
    # 3. 验证价格
    if "price" in data:
        price = data["price"]
        if not isinstance(price, (int, float)):
            errors.append("商品价格必须是数字")
        elif price < 0:
            errors.append("商品价格不能为负数")
        elif price > 1000000:  # 100万限制
            errors.append("商品价格不能超过100万")
    
    # 4. 验证原价
    if "original_price" in data and data["original_price"] is not None:
        original_price = data["original_price"]
        if not isinstance(original_price, (int, float)):
            errors.append("商品原价必须是数字")
        elif original_price < 0:
            errors.append("商品原价不能为负数")
        elif "price" in data and original_price < data["price"]:
            errors.append("商品原价不能低于当前价格")
    
    # 5. 验证特点列表
    if "features" in data:
        features = data["features"]
        if not isinstance(features, list):
            errors.append("商品特点必须是列表")
            if len(features) > 10:
                errors.append("商品特点不能超过10个")
            for i, feature in enumerate(features):
                if not isinstance(feature, str):
                    errors.append(f"第{i+1}个特点必须是字符串")
                elif len(feature.strip()) == 0:
                    errors.append(f"第{i+1}个特点不能为空")
                elif len(feature) > 200:
                    errors.append(f"第{i+1}个特点不能超过200个字符")
    
    # 6. 验证卖点列表
    if "selling_points" in data:
        selling_points = data["selling_points"]
        if not isinstance(selling_points, list):
            errors.append("核心卖点必须是列表")
            if len(selling_points) > 5:
                errors.append("核心卖点不能超过5个")
            for i, point in enumerate(selling_points):
                if not isinstance(point, str):
                    errors.append(f"第{i+1}个卖点必须是字符串")
                elif len(point.strip()) == 0:
                    errors.append(f"第{i+1}个卖点不能为空")
    
    # 7. 验证描述
    if "description" in data and data["description"] is not None:
        description = data["description"]
        if not isinstance(description, str):
            errors.append("商品描述必须是字符串")
        elif len(description) > 1000:
            errors.append("商品描述不能超过1000个字符")
    
    # 8. 验证目标受众
    if "target_audience" in data and data["target_audience"] is not None:
        audience = data["target_audience"]
        if not isinstance(audience, str):
            errors.append("目标受众必须是字符串")
        elif len(audience) > 200:
            errors.append("目标受众描述不能超过200个字符")
    
    # 9. 验证评价列表
    if "reviews" in data:
        reviews = data["reviews"]
        if not isinstance(reviews, list):
            errors.append("用户评价必须是列表")
            for i, review in enumerate(reviews):
                if not isinstance(review, dict):
                    errors.append(f"第{i+1}个评价必须是对象")
                
                # 验证评价内容
                if "content" not in review:
                    errors.append(f"第{i+1}个评价缺少内容")
                    content = review["content"]
                    if not isinstance(content, str):
                        errors.append(f"第{i+1}个评价内容必须是字符串")
                    elif len(content.strip()) == 0:
                        errors.append(f"第{i+1}个评价内容不能为空")
                    elif len(content) > 500:
                        errors.append(f"第{i+1}个评价内容不能超过500个字符")
                
                # 验证评分
                if "rating" not in review:
                    errors.append(f"第{i+1}个评价缺少评分")
                    rating = review["rating"]
                    if not isinstance(rating, int):
                        errors.append(f"第{i+1}个评价评分必须是整数")
                    elif rating < 1 or rating > 5:
                        errors.append(f"第{i+1}个评价评分必须在1-5之间")
    
    # 10. 验证图片URL列表
    if "images" in data:
        images = data["images"]
        if not isinstance(images, list):
            errors.append("商品图片必须是列表")
            for i, image_url in enumerate(images):
                if not isinstance(image_url, str):
                    errors.append(f"第{i+1}个图片URL必须是字符串")
                elif not _is_valid_url(image_url):
                    errors.append(f"第{i+1}个图片URL格式无效")
    
        raise ValidationError(
            errors=[{"loc": ("body",), "msg": error, "type": "value_error"} 
                   for error in errors],
            model="ProductData"
    
    # 清理数据
    cleaned_data = _clean_product_data(data)
    
    return cleaned_data

def validate_video_params(params: Dict) -> Dict:
    验证视频参数
    
    修复: 全面验证视频生成参数
    
    # 1. 验证模板ID
    if "template_id" not in params:
        errors.append("缺少模板ID")
        template_id = params["template_id"]
        if not isinstance(template_id, str):
            errors.append("模板ID必须是字符串")
        elif not _is_valid_uuid(template_id):
            errors.append("模板ID格式无效")
    
    # 2. 验证优先级
    if "priority" in params:
        priority = params["priority"]
        if not isinstance(priority, int):
            errors.append("优先级必须是整数")
        elif priority < 1 or priority > 10:
            errors.append("优先级必须在1-10之间")
    
    # 3. 验证回调URL
    if "callback_url" in params and params["callback_url"] is not None:
        callback_url = params["callback_url"]
        if not isinstance(callback_url, str):
            errors.append("回调URL必须是字符串")
        elif not _is_valid_url(callback_url):
            errors.append("回调URL格式无效")
    
    # 4. 验证自定义配置
    if "customization" in params and params["customization"] is not None:
        customization = params["customization"]
        if not isinstance(customization, dict):
            errors.append("自定义配置必须是对象")
            # 验证配音风格
            if "voice_style" in customization:
                valid_voices = ["professional", "friendly", "energetic", "calm"]
                if customization["voice_style"] not in valid_voices:
                    errors.append(f"配音风格必须是以下之一: {valid_voices}")
            
            # 验证音乐风格
            if "music_style" in customization:
                valid_music = ["upbeat", "corporate", "emotional", "trending"]
                if customization["music_style"] not in valid_music:
                    errors.append(f"音乐风格必须是以下之一: {valid_music}")
    
    # 5. 验证平台优化配置
    if "platform_optimization" in params and params["platform_optimization"] is not None:
        platform_opt = params["platform_optimization"]
        if not isinstance(platform_opt, dict):
            errors.append("平台优化配置必须是对象")
            # 验证平台
            if "platform" in platform_opt:
                valid_platforms = ["douyin", "kuaishou", "wechat", "general"]
                if platform_opt["platform"] not in valid_platforms:
                    errors.append(f"平台必须是以下之一: {valid_platforms}")
            
            # 验证话题标签
            if "hashtags" in platform_opt:
                hashtags = platform_opt["hashtags"]
                if not isinstance(hashtags, list):
                    errors.append("话题标签必须是列表")
                    if len(hashtags) > 10:
                        errors.append("话题标签不能超过10个")
                    for i, hashtag in enumerate(hashtags):
                        if not isinstance(hashtag, str):
                            errors.append(f"第{i+1}个话题标签必须是字符串")
                        elif not hashtag.startswith('#'):
                            errors.append(f"第{i+1}个话题标签必须以#开头")
    
            model="VideoGenerationRequest"
    
    return params

def validate_file_upload(file: UploadFile, max_size: int) -> bool:
    验证文件上传
    
    修复: 确保文件符合要求
    
    # 1. 检查文件名
    if not file.filename:
        errors.append("文件没有名称")
    
    # 2. 检查文件大小
    file.file.seek(0, 2)  # 移动到文件末尾
    file_size = file.file.tell()
    file.file.seek(0)  # 移回文件开头
    
    if file_size > max_size:
        errors.append(f"文件大小超过限制: {file_size} > {max_size}")
    
    # 3. 检查文件类型
    filename = file.filename.lower()
    
    # 支持的数据文件格式
    data_formats = ['.csv', '.xlsx', '.xls', '.json']
    # 支持的图片格式
    image_formats = ['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.gif', '.bmp']
    # 支持的视频格式
    video_formats = ['.mp4', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv', '.webm']
    
    supported_formats = data_formats + image_formats + video_formats
    
    if not any(filename.endswith(fmt) for fmt in supported_formats):
        errors.append(f"不支持的文件格式。支持的格式: {', '.join(supported_formats)}")
    
                code=ErrorCode.INVALID_PARAMETER,
                message="文件验证失败",
                details={"errors": errors}

def _is_valid_uuid(uuid_str: str) -> bool:

def _clean_product_data(data: Dict) -> Dict:
    清理商品数据
    
    修复: 确保数据格式一致
    cleaned = data.copy()
    
    # 确保列表字段存在
    for list_field in ["features", "selling_points", "reviews", "images"]:
        if list_field not in cleaned:
            cleaned[list_field] = []
        elif not isinstance(cleaned[list_field], list):
    
    # 清理字符串字段
    for str_field in ["name", "description", "target_audience"]:
        if str_field in cleaned and cleaned[str_field] is not None:
            cleaned[str_field] = cleaned[str_field].strip()
    
    # 清理特点列表
    if "features" in cleaned:
        cleaned["features"] = [
            feature.strip() for feature in cleaned["features"] 
            if isinstance(feature, str) and feature.strip()
    
    # 清理卖点列表
    if "selling_points" in cleaned:
        cleaned["selling_points"] = [
            point.strip() for point in cleaned["selling_points"] 
            if isinstance(point, str) and point.strip()
    
    # 清理评价列表
    if "reviews" in cleaned:
        valid_reviews = []
        for review in cleaned["reviews"]:
            if isinstance(review, dict):
                valid_review = {}
                
                # 清理评价内容
                if "content" in review and isinstance(review["content"], str):
                    valid_review["content"] = review["content"].strip()
                
                # 清理评分
                if "rating" in review and isinstance(review["rating"], int):
                    valid_review["rating"] = max(1, min(5, review["rating"]))
                
                if valid_review:  # 只有同时有内容和评分的评价才保留
                    valid_reviews.append(valid_review)
        
        cleaned["reviews"] = valid_reviews
    
    # 清理图片URL
    if "images" in cleaned:
        cleaned["images"] = [
            url for url in cleaned["images"] 
            if isinstance(url, str) and _is_valid_url(url)
    
    return cleaned

def sanitize_string_input(input_str: str, max_length: int = 1000) -> str:
    清理字符串输入
    
    修复: 防止注入攻击
    if not isinstance(input_str, str):
    
    # 移除首尾空格
    cleaned = input_str.strip()
    
    # 限制长度
    if len(cleaned) > max_length:
        cleaned = cleaned[:max_length]
    
    # 移除危险字符（根据需要进行调整）
    dangerous_patterns = [
        r'<script.*?>.*?</script>',  # 脚本标签
        r'javascript:',  # JavaScript协议
        r'on\w+=".*?"',  # 事件处理器
        r'on\w+=\'.*?\'',
        r'on\w+=.*?',
    
    for pattern in dangerous_patterns:
        cleaned = re.sub(pattern, '', cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    
    # 转义HTML特殊字符
    html_escape_table = {
        "&": "&amp;",
        '"': "&quot;",
        "'": "&#39;",
        ">": "&gt;",
        "<": "&lt;",
    
    for char, escape in html_escape_table.items():
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(char, escape)
    

def validate_json_schema(data: Any, schema: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:
    根据JSON Schema验证数据
    
    修复: 提供详细的验证错误信息
    
        import jsonschema
        jsonschema.validate(instance=data, schema=schema)
        return True, []
    except jsonschema.ValidationError as e:
        errors.append(f"JSON Schema验证失败: {e.message}")
        return False, errors
        errors.append(f"验证过程出错: {str(e)}")

async def add_process_time_header(request: Request, call_next):
    添加请求处理时间头
    
    修复: 监控API性能
    start_time = time.time()
    response = await call_next(request)
    process_time = time.time() - start_time
    response.headers["X-Process-Time"] = str(process_time)
    return response

#!/bin/bash

# Coze视频生成平台部署脚本
# 符合Trae-AI-IDE和Trae-CN软件规范

set -e  # 遇到错误退出

# 颜色定义
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# 日志函数
log_info() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"

log_success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1"

log_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1"

log_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"

# 检查命令是否存在
check_command() {
    if ! command -v $1 &> /dev/null; then
        log_error "命令 $1 未安装"
        exit 1
    fi

# 显示帮助
show_help() {
    echo "Coze视频生成平台部署脚本"
    echo ""
    echo "用法: $0 [选项]"
    echo "选项:"
    echo "  -h, --help          显示帮助信息"
    echo "  -e, --environment   部署环境 (development|staging|production)"
    echo "  -v, --version       部署版本号"
    echo "  -f, --force         强制部署（忽略警告）"
    echo "  -r, --rollback      回滚到上一个版本"
    echo "  -t, --test          运行部署测试"
    echo "示例:"
    echo "  $0 -e production -v 1.0.0"
    echo "  $0 -e staging --test"

# 解析参数
ENVIRONMENT="development"
VERSION=""
FORCE=false
ROLLBACK=false
TEST=false

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        -h|--help)
            show_help
            exit 0
            ;;
        -e|--environment)
            ENVIRONMENT="$2"
            shift 2
        -v|--version)
            VERSION="$2"
        -f|--force)
            FORCE=true
            shift
        -r|--rollback)
            ROLLBACK=true
        -t|--test)
            TEST=true
        *)
            log_error "未知参数: $1"
    esac
done

# 验证参数
validate_parameters() {
    if [[ ! "$ENVIRONMENT" =~ ^(development|staging|production)$ ]]; then
        log_error "无效的环境: $ENVIRONMENT"
    
    if [[ -z "$VERSION" && "$ROLLBACK" == false ]]; then
        log_error "未指定版本号"

# 检查系统要求
check_system_requirements() {
    log_info "检查系统要求..."
    
    # 检查Docker
    check_command docker
    check_command docker-compose
    
    # 检查Python
    check_command python3
    
    # 检查Git
    check_command git
    
    # 检查磁盘空间
    DISK_SPACE=$(df -h / | tail -1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//')
    if [[ $DISK_SPACE -gt 90 ]]; then
        log_warning "磁盘空间不足: ${DISK_SPACE}% 已使用"
        if [[ "$FORCE" == false ]]; then
            log_error "请清理磁盘空间或使用 -f 强制部署"

Hugging Face模型训练完整代码实现
已思考（用时 27 秒）
由于用户提供的代码和需求非常庞大且复杂，我无法一次性处理所有内容。但是，我可以根据用户的要求，逐步修复和整合代码。
用户要求修复的错误包括：Inconsistent API URL prefix 和 Invalid params 错误，以及通过 JSON 或 YAML 文件导入插件时出现的 invalid parameter 问题。
同时，用户希望得到一个完整的、修复了所有历史错误的代码，包括模型定义、分词器实现、训练脚本等。

由于代码量巨大，我将先修复OpenAPI规范中的问题，然后修复模型代码中的问题，最后提供一个完整的训练流程。


修复OpenAPI规范中的不一致的API URL前缀和参数验证错误。

修复模型代码中的错误，包括配置、模型实现、分词器等。

# configuration_bunny_phi.py
from transformers import PretrainedConfig

class BunnyPhiConfig(PretrainedConfig):
    """BunnyPhi模型配置类（显式定义所有Transformer所需属性）"""
    model_type = "bunny-phi"
    def __init__(
        vocab_size=50000,
        hidden_size=1024,
        num_hidden_layers=24,
        num_attention_heads=16,
        intermediate_size=4096,
        hidden_act="gelu",
        hidden_dropout_prob=0.1,        # 关键：添加缺失的dropout属性
        attention_probs_dropout_prob=0.1,  # 关键：添加注意力dropout属性
        pad_token_id=0,
        eos_token_id=1,
        **kwargs
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.vocab_size = vocab_size
        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
        self.num_hidden_layers = num_hidden_layers
        self.num_attention_heads = num_attention_heads
        self.intermediate_size = intermediate_size
        self.hidden_act = hidden_act
        self.hidden_dropout_prob = hidden_dropout_prob
        self.attention_probs_dropout_prob = attention_probs_dropout_prob
        self.pad_token_id = pad_token_id
        self.eos_token_id = eos_token_id
2. 模型实现文件
# modeling_bunny_phi.py
from transformers import PreTrainedModel, AutoConfig, AutoModelForCausalLM
from configuration_bunny_phi import BunnyPhiConfig  # 导入完整配置类

# ------------------------------ 自定义Transformer编码器层 ------------------------------
class PhiTransformerEncoderLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config: BunnyPhiConfig):
        self.self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=config.hidden_size,
            num_heads=config.num_attention_heads,
            dropout=config.attention_probs_dropout_prob,  # 直接使用配置属性
            batch_first=True
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(config.hidden_size)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(config.hidden_size)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, config.intermediate_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(config.intermediate_size, config.hidden_size),
            nn.Dropout(config.hidden_dropout_prob)  # 直接使用配置属性

    def forward(self, hidden_states, attention_mask=None):
        residual = hidden_states
        hidden_states = self.norm1(hidden_states)
        attn_output, _ = self.self_attn(
            hidden_states, hidden_states, hidden_states,
            key_padding_mask=attention_mask
        hidden_states = residual + attn_output
        
        hidden_states = self.norm2(hidden_states)
        hidden_states = self.ffn(hidden_states)
        hidden_states = residual + hidden_states
        return hidden_states

# ------------------------------ 核心模型类（遵循Hugging Face规范） ------------------------------
class BunnyPhiModel(PreTrainedModel):
    config_class = BunnyPhiConfig
    base_model_prefix = "bunny_phi"

        super().__init__(config)
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(
            config.vocab_size, config.hidden_size, config.pad_token_id
        self.encoder = nn.ModuleList([
            PhiTransformerEncoderLayer(config) for _ in range(config.num_hidden_layers)
        self.pooler = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, config.hidden_size)  # 新增池化层

        self.post_init()

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask=None):
        if attention_mask is None:
            attention_mask = torch.ones_like(input_ids, dtype=torch.bool)
        hidden_states = self.embedding(input_ids)
        for layer in self.encoder:
            hidden_states = layer(hidden_states, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled_output = self.pooler(hidden_states.mean(dim=1))  # 平均池化后接线性层
        return {"last_hidden_state": hidden_states, "pooled_output": pooled_output}

# ------------------------------ 模型注册（支持AutoModel自动加载） ------------------------------
AutoConfig.register("bunny-phi", BunnyPhiConfig)
AutoModelForCausalLM.register(BunnyPhiConfig, BunnyPhiModel)

# tokenization_bunny_phi.py
from transformers import PreTrainedTokenizer
from configuration_bunny_phi import BunnyPhiConfig

class BunnyPhiTokenizer(PreTrainedTokenizer):
    vocab_files_names = {"vocab_file": "tokenizer.json"}
    model_input_names = ["input_ids", "attention_mask"]

        vocab_file,
        config: BunnyPhiConfig,  # 显式接收配置参数
        **kwargs
        
        with open(vocab_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            self.vocab = json.load(f)
        self.token_to_id = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(self.vocab)}
        self.id_to_token = {i: t for i, t in enumerate(self.vocab)}

    def from_pretrained(cls, pretrained_model_name_or_path, **kwargs):
        config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(pretrained_model_name_or_path)
        vocab_file = f"{pretrained_model_name_or_path}/tokenizer.json"
        return cls(vocab_file=vocab_file, config=config, **kwargs)

    def tokenize(self, text):
        return text.split()  # 替换为实际分词逻辑（如空格分词）

    def convert_tokens_to_ids(self, tokens):
        return [self.token_to_id.get(t, self.unk_token_id) for t in tokens]

    @property
    def unk_token_id(self):
        return self.token_to_id.get("<unk>", 0)

# 2. 智能数据投喂器（保持不变）
class DataFeeder:
    def __init__(self, data_root="data", val_ratio=0.2):
        self.data_root = data_root
        self.val_ratio = val_ratio
        self.train_ds, self.val_ds = self._load_datasets()
    
    def _load_datasets(self):
        """智能加载数据集：优先使用已划分的train/val，否则从raw自动划分"""
        train_path = os.path.join(self.data_root, "train")
        val_path = os.path.join(self.data_root, "val")
        
        # 使用预划分数据集
        if os.path.exists(train_path) and os.path.exists(val_path):
                self._load_folder(train_path),
                self._load_folder(val_path)
        
        # 从原始数据自动划分
        raw_path = os.path.join(self.data_root, "raw")
        if not os.path.exists(raw_path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"原始数据目录缺失: {raw_path}")
        
        raw_data = self._load_folder(raw_path)
        if not raw_data:
            raise ValueError("原始数据为空，请在raw目录下创建类别子文件夹并添加文本文件")
        
        # 处理极端数据分布（修复分层抽样错误）
            return self._stratified_split(raw_data)
            print("警告：数据分布不均，已禁用分层抽样")
            return self._non_stratified_split(raw_data)
    
    def _load_folder(self, folder):
        """加载类别文件夹数据到Dataset"""
        data = []
        for label, class_name in enumerate(sorted(os.listdir(folder))):
            class_path = os.path.join(folder, class_name)
            if not os.path.isdir(class_path):
            for file in os.listdir(class_path):
                file_path = os.path.join(class_path, file)
                if not file.endswith((".txt", ".md")):  # 支持常见文本格式
                        text = f.read().strip()
                    data.append({"text": text, "label": label})
                    print(f"加载文件 {file_path} 失败: {str(e)}")
        return Dataset.from_list(data) if data else Dataset.from_list([])
    
    def _stratified_split(self, data):
        """带分层的数据集划分（优先保持类别分布）"""
        labels = [d["label"] for d in data]
        train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
            range(len(data)),
            test_size=self.val_ratio,
            stratify=labels,
            random_state=42
            Dataset.from_list([data[i] for i in train_idx]),
            Dataset.from_list([data[i] for i in val_idx])
    
    def _non_stratified_split(self, data):
        """非分层划分（处理小数据集场景）"""

# 3. 序列分类模型适配器（使用AutoModel加载自定义模型）
class SequenceClassificationAdapter(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name_or_path):
        self.config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name_or_path, trust_remote_code=True)
        # 关键：使用AutoModel自动加载注册的自定义模型
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            model_name_or_path,
            config=self.config
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(self.config.hidden_size, self.config.num_labels)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask=None, labels=None):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled_output = outputs.pooled_output  # 使用模型自带的池化输出
        logits = self.classifier(pooled_output)
        if labels is not None:
            return nn.CrossEntropyLoss()(logits, labels)
        return logits

BunnyPhi模型实现 - 完整支持序列分类和因果语言建模
import math
from typing import Optional, Tuple, Dict, Any

import torch.nn.functional as F
    PreTrainedModel,
    AutoModelForSequenceClassification
from transformers.modeling_outputs import (
    BaseModelOutputWithPast,
    CausalLMOutputWithPast,
    SequenceClassifierOutput
from transformers.utils import logging

from .configuration_bunny_phi import BunnyPhiConfig

logger = logging.get_logger(__name__)


class RotaryEmbedding(nn.Module):
    """RoPE旋转位置编码"""
    def __init__(self, dim: int, max_position_embeddings: int = 2048, base: float = 10000.0):
        self.dim = dim
        self.base = base
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (base ** (torch.arange(0, dim, 2).float() / dim))
        self.register_buffer("inv_freq", inv_freq, persistent=False)
        
    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor, seq_len: int):
        # x: [batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim]
        t = torch.arange(seq_len, device=x.device, dtype=self.inv_freq.dtype)
        freqs = torch.einsum("i,j->ij", t, self.inv_freq)
        emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)
        cos = emb.cos()
        sin = emb.sin()
        return cos, sin


def apply_rotary_pos_emb(q, k, cos, sin):
    """应用旋转位置编码"""
    q_embed = (q * cos) + (rotate_half(q) * sin)
    k_embed = (k * cos) + (rotate_half(k) * sin)
    return q_embed, k_embed


def rotate_half(x):
    """旋转一半的维度"""
    x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
    return torch.cat((-x2, x1), dim=-1)


class BunnyPhiAttention(nn.Module):
    """多头注意力机制"""
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
        self.head_dim = self.hidden_size // self.num_heads
        self.num_key_value_heads = config.num_key_value_heads
        self.num_key_value_groups = self.num_heads // self.num_key_value_heads
        
        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=config.attention_bias)
        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=config.attention_bias)
        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=config.attention_bias)
        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(self.num_heads * self.head_dim, self.hidden_size, bias=config.attention_bias)
        
        self.rotary_emb = RotaryEmbedding(
            self.head_dim,
            max_position_embeddings=config.max_position_embeddings,
            base=config.rope_theta
        
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(config.attention_dropout)
    
    def forward(
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        position_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        past_key_value: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor]] = None,
        output_attentions: bool = False,
        use_cache: bool = False,
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor], Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor]]]:
        batch_size, seq_len, _ = hidden_states.shape
        
        # 计算查询、键、值
        query_states = self.q_proj(hidden_states)
        key_states = self.k_proj(hidden_states)
        value_states = self.v_proj(hidden_states)
        
        # 重塑为多头形式
        query_states = query_states.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        key_states = key_states.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_key_value_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        value_states = value_states.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_key_value_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        
        # 应用旋转位置编码
        cos, sin = self.rotary_emb(value_states, seq_len=seq_len)
        query_states, key_states = apply_rotary_pos_emb(query_states, key_states, cos, sin)
        
        # 如果有过去的键值对，进行拼接
        if past_key_value is not None:
            key_states = torch.cat([past_key_value[0], key_states], dim=2)
            value_states = torch.cat([past_key_value[1], value_states], dim=2)
        
        past_key_value = (key_states, value_states) if use_cache else None
        
        # 缩放点积注意力
        attn_weights = torch.matmul(query_states, key_states.transpose(2, 3)) / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)
        
        if attention_mask is not None:
            attn_weights = attn_weights + attention_mask
        
        attn_weights = nn.functional.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(query_states.dtype)
        attn_weights = self.dropout(attn_weights)
        
        attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_weights, value_states)
        
        # 重塑输出
        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()
        attn_output = attn_output.reshape(batch_size, seq_len, self.hidden_size)
        
        # 输出投影
        attn_output = self.o_proj(attn_output)
        
        if not output_attentions:
            attn_weights = None
        
        return attn_output, attn_weights, past_key_value


class BunnyPhiMLP(nn.Module):
    """前馈神经网络"""
        self.intermediate_size = config.intermediate_size
        
        self.gate_proj = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.intermediate_size, bias=False)
        self.up_proj = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.intermediate_size, bias=False)
        self.down_proj = nn.Linear(self.intermediate_size, self.hidden_size, bias=False)
        self.act_fn = nn.GELU()
    
    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self.down_proj(self.act_fn(self.gate_proj(x)) * self.up_proj(x))


class BunnyPhiDecoderLayer(nn.Module):
    """Transformer解码器层"""
        
        self.self_attn = BunnyPhiAttention(config=config)
        self.mlp = BunnyPhiMLP(config)
        
        self.input_layernorm = nn.LayerNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.layer_norm_eps)
        self.post_attention_layernorm = nn.LayerNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.layer_norm_eps)
        
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(config.hidden_dropout_prob)
    
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor]]]:
        # 自注意力
        hidden_states = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states)
        
        hidden_states, self_attn_weights, present_key_value = self.self_attn(
            hidden_states=hidden_states,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            position_ids=position_ids,
            past_key_value=past_key_value,
            output_attentions=output_attentions,
            use_cache=use_cache,
        hidden_states = residual + self.dropout(hidden_states)
        
        # 前馈网络
        hidden_states = self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden_states)
        hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states)
        
        outputs = (hidden_states,)
        
        if output_attentions:
            outputs += (self_attn_weights,)
        
        if use_cache:
            outputs += (present_key_value,)
        
        return outputs


    """BunnyPhi基础模型"""
    base_model_prefix = "model"
    
        self.padding_idx = config.pad_token_id
        self.vocab_size = config.vocab_size
        
        self.embed_tokens = nn.Embedding(config.vocab_size, config.hidden_size, self.padding_idx)
        
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([
            BunnyPhiDecoderLayer(config) for _ in range(config.num_hidden_layers)
        
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.layer_norm_eps)
        
        self.gradient_checkpointing = False
        
        # 初始化权重
    
    def get_input_embeddings(self):
        return self.embed_tokens
    
    def set_input_embeddings(self, value):
        self.embed_tokens = value
    
        input_ids: torch.LongTensor = None,
        position_ids: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
        past_key_values: Optional[Tuple[Tuple[torch.FloatTensor]]] = None,
        inputs_embeds: Optional[torch.FloatTensor] = None,
        use_cache: Optional[bool] = None,
        output_attentions: Optional[bool] = None,
        output_hidden_states: Optional[bool] = None,
        return_dict: Optional[bool] = None,
    ) -> Union[Tuple, BaseModelOutputWithPast]:
        output_attentions = output_attentions if output_attentions is not None else self.config.output_attentions
        output_hidden_states = output_hidden_states if output_hidden_states is not None else self.config.output_hidden_states
        use_cache = use_cache if use_cache is not None else self.config.use_cache
        return_dict = return_dict if return_dict is not None else self.config.use_return_dict
        
        if input_ids is not None and inputs_embeds is not None:
            raise ValueError("不能同时指定input_ids和inputs_embeds")
        elif input_ids is not None:
            batch_size, seq_length = input_ids.shape
        elif inputs_embeds is not None:
            batch_size, seq_length, _ = inputs_embeds.shape
            raise ValueError("必须指定input_ids或inputs_embeds")
        
        if past_key_values is None:
            past_key_values_length = 0
            past_key_values = tuple([None] * len(self.layers))
            past_key_values_length = past_key_values[0][0].shape[2]
        
        if position_ids is None:
            device = input_ids.device if input_ids is not None else inputs_embeds.device
            position_ids = torch.arange(
                past_key_values_length, seq_length + past_key_values_length, dtype=torch.long, device=device
            position_ids = position_ids.unsqueeze(0).view(-1, seq_length)
        
        if inputs_embeds is None:
            inputs_embeds = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
        
        # 生成注意力掩码
            if attention_mask.size() != (batch_size, 1, seq_length, seq_length + past_key_values_length):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"注意力掩码形状应为 {(batch_size, 1, seq_length, seq_length + past_key_values_length)}"
                    f"但得到 {attention_mask.size()}"
        
        hidden_states = inputs_embeds
        
        # 解码器层
        all_hidden_states = () if output_hidden_states else None
        all_self_attentions = () if output_attentions else None
        next_decoder_cache = () if use_cache else None
        
        for idx, decoder_layer in enumerate(self.layers):
            if output_hidden_states:
                all_hidden_states += (hidden_states,)
            
            past_key_value = past_key_values[idx] if past_key_values is not None else None
            
            if self.gradient_checkpointing and self.training:
                def create_custom_forward(module):
                    def custom_forward(*inputs):
                        return module(*inputs)
                    return custom_forward
                
                layer_outputs = torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(
                    create_custom_forward(decoder_layer),
                    hidden_states,
                    attention_mask,
                    position_ids,
                    past_key_value,
                    output_attentions,
                    use_cache,
                layer_outputs = decoder_layer(
            
            hidden_states = layer_outputs[0]
            
                next_decoder_cache += (layer_outputs[2 if output_attentions else 1],)
            
                all_self_attentions += (layer_outputs[1],)
        
        hidden_states = self.norm(hidden_states)
        
        
        next_cache = next_decoder_cache if use_cache else None
        
        if not return_dict:
            return tuple(
                v for v in [hidden_states, next_cache, all_hidden_states, all_self_attentions] if v is not None
        
        return BaseModelOutputWithPast(
            last_hidden_state=hidden_states,
            past_key_values=next_cache,
            hidden_states=all_hidden_states,
            attentions=all_self_attentions,


class BunnyPhiForSequenceClassification(PreTrainedModel):
    """BunnyPhi序列分类模型"""
    
    def __init__(self, config):
        self.num_labels = config.num_labels
        self.model = BunnyPhiModel(config)
        self.score = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, self.num_labels, bias=False)
        
        # 注册模型到AutoModel
        AutoModelForSequenceClassification.register(BunnyPhiConfig, BunnyPhiForSequenceClassification)
        
    
        return self.model.embed_tokens
    
        self.model.embed_tokens = value
    
        input_ids: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.FloatTensor] = None,
        labels: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
    ) -> Union[Tuple, SequenceClassifierOutput]:
        
        outputs = self.model(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            past_key_values=past_key_values,
            inputs_embeds=inputs_embeds,
            output_hidden_states=output_hidden_states,
            return_dict=return_dict,
        
        sequence_output = outputs[0]
        logits = self.score(sequence_output)
        
        loss = None
            if self.config.problem_type is None:
                if self.num_labels == 1:
                    self.config.problem_type = "regression"
                elif self.num_labels > 1 and (labels.dtype == torch.long or labels.dtype == torch.int):
                    self.config.problem_type = "single_label_classification"
                    self.config.problem_type = "multi_label_classification"
            
            if self.config.problem_type == "regression":
                loss_fct = nn.MSELoss()
                    loss = loss_fct(logits.squeeze(), labels.squeeze())
                    loss = loss_fct(logits, labels)
            elif self.config.problem_type == "single_label_classification":
                loss_fct = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
                loss = loss_fct(logits.view(-1, self.num_labels), labels.view(-1))
            elif self.config.problem_type == "multi_label_classification":
                loss_fct = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
        
            output = (logits,) + outputs[1:]
            return ((loss,) + output) if loss is not None else output
        
        return SequenceClassifierOutput(
            loss=loss,
            logits=logits,
            hidden_states=outputs.hidden_states,
            attentions=outputs.attentions,

智能数据投喂器 - 支持多格式、自动划分、批量处理
import codecs
import pickle
from typing import List, Tuple, Dict, Any, Generator, Optional, Union
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, ProcessPoolExecutor

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedShuffleSplit
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from loguru import logger

from .parser import FileParser


class DataConfig:
    """数据配置类"""
    data_dir: str
    supported_formats: List[str] = None
    label_depth: int = 1
    val_split: float = 0.2
    test_split: float = 0.1
    batch_size: int = 32
    shuffle: bool = True
    seed: int = 42
    max_samples: Optional[int] = None
    num_workers: int = 4


class LabeledDataLoader:
    """带标签数据加载器"""
    def __init__(self, config: DataConfig):
        self.parser = FileParser()
        self.supported_formats = config.supported_formats or ["txt", "csv", "json", "jsonl", "parquet"]
    
    def load_with_labels(self) -> List[Tuple[str, Any, str]]:
        加载文件并提取标签
        
        返回:
            List[Tuple[文件路径, 内容, 标签]]
        data_dir = Path(self.config.data_dir)
        
        if not data_dir.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"数据目录不存在: {data_dir}")
        
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(data_dir):
            # 跳过隐藏目录
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
            
            # 提取标签（基于文件夹层级）
            rel_path = os.path.relpath(root, self.config.data_dir)
            if rel_path == ".":
                label = "unlabeled"
                label_parts = rel_path.split(os.sep)
                label = label_parts[self.config.label_depth - 1] if len(label_parts) >= self.config.label_depth else "unlabeled"
            
                # 跳过隐藏文件
                if file.startswith('.'):
                
                ext = file_path.suffix[1:].lower()
                
                if ext in self.supported_formats:
                        _, content = self.parser.parse(str(file_path))
                        data.append((str(file_path), content, label))
                        logger.warning(f"跳过文件 {file_path}: {str(e)}")
        
        if self.config.max_samples and len(data) > self.config.max_samples:
            np.random.seed(self.config.seed)
            indices = np.random.choice(len(data), self.config.max_samples, replace=False)
            data = [data[i] for i in indices]
        
        logger.info(f"加载了 {len(data)} 个样本，{len(set(d[2] for d in data))} 个类别")
        return data


    """数据处理器"""
    def __init__(self, data: List[Tuple[str, Any, str]]):
        self.data = data
        self.labels = [label for _, _, label in data]
        self.label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
        self.label_encoder.fit(self.labels)
    
    def split_stratified(self, val_split: float = 0.2, test_split: float = 0.1) -> Tuple[List, List, List]:
        """分层划分数据集"""
        y = self.label_encoder.transform(self.labels)
        
        # 先划分测试集
        if test_split > 0:
            sss = StratifiedShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=test_split, random_state=42)
            train_val_idx, test_idx = next(sss.split(self.data, y))
            test_data = [self.data[i] for i in test_idx]
            train_val_data = [self.data[i] for i in train_val_idx]
            y_train_val = y[train_val_idx]
            test_data = []
            train_val_data = self.data
            y_train_val = y
        
        # 再划分训练集和验证集
        if val_split > 0:
            val_size = val_split / (1 - test_split) if test_split > 0 else val_split
            sss = StratifiedShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=val_size, random_state=42)
            train_idx, val_idx = next(sss.split(train_val_data, y_train_val))
            train_data = [train_val_data[i] for i in train_idx]
            val_data = [train_val_data[i] for i in val_idx]
            train_data = train_val_data
            val_data = []
        
        return train_data, val_data, test_data
    
    def encode_labels(self, labels: List[str]) -> np.ndarray:
        """编码标签"""
        return self.label_encoder.transform(labels)
    
    def decode_labels(self, encoded_labels: np.ndarray) -> List[str]:
        """解码标签"""
        return self.label_encoder.inverse_transform(encoded_labels)
    
    def get_label_mapping(self) -> Dict[str, int]:
        """获取标签映射"""
        return dict(zip(self.label_encoder.classes_, range(len(self.label_encoder.classes_))))


class ModelDataGenerator:
    """模型数据生成器"""
        data: List[Tuple[str, Any, str]],
        batch_size: int = 32,
        preprocess_func=None,
        shuffle: bool = True,
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        self.preprocess = preprocess_func or (lambda x: x)
        self.shuffle = shuffle
        self.seed = seed
        
        self.n_samples = len(data)
        self._shuffle_indices = np.arange(self.n_samples)
        
        if self.shuffle:
            np.random.seed(seed)
            np.random.shuffle(self._shuffle_indices)
    
        return (self.n_samples + self.batch_size - 1) // self.batch_size
    
    def __iter__(self) -> Generator:
        """无限循环生成器"""
            
            for i in range(0, self.n_samples, self.batch_size):
                batch_indices = self._shuffle_indices[i:i + self.batch_size]
                batch = [self.data[idx] for idx in batch_indices]
                
                    X, y = self._process_batch(batch)
                    yield X, y
                    logger.error(f"处理批次时出错: {str(e)}")
    
    def _process_batch(self, batch: List[Tuple]) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        """处理批次数据"""
        contents = [item[1] for item in batch]
        labels = [item[2] for item in batch]
        
        X = self.preprocess(contents)
        y = np.array(labels, dtype=np.int64)
        
        return X, y


class SmartDataFeeder:
    """智能数据投喂器"""
        self.loader = LabeledDataLoader(config)
        self.raw_data = []
        self.processor = None
        self.train_data = []
        self.val_data = []
        self.test_data = []
    
    def load_and_process(self) -> "SmartDataFeeder":
        """加载并处理数据"""
        logger.info("开始加载数据...")
        self.raw_data = self.loader.load_with_labels()
        
        logger.info("开始处理数据...")
        self.processor = DataProcessor(self.raw_data)
        self.train_data, self.val_data, self.test_data = self.processor.split_stratified(
            self.config.val_split, self.config.test_split
        
        logger.info(f"数据划分完成: 训练集={len(self.train_data)}, 验证集={len(self.val_data)}, 测试集={len(self.test_data)}")
        return self
    
    def get_train_generator(self, preprocess_func=None) -> ModelDataGenerator:
        """获取训练数据生成器"""
        return ModelDataGenerator(
            self.train_data,
            batch_size=self.config.batch_size,
            preprocess_func=preprocess_func,
            shuffle=self.config.shuffle,
            seed=self.config.seed
    
    def get_val_generator(self, preprocess_func=None) -> ModelDataGenerator:
        """获取验证数据生成器"""
            self.val_data,
            shuffle=False,
    
    def get_test_generator(self, preprocess_func=None) -> ModelDataGenerator:
        """获取测试数据生成器"""
            self.test_data,
    
        if self.processor is None:
            raise ValueError("请先调用load_and_process()方法")
        return self.processor.get_label_mapping()
    
    def get_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """获取统计信息"""
        if not self.raw_data:
        
        labels = [d[2] for d in self.raw_data]
        unique_labels = set(labels)
        label_counts = {label: labels.count(label) for label in unique_labels}
        
            "total_samples": len(self.raw_data),
            "train_samples": len(self.train_data),
            "val_samples": len(self.val_data),
            "test_samples": len(self.test_data),
            "num_classes": len(unique_labels),
            "class_distribution": label_counts,
            "supported_formats": self.config.supported_formats,
            "label_depth": self.config.label_depth
    
    def save_splits(self, output_dir: str):
        """保存划分后的数据"""
        
        splits = {
            "train": self.train_data,
            "val": self.val_data,
            "test": self.test_data
        
        for split_name, split_data in splits.items():
            if split_data:
                split_file = output_dir / f"{split_name}_data.pkl"
                with open(split_file, "wb") as f:
                    pickle.dump(split_data, f)
                logger.info(f"保存 {split_name} 数据到 {split_file}")
        
        # 保存标签映射
        if self.processor:
            mapping_file = output_dir / "label_mapping.json"
            with open(mapping_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(self.processor.get_label_mapping(), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    
    def load_splits(cls, input_dir: str) -> Tuple[List, List, List, Dict]:
        """加载划分后的数据"""
        input_dir = Path(input_dir)
        
        splits = {}
        for split_name in ["train", "val", "test"]:
            split_file = input_dir / f"{split_name}_data.pkl"
            if split_file.exists():
                with open(split_file, "rb") as f:
                    splits[split_name] = pickle.load(f)
                splits[split_name] = []
        
        # 加载标签映射
        mapping_file = input_dir / "label_mapping.json"
        if mapping_file.exists():
            with open(mapping_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                label_mapping = json.load(f)
            label_mapping = {}
        
        return splits["train"], splits["val"], splits["test"], label_mapping

        self.val_loader = self.data_feeder.get_val_generator(preprocess_function)
        self.test_loader = self.data_feeder.get_test_generator(preprocess_function)

    def setup_optimizer(self):
        """设置优化器"""
        logger.info("开始设置优化器...")
        
        # 获取优化器参数
        optimizer_name = self.training_config.get("optimizer", "AdamW")
        learning_rate = float(self.training_config.get("learning_rate", 5e-5))
        weight_decay = float(self.training_config.get("weight_decay", 0.01))
        
        # 分离参数
        no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight"]
        optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
                "params": [p for n, p in self.model.named_parameters() 
                          if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)],
                "weight_decay": weight_decay,
                          if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)],
                "weight_decay": 0.0,
        
        # 创建优化器
        if optimizer_name.lower() == "adamw":
                optimizer_grouped_parameters,
                lr=learning_rate,
                betas=(0.9, 0.999),
                eps=1e-8
        elif optimizer_name.lower() == "adam":
            self.optimizer = optim.Adam(
        elif optimizer_name.lower() == "sgd":
            self.optimizer = optim.SGD(
                momentum=0.9
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的优化器: {optimizer_name}")
        
        logger.info(f"优化器设置完成: {optimizer_name}")
    
    def setup_scheduler(self, total_steps: int):
        """设置学习率调度器"""
        logger.info("开始设置学习率调度器...")
        
        scheduler_name = self.training_config.get("scheduler", "linear")
        warmup_steps = int(self.training_config.get("warmup_steps", 0.1 * total_steps))
        
        if scheduler_name.lower() == "linear":
            self.scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
                num_warmup_steps=warmup_steps,
                num_training_steps=total_steps
        elif scheduler_name.lower() == "cosine":
            self.scheduler = get_cosine_schedule_with_warmup(
                num_training_steps=total_steps,
                num_cycles=0.5
        elif scheduler_name.lower() == "constant":
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的学习率调度器: {scheduler_name}")
        
        logger.info(f"学习率调度器设置完成: {scheduler_name}")
    
    def setup_training(self):
        logger.info("开始设置训练环境...")
        
        # 准备加速器
        (self.model, self.optimizer, self.train_loader, 
         self.val_loader, self.scheduler) = self.accelerator.prepare(
            self.model, self.optimizer, self.train_loader, 
            self.val_loader, self.scheduler
        
        # 初始化梯度缩放器（用于混合精度训练）
        if self.accelerator.mixed_precision == "fp16":
            self.scaler = GradScaler()
        
        logger.info("训练环境设置完成")
    
    def train_epoch(self, epoch: int) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """训练一个epoch"""
        total_steps = 0
        
        # 进度条
        from tqdm.auto import tqdm
        progress_bar = tqdm(
            self.train_loader,
            desc=f"Epoch {epoch}",
            disable=not self.accelerator.is_local_main_process
        
        for batch_idx, (inputs, labels) in enumerate(progress_bar):
            with self.accelerator.accumulate(self.model):
                # 混合精度训练
                with autocast(enabled=self.accelerator.mixed_precision != "no"):
                    outputs = self.model(**inputs, labels=labels)
                
                # 反向传播
                self.accelerator.backward(loss)
                
                # 梯度裁剪
                if self.training_config.get("max_grad_norm", 1.0) > 0:
                    self.accelerator.clip_grad_norm_(
                        self.training_config["max_grad_norm"]
                
                # 优化器步进
                self.optimizer.step()
                if self.scheduler is not None:
            
            # 更新统计信息
            total_steps += 1
            
            # 更新进度条
            progress_bar.set_postfix({
                "loss": f"{loss.item():.4f}",
                "lr": f"{self.optimizer.param_groups[0]['lr']:.2e}"
            
            # 记录日志
            if batch_idx % self.training_config.get("logging_steps", 10) == 0:
                self.accelerator.log({
                    "train_loss": loss.item(),
                    "learning_rate": self.optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"],
                    "epoch": epoch,
                    "step": batch_idx
        
        avg_loss = total_loss / total_steps if total_steps > 0 else 0
        return {"train_loss": avg_loss}
    
    def evaluate(self, dataloader) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """评估模型"""
        self.model.eval()
        all_preds = []
        all_labels = []
        
            for inputs, labels in dataloader:
                    logits = outputs.logits
                
                
                # 收集预测和标签
                preds = torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
                all_preds.extend(preds.cpu().numpy())
                all_labels.extend(labels.cpu().numpy())
        
        
        # 计算指标
        metrics = compute_metrics(all_preds, all_labels)
        metrics["eval_loss"] = avg_loss
        
    
        """主训练循环"""
        logger.info("开始训练...")
        
        # 设置所有组件
        self.setup_model()
        self.setup_tokenizer()
        self.setup_data()
        self.setup_optimizer()
        
        # 计算总步数
        num_epochs = self.training_config.get("num_epochs", 3)
        batches_per_epoch = len(self.train_loader)
        total_steps = num_epochs * batches_per_epoch
        
        self.setup_scheduler(total_steps)
        self.setup_training()
        
        # 训练循环
        best_score = 0
        patience_counter = 0
        patience = self.training_config.get("patience", 5)
        
        for epoch in range(1, num_epochs + 1):
            logger.info(f"开始第 {epoch}/{num_epochs} 轮训练")
            
            # 训练一个epoch
            train_metrics = self.train_epoch(epoch)
            logger.info(f"第 {epoch} 轮训练完成，训练损失: {train_metrics['train_loss']:.4f}")
            
            # 评估
            if self.val_loader:
                eval_metrics = self.evaluate(self.val_loader)
                logger.info(f"验证指标: {eval_metrics}")
                
                # 记录到加速器
                    "eval_loss": eval_metrics.get("eval_loss", 0),
                    "accuracy": eval_metrics.get("accuracy", 0),
                    "f1": eval_metrics.get("f1", 0)
                
                # 检查是否是最好模型
                score = eval_metrics.get("accuracy", 0)
                if score > best_score:
                    best_score = score
                    self.save_checkpoint(epoch, score, is_best=True)
                    logger.info(f"新的最佳模型，分数: {score:.4f}")
                    patience_counter += 1
                    logger.info(f"耐心计数器: {patience_counter}/{patience}")
                    
                    # 早停
                    if patience_counter >= patience:
                        logger.info(f"达到早停条件，停止训练")
            
            # 保存检查点
            if epoch % self.training_config.get("save_steps", 1) == 0:
                self.save_checkpoint(epoch, best_score, is_best=False)
        
        # 训练完成
        logger.info("训练完成")
        
        # 最终评估
        if self.test_loader:
            test_metrics = self.evaluate(self.test_loader)
            logger.info(f"最终测试指标: {test_metrics}")
        
        # 保存最终模型
        self.save_final_model()
    
    def save_checkpoint(self, epoch: int, score: float, is_best: bool = False):
        """保存检查点"""
        checkpoint_dir = self.output_dir / "checkpoints"
        checkpoint_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        if is_best:
            checkpoint_path = checkpoint_dir / "best_model"
            checkpoint_path = checkpoint_dir / f"checkpoint-epoch-{epoch}"
        
        # 保存模型
        self.accelerator.wait_for_everyone()
        unwrapped_model = self.accelerator.unwrap_model(self.model)
        unwrapped_model.save_pretrained(
            checkpoint_path,
            is_main_process=self.accelerator.is_main_process,
            save_function=self.accelerator.save
        
        # 保存分词器
        if self.tokenizer:
            self.tokenizer.save_pretrained(checkpoint_path)
        
        # 保存配置
            "score": score,
            "model_config": self.model_config,
            "training_config": self.training_config,
            "data_config": self.data_config
        
        config_path = checkpoint_path / "training_config.json"
        with open(config_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(config, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        
        logger.info(f"检查点保存到: {checkpoint_path}")
    
    def save_final_model(self):
        """保存最终模型"""
        final_dir = self.output_dir / "final_model"
        
        # 保存模型
            final_dir,
        
        # 保存分词器
            self.tokenizer.save_pretrained(final_dir)
        
        logger.info(f"最终模型保存到: {final_dir}")
