#!/usr/bin/env python3
BunnyPhi主训练脚本
支持命令行参数和配置文件

# 添加项目根目录到路径
project_root = Path(__file__).parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root))

from src.trainers.trainer import BunnyPhiTrainer
from src.utils.logger import setup_logging
from src.utils.config import load_config, merge_configs


def parse_args():
    """解析命令行参数"""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="训练BunnyPhi模型")
    
    # 配置文件
    parser.add_argument(
        "--config",
        type=str,
        default="configs/training_config.yaml",
        help="训练配置文件路径"
        "--model-config",
        default="configs/model_config.yaml",
        help="模型配置文件路径"
        "--data-config",
        default="configs/data_config.yaml",
        help="数据配置文件路径"
    
    # 训练参数
        "--output-dir",
        default="./outputs",
        help="输出目录"
        "--num-epochs",
        type=int,
        default=None,
        help="训练轮数"
        "--batch-size",
        help="批次大小"
        "--learning-rate",
        type=float,
        help="学习率"
    
    # 数据参数
        "--data-dir",
        help="数据目录"
    
    # 模型参数
        "--model-path",
        help="预训练模型路径"
    
    # 硬件参数
        "--mixed-precision",
        choices=["no", "fp16", "bf16"],
        help="混合精度训练"
        "--gradient-checkpointing",
        action="store_true",
        help="启用梯度检查点"
    
    # 实验跟踪
        "--wandb",
        help="启用Weights & Biases"
        "--wandb-project",
        default="bunny-phi",
        help="WandB项目名称"
        "--wandb-run-name",
        help="WandB运行名称"
    
    return parser.parse_args()


    """主函数"""
    # 解析参数
    args = parse_args()
    
    # 加载配置文件
    training_config = load_config(args.config)
    model_config = load_config(args.model_config)
    data_config = load_config(args.data_config)
    
    # 合并命令行参数
    if args.output_dir:
        training_config["output_dir"] = args.output_dir
    
    if args.num_epochs:
        training_config["num_epochs"] = args.num_epochs
    
    if args.batch_size:
        training_config["per_device_train_batch_size"] = args.batch_size
        training_config["per_device_eval_batch_size"] = args.batch_size * 2
    
    if args.learning_rate:
        training_config["learning_rate"] = args.learning_rate
    
    if args.data_dir:
        data_config["data_dir"] = args.data_dir
    
    if args.model_path:
        model_config["pretrained_path"] = args.model_path
        model_config["from_pretrained"] = True
    
    if args.mixed_precision:
        training_config["mixed_precision"] = args.mixed_precision
    
    if args.gradient_checkpointing:
        training_config["gradient_checkpointing"] = True
    
    if args.wandb:
        training_config["use_wandb"] = True
    
    if args.wandb_project:
        training_config["wandb_project"] = args.wandb_project
    
    if args.wandb_run_name:
        training_config["wandb_run_name"] = args.wandb_run_name
    
    # 创建输出目录
    output_dir = Path(training_config["output_dir"])
    
    # 设置日志
    setup_logging(output_dir / "logs")
    
    # 保存配置
    configs = {
        "training_config": training_config,
        "model_config": model_config,
        "data_config": data_config
    
    config_file = output_dir / "configs.json"
    with open(config_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(configs, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    
    # 创建训练器
    trainer = BunnyPhiTrainer(
        model_config=model_config,
        data_config=data_config,
        training_config=training_config,
        output_dir=str(output_dir)
    
    # 开始训练
    
    print(f"\n训练完成！模型保存在: {output_dir}")
    print(f"配置保存在: {config_file}")

# 数据模型
class TextRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(..., description="输入文本")
    max_length: Optional[int] = Field(512, description="最大长度")
    temperature: Optional[float] = Field(1.0, description="温度参数")


class BatchRequest(BaseModel):
    texts: List[str] = Field(..., description="批量文本")


class TrainingRequest(BaseModel):
    data_dir: str = Field(..., description="数据目录")
    output_dir: str = Field("./outputs", description="输出目录")
    num_epochs: int = Field(10, description="训练轮数")
    batch_size: int = Field(8, description="批次大小")


class PredictionResponse(BaseModel):
    prediction: str = Field(..., description="预测结果")
    confidence: float = Field(..., description="置信度")
    probabilities: Dict[str, float] = Field(..., description="类别概率")


class TrainingResponse(BaseModel):
    task_id: str = Field(..., description="任务ID")
    status: str = Field(..., description="任务状态")
    output_dir: str = Field(..., description="输出目录")

class ModelManager:
    """模型管理器"""
    
        self.device = None
        self.label_map = None
    
    def load(self, model_path: str):
        from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoConfig
        
        logger.info(f"加载模型: {model_path}")
        
        # 设置设备
        logger.info(f"使用设备: {self.device}")
        
        # 加载配置
        config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
        
        # 加载模型
        
        # 加载分词器
        self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
        
        
        # 加载标签映射
        self.label_map = config.id2label if hasattr(config, "id2label") else {}
        
        logger.info(f"模型加载完成，标签数量: {len(self.label_map)}")
    
    def predict(self, text: str, max_length: int = 512) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """预测单条文本"""
        
        # 编码文本
        
        # 移动到设备
        inputs = {k: v.to(self.device) for k, v in inputs.items()}
        
        # 推理
            probabilities = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
            prediction = torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
        
        # 转换为Python类型
        prediction_idx = prediction.item()
        confidence = probabilities[0][prediction_idx].item()
        probs = probabilities[0].cpu().numpy().tolist()
        
        # 获取标签
        predicted_label = self.label_map.get(prediction_idx, str(prediction_idx))
        
        # 构建概率字典
        prob_dict = {}
        for idx, prob in enumerate(probs):
            label = self.label_map.get(idx, str(idx))
            prob_dict[label] = float(prob)
        
            "text": text,
            "prediction": predicted_label,
            "confidence": confidence,
            "probabilities": prob_dict
    
    def predict_batch(self, texts: List[str], max_length: int = 512) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """批量预测"""

@app.post("/train", response_model=TrainingResponse)
async def start_training(request: TrainingRequest):
    
    # 生成任务ID
    task_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    
    # 创建训练任务
    training_tasks[task_id] = {
        "request": request.dict(),
        "output_dir": request.output_dir
    
    # 在后台运行训练
    asyncio.create_task(run_training(task_id, request))
    
    return TrainingResponse(
        status="started",
        output_dir=request.output_dir


async def run_training(task_id: str, request: TrainingRequest):
    """运行训练任务"""
        # 更新任务状态
        training_tasks[task_id]["status"] = "running"
        
        # 加载配置
        config_dir = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "configs"
        
        # 创建训练器
            model_config=str(config_dir / "model_config.yaml"),
            data_config={
                "data_dir": request.data_dir,
            training_config={
                "output_dir": request.output_dir,
                "num_epochs": request.num_epochs,
                "per_device_train_batch_size": request.batch_size
        
        # 开始训练
        
        # 更新任务状态
        training_tasks[task_id]["status"] = "completed"
        training_tasks[task_id]["completed_at"] = str(asyncio.get_event_loop().time())
        
        logger.error(f"训练任务失败: {str(e)}")
        training_tasks[task_id]["status"] = "failed"
        training_tasks[task_id]["error"] = str(e)


@app.get("/tasks/{task_id}")
async def get_task_status(task_id: str):
    """获取任务状态"""
    if task_id not in training_tasks:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="任务不存在")
    
    return training_tasks[task_id]

8. 快速开始指南
README.md
markdown
# BunnyPhi智能数据投喂与训练系统

一个完整的、生产级的智能数据投喂与模型训练系统，支持多格式数据处理、自动模型训练和API服务。

## 特性

### 🚀 核心特性
- **多格式数据支持**: TXT、CSV、JSON、JSONL、Parquet等
- **智能数据投喂**: 自动标签提取、分层划分、批量处理
- **高性能模型**: 基于Transformer的BunnyPhi架构
- **完整训练流程**: 支持分布式训练、混合精度、梯度检查点
- **RESTful API**: 提供模型推理、训练管理、数据上传等接口
- **生产级部署**: 支持Docker、Kubernetes部署

### 🔧 技术栈
- **深度学习**: PyTorch 2.0+, Transformers 4.30+
- **数据处理**: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn
- **API框架**: FastAPI, Uvicorn
- **任务管理**: Celery, Redis
- **监控跟踪**: WandB, TensorBoard
- **容器化**: Docker, Docker Compose

## 快速开始

### 1. 环境准备

```bash
# 克隆项目

test_split: 0.1          # 测试集比例
label_depth: 1           # 标签提取深度

max_length: 512          # 最大序列长度
batch_size: 32           # 批次大小
num_workers: 4           # 数据加载线程数

# 训练参数

# 混合精度

gradient_checkpointing: true  # 梯度检查点

# 早停
patience: 5              # 早停耐心值

1. 核心AI智能体协作代码
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from browser_use import Agent
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

async def main():
    agent = Agent(
        task="Go to Reddit, search for 'browser-use', click on the first post and return the first comment.",
        llm=ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o"),
    result = await agent.run()
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())

def cli():
    """命令行接口"""
    import click
    
    @click.group()
    def coze():
        """Coze AI智能体平台命令行工具"""
    
    @coze.command()
    @click.option("--host", default="0.0.0.0", help="监听主机")
    @click.option("--port", default=8000, help="监听端口")
    def serve(host, port):
        """启动API服务器"""
            host=host,
            port=port,
            reload=settings.DEBUG,
            log_level="info",
    
    @click.argument("task_description")
    @click.option("--agents", "-a", multiple=True, help="智能体ID列表")
    @click.option("--timeout", "-t", default=90, help="超时时间(分钟)")
    def run_task(task_description, agents, timeout):
        """执行AI智能体任务"""
        asyncio.run(execute_task_cli(task_description, agents, timeout))
    
    coze()

async def execute_task_cli(task_description: str, agents: List[str], timeout: int):
    """CLI任务执行"""
    
    manager = CollaborationManager.get_instance()
    
    session = await manager.create_collaboration_session(
        agent_ids=list(agents),
        task_description=task_description,
        timeout_minutes=timeout,
    
    print(f"🎯 任务已创建: {session.session_id}")
    print(f"📋 任务描述: {task_description}")
    print(f"🤖 参与智能体: {', '.join(agents)}")
    print(f"⏱️  超时时间: {timeout}分钟")
    print("🚀 开始执行任务...")
    
    result = await manager.execute_task_async(session)
    
    print(f"✅ 任务完成!")
    print(f"📊 结果: {result}")

    cli()

3. src/agents/collaboration_manager.py - 协作管理器
AI智能体协作管理器
实现多个AI智能体之间的协作与协调

from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Set, Union

import redis.asyncio as redis

from src.agents.base_agent import BaseAgent
from src.agents.openai_operator import OpenAIOperator
from src.agents.replit_agent import ReplitAgent
from src.agents.browser_agent import BrowserAgent
from src.utils.logger import get_logger

logger = get_logger(__name__)

class AgentType(Enum):
    """AI智能体类型"""
    OPENAI_OPERATOR = "openai_operator"
    REPLIT_AGENT = "replit_agent"
    BROWSER_AGENT = "browser_agent"
    CUSTOM_AGENT = "custom_agent"

class CollaborationStatus(Enum):
    """协作会话状态"""
    PENDING = "pending"
    RUNNING = "running"
    PAUSED = "paused"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"
    TIMEOUT = "timeout"

class AgentSession:
    """智能体会话信息"""
    agent_id: str
    agent_type: AgentType
    agent_instance: BaseAgent
    status: str = "idle"
    last_active: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    task_queue: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    result_queue: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)

class CollaborationSession:
    """协作会话"""
    session_id: str
    task_description: str
    agents: List[AgentSession]
    prompts: List[str]
    status: CollaborationStatus
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    timeout_minutes: int
    estimated_completion_time: Optional[datetime] = None
    progress: float = 0.0
    results: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    errors: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    credentials: Optional[Dict] = None

class CollaborationManager:
    负责协调多个AI智能体的协作执行
    
    _lock = asyncio.Lock()
    
        """初始化协作管理器"""
        self.active_sessions: Dict[str, CollaborationSession] = {}
        self.agent_registry: Dict[str, BaseAgent] = {}
        self.redis_client: Optional[redis.Redis] = None
        self.executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=10)
        self.active_tasks: Set[asyncio.Task] = set()
        
        # 注册默认智能体
        self._register_default_agents()
    
    def get_instance(cls):
        """获取单例实例"""
            cls._instance = cls()
    
    def _register_default_agents(self):
        """注册默认AI智能体"""
            # OpenAI Operator
            openai_agent = OpenAIOperator(
                agent_id="openai_operator_001",
                name="OpenAI Operator",
                description="负责代码生成和智能搜索的AI智能体",
                config=settings.AGENTS_CONFIG["openai_operator"]
            self.register_agent(openai_agent)
            
            # Replit Agent
            replit_agent = ReplitAgent(
                agent_id="replit_agent_001",
                name="Replit Agent",
                description="负责代码执行和实时构建的AI智能体",
                config=settings.AGENTS_CONFIG["replit_agent"]
            self.register_agent(replit_agent)
            
            # Browser Agent
            browser_agent = BrowserAgent(
                agent_id="browser_agent_001",
                name="Browser Agent",
                description="负责浏览器自动化和Web交互的AI智能体",
                config=settings.AGENTS_CONFIG["browser_agent"]
            self.register_agent(browser_agent)
            
            logger.info(f"✅ 已注册 {len(self.agent_registry)} 个默认智能体")
            
            logger.error(f"注册默认智能体失败: {e}")
    
    def register_agent(self, agent: BaseAgent):
        """注册AI智能体"""
        if agent.agent_id in self.agent_registry:
            raise ValueError(f"智能体 {agent.agent_id} 已注册")
        
        self.agent_registry[agent.agent_id] = agent
        logger.info(f"📝 注册智能体: {agent.name} ({agent.agent_id})")
    
    async def create_collaboration_session(
        agent_ids: List[str],
        task_description: str,
        prompts: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        timeout_minutes: Optional[int] = None,
        credentials: Optional[Dict] = None,
    ) -> CollaborationSession:
        
        Args:
            agent_ids: 参与协作的智能体ID列表
            task_description: 任务描述
            prompts: 提示列表
            timeout_minutes: 超时时间(分钟)
            credentials: 认证凭证
            
        Returns:
            CollaborationSession: 创建的协作会话
        async with self._lock:
            # 验证智能体
            agents = []
            for agent_id in agent_ids:
                if agent_id not in self.agent_registry:
                    raise ValueError(f"智能体 {agent_id} 未注册")
                
                agent = self.agent_registry[agent_id]
                agent_session = AgentSession(
                    agent_id=agent_id,
                    agent_type=AgentType(agent.agent_type),
                    agent_instance=agent,
                agents.append(agent_session)
            
            # 创建会话
            session_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            timeout = timeout_minutes or settings.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES
            
            session = CollaborationSession(
                session_id=session_id,
                agents=agents,
                prompts=prompts or [],
                status=CollaborationStatus.PENDING,
                created_at=datetime.now(),
                updated_at=datetime.now(),
                credentials=credentials,
            
            # 存储会话
            self.active_sessions[session_id] = session
            
            logger.info(
                f"🎯 创建协作会话: {session_id}\n"
                f"   任务: {task_description}\n"
                f"   智能体: {', '.join(agent_ids)}\n"
                f"   超时: {timeout}分钟"
            
            return session
    
    async def execute_task_async(self, session: CollaborationSession) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        异步执行协作任务
        
            session: 协作会话
            
            Dict: 任务执行结果
        
        # 更新会话状态
        session.status = CollaborationStatus.RUNNING
        session.updated_at = datetime.now()
        session.estimated_completion_time = (
            datetime.now() + timedelta(minutes=session.timeout_minutes)
        
        # 创建异步任务
        task = asyncio.create_task(
            self._execute_task_internal(session, task_id)
        self.active_tasks.add(task)
        task.add_done_callback(self.active_tasks.discard)
        
            "status": "running",
            "estimated_completion_time": session.estimated_completion_time.isoformat(),
    
    async def _execute_task_internal(
        session: CollaborationSession,
        task_id: str
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        内部任务执行逻辑
            logger.info(f"🚀 开始执行任务: {task_id}")
            
            # 分配提示给各个智能体
            prompt_assignments = self._assign_prompts_to_agents(session)
            
            # 并行执行智能体任务
            tasks = []
            for agent_session, agent_prompts in prompt_assignments.items():
                    self._execute_agent_tasks(agent_session, agent_prompts, session)
                tasks.append(task)
            
            # 等待所有智能体完成
            agent_results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
            
            # 处理结果
            final_result = self._aggregate_results(agent_results, session)
            
            # 更新会话状态
            session.status = CollaborationStatus.COMPLETED
            session.progress = 100.0
            session.results = final_result
            
            logger.info(f"✅ 任务完成: {task_id}")
            
                "status": "completed",
                "result": final_result,
                "completed_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            logger.error(f"⏰ 任务超时: {task_id}")
            session.status = CollaborationStatus.TIMEOUT
            
                "status": "timeout",
                "error": "任务执行超时",
            
            logger.error(f"❌ 任务失败: {task_id}, 错误: {e}")
            session.status = CollaborationStatus.FAILED
            session.errors.append(str(e))
            
                "status": "failed",
                "error": str(e),
    
    def _assign_prompts_to_agents(
        session: CollaborationSession
    ) -> Dict[AgentSession, List[str]]:
        将提示分配给各个智能体
        
            
            Dict: 智能体到提示列表的映射
        assignments = {}
        
        if not session.prompts:
            # 如果没有特定提示，为每个智能体生成默认提示
            for agent_session in session.agents:
                if agent_session.agent_type == AgentType.OPENAI_OPERATOR:
                    assignments[agent_session] = [
                        f"基于任务描述生成代码: {session.task_description}",
                        "进行智能搜索和代码优化",
                elif agent_session.agent_type == AgentType.REPLIT_AGENT:
                        "执行生成的代码",
                        "进行实时构建和测试",
                elif agent_session.agent_type == AgentType.BROWSER_AGENT:
                        "进行浏览器自动化测试",
                        "验证应用功能",
            # 如果有特定提示，根据智能体类型分配
            for i, prompt in enumerate(session.prompts):
                agent_idx = i % len(session.agents)
                agent_session = session.agents[agent_idx]
                
                if agent_session not in assignments:
                    assignments[agent_session] = []
                assignments[agent_session].append(prompt)
        
        return assignments
    
    async def _execute_agent_tasks(
        agent_session: AgentSession,
        prompts: List[str],
        collaboration_session: CollaborationSession
        执行单个智能体的任务
        
            agent_session: 智能体会话

            agent_session.status = "running"

    def _aggregate_results(
        agent_results: List[Union[Dict, Exception]],
        聚合各个智能体的结果
        
            agent_results: 智能体结果列表
            
            Dict: 聚合结果
        aggregated = {
            "task_description": session.task_description,
            "total_agents": len(session.agents),
            "agent_results": [],
            "summary": {},
            "final_output": None,
        
        successful_agents = []
        failed_agents = []
        
        for result in agent_results:
            if isinstance(result, Exception):
                failed_agents.append({
                    "error": str(result),
                    "type": type(result).__name__,
            
            aggregated["agent_results"].append(result)
            
            if result.get("status") == "completed":
                successful_agents.append(result)
                failed_agents.append(result)
        
        # 根据智能体类型聚合结果
        openai_results = []
        replit_results = []
        browser_results = []
        
        for result in successful_agents:
            if result.get("agent_type") == AgentType.OPENAI_OPERATOR.value:
                openai_results.append(result)
            elif result.get("agent_type") == AgentType.REPLIT_AGENT.value:
                replit_results.append(result)
            elif result.get("agent_type") == AgentType.BROWSER_AGENT.value:
                browser_results.append(result)
        
        # 生成总结
        aggregated["summary"] = {
            "successful_agents": len(successful_agents),
            "failed_agents": len(failed_agents),
            "total_prompts_executed": sum(
                r.get("total_prompts", 0) for r in successful_agents
            "openai_operator_results": len(openai_results),
            "replit_agent_results": len(replit_results),
            "browser_agent_results": len(browser_results),
        
        # 生成最终输出（根据任务类型）
        if openai_results and replit_results:
            # 代码开发任务
            aggregated["final_output"] = self._generate_code_output(
                openai_results, replit_results, browser_results
        elif browser_results:
            # 浏览器自动化任务
            aggregated["final_output"] = self._generate_browser_output(browser_results)
            # 通用任务
            aggregated["final_output"] = {
                "message": "任务执行完成",
                "details": aggregated["agent_results"],
        
        return aggregated
    
    def _generate_code_output(
        openai_results: List[Dict],
        replit_results: List[Dict],
        browser_results: List[Dict]
        """生成代码开发任务的输出"""
        # 提取生成的代码
        generated_code = []
        for result in openai_results:
            for r in result.get("results", []):
                if "code" in str(r.get("result", "")):
                    generated_code.append(r.get("result"))
        
        # 提取执行结果
        execution_results = []
        for result in replit_results:
                execution_results.append(r.get("result"))
        
        # 提取测试结果
        test_results = []
        for result in browser_results:
                test_results.append(r.get("result"))
        
            "type": "code_development",
            "generated_code": generated_code[:5],  # 只显示前5个
            "execution_results": execution_results[:5],
            "test_results": test_results[:5],
            "total_code_snippets": len(generated_code),
            "successful_executions": len(execution_results),
            "successful_tests": len(test_results),
    
    def _generate_browser_output(self, browser_results: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """生成浏览器自动化任务的输出"""
        actions = []
        screenshots = []

                if isinstance(res, dict):
                    if "action" in res:
                        actions.append(res["action"])
                    if "screenshot" in res:

                    if "data" in res:
                        extracted_data.append(res["data"])
        
            "total_actions": len(actions),

    def get_session(self, session_id: str) -> Optional[CollaborationSession]:
        """获取协作会话"""
        return self.active_sessions.get(session_id)
    
    async def cleanup_sessions(self, max_age_hours: int = 24):
        """清理过期的会话"""
        cutoff = datetime.now() - timedelta(hours=max_age_hours)
        
        sessions_to_remove = []
        for session_id, session in self.active_sessions.items():
            if session.created_at < cutoff:
                sessions_to_remove.append(session_id)
        
        for session_id in sessions_to_remove:
            del self.active_sessions[session_id]
            logger.info(f"清理过期会话: {session_id}")
        
        return len(sessions_to_remove)
    
    def active_agents(self) -> List[str]:
        """获取活跃智能体列表"""
        return list(self.agent_registry.keys())
    
    def active_collaborations(self) -> List[str]:
        """获取活跃协作会话列表"""
        return list(self.active_sessions.keys())
    
    async def shutdown(self):
        """关闭协作管理器"""
        logger.info("正在关闭协作管理器...")
        
        # 取消所有任务
        for task in self.active_tasks:
            task.cancel()
        
        if self.active_tasks:
            await asyncio.gather(*self.active_tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        
        # 关闭执行器
        self.executor.shutdown(wait=True)
        
        logger.info("协作管理器已关闭")

OpenAI Operator 智能体

import openai
from openai import AsyncOpenAI



class OpenAIOperator(BaseAgent):
    """OpenAI Operator 智能体"""
    
        agent_id: str,
        name: str,
        description: str,
        config: Optional[Dict] = None
        """初始化OpenAI Operator"""
        super().__init__(agent_id, name, description, "openai_operator")
        
        self.config = config or {}
        self.client = AsyncOpenAI(
            api_key=settings.OPENAI_API_KEY,
            base_url=settings.OPENAI_API_BASE,
            timeout=settings.OPENAI_TIMEOUT,
        
        self.model = self.config.get("model", "gpt-4o")
        self.temperature = self.config.get("temperature", 0.7)
        self.max_tokens = self.config.get("max_tokens", 4000)
        
        # 缓存
        self.code_cache: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self.search_cache: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {}
    
    async def initialize(self):
        """初始化智能体"""
        logger.info(f"初始化OpenAI Operator: {self.name}")
        
        # 测试连接
            await self.client.models.list()
            logger.info(f"✅ OpenAI Operator {self.agent_id} 初始化成功")
            logger.error(f"❌ OpenAI Operator 初始化失败: {e}")
    
    async def execute(
        prompt: str,
        context: Optional[Dict] = None,
        **kwargs
        执行任务
        
            prompt: 执行提示
            context: 执行上下文
            **kwargs: 其他参数
            
            Dict: 执行结果
            logger.info(f"OpenAI Operator 执行任务: {prompt[:100]}...")
            
            # 分析任务类型
            task_type = self._analyze_task_type(prompt)
            
            # 根据任务类型执行
            if task_type == "code_generation":
                result = await self._generate_code(prompt, context)
            elif task_type == "code_search":
                result = await self._search_code(prompt, context)
            elif task_type == "debugging":
                result = await self._debug_code(prompt, context)
            elif task_type == "documentation":
                result = await self._generate_docs(prompt, context)
                result = await self._general_task(prompt, context)
            
                "agent_id": self.agent_id,
                "agent_name": self.name,
                "task_type": task_type,
            
            logger.error(f"OpenAI Operator 执行失败: {e}")
            
    
    def _analyze_task_type(self, prompt: str) -> str:
        """分析任务类型"""
        prompt_lower = prompt.lower()
        
        if any(word in prompt_lower for word in [
            "生成代码", "编写代码", "实现", "code", "generate code", "write code"
        ]):
            return "code_generation"
        
        elif any(word in prompt_lower for word in [
            "搜索代码", "查找代码", "search code", "find code"
            return "code_search"
        
            "调试", "修复", "debug", "fix bug"
            return "debugging"
        
            "文档", "注释", "documentation", "comment"
            return "documentation"
        
            return "general"
    
    async def _generate_code(
        context: Optional[Dict] = None
        """生成代码"""
        # 检查缓存
        cache_key = f"code_gen:{hash(prompt)}"
        if cache_key in self.code_cache:
            logger.info("使用缓存的代码")
            return {"cached": True, "code": self.code_cache[cache_key]}
        
        # 构建系统提示
        system_prompt = self._build_code_generation_system_prompt(context)
        
        # 调用OpenAI API
        response = await self.client.chat.completions.create(
            messages=[
                {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
            temperature=self.temperature,
            max_tokens=self.max_tokens,
        
        # 解析响应
        code_content = response.choices[0].message.content
        
        # 提取代码块
        code_blocks = self._extract_code_blocks(code_content)
        
        # 缓存结果
        if code_blocks:
            self.code_cache[cache_key] = code_blocks[0]
        
            "code_content": code_content,
            "code_blocks": code_blocks,
            "total_tokens": response.usage.total_tokens,
    
    async def _search_code(
        """搜索代码"""
        # 检查缓存
        cache_key = f"code_search:{hash(prompt)}"
        if cache_key in self.search_cache:
            logger.info("使用缓存的搜索结果")
            return {"cached": True, "results": self.search_cache[cache_key]}
        
        # 构建搜索提示
        search_prompt = f"""
        基于以下需求搜索相关代码示例或最佳实践:
        
        需求: {prompt}
        
        请提供:
        1. 相关代码示例
        2. 最佳实践建议
        3. 可能遇到的问题和解决方案
        
        用JSON格式返回搜索结果。
        
        # 调用OpenAI API
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一个专业的代码搜索助手。"},
                {"role": "user", "content": search_prompt},
            temperature=0.3,
            max_tokens=2000,
            response_format={"type": "json_object"},
        
        # 解析响应
            result = json.loads(response.choices[0].message.content)
            
            # 缓存结果
                self.search_cache[cache_key] = result
            elif "results" in result:

                "search_results": result,
            
                "search_results": response.choices[0].message.content,
                "warning": "响应不是有效的JSON格式",

    def _build_code_generation_system_prompt(
        """构建代码生成的系统提示"""
        base_prompt = """
        你是一个专业的代码生成助手。请根据用户需求生成高质量、可维护的代码。

    def _extract_code_blocks(self, text: str) -> List[str]:
        """从文本中提取代码块"""
        
        # 匹配 ```代码块
        pattern = r"```(?:\w+)?\n(.*?)```"
        matches = re.findall(pattern, text, re.DOTALL)
        
        # 如果没有代码块，返回整个文本
        if not matches:
            return [text.strip()]
        
        return [match.strip() for match in matches]

            status = getattr(agent, "status", "active")
            status_counts[status] = status_counts.get(status, 0) + 1
        
        # 协作会话统计
        collaboration_stats = {
            "total_sessions": len(manager.active_sessions),
            "sessions_by_status": {},
        
        for session in manager.active_sessions.values():
            status = session.status.value
            collaboration_stats["sessions_by_status"][status] = (
                collaboration_stats["sessions_by_status"].get(status, 0) + 1
        
            "total_agents": len(manager.agent_registry),
            "agent_types": agent_types,
            "agent_status": status_counts,
            "collaboration_stats": collaboration_stats,
            "active_collaborations": len(manager.active_collaborations),
        
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"获取统计摘要失败: {str(e)}")

📋 完整部署脚本
scripts/setup.trae.sh
#!/bin/bash

# Coze AI智能体平台 - Trae IDE 部署脚本
# 版本: 10.1.0

set -e

# 颜色定义

# 日志函数




# 检查命令是否存在

# 检查Python版本
check_python_version() {
    local python_version=$(python3 --version | cut -d' ' -f2)
    local major=$(echo $python_version | cut -d'.' -f1)
    local minor=$(echo $python_version | cut -d'.' -f2)
    
    if [ $major -lt 3 ] || [ $major -eq 3 -a $minor -lt 11 ]; then
        log_error "需要Python 3.11或更高版本，当前版本: $python_version"
    
    log_info "Python版本: $python_version ✓"

# 安装系统依赖
install_system_deps() {
    log_info "安装系统依赖..."
    
    if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "linux-gnu"* ]]; then
        # Ubuntu/Debian
        if command -v apt-get &> /dev/null; then
            sudo apt-get update
            sudo apt-get install -y \
                python3-pip \
                python3-venv \
                docker.io \
                docker-compose \
                postgresql-client \
                redis-tools
        # CentOS/RHEL
        elif command -v yum &> /dev/null; then
            sudo yum install -y \
                python3-devel \
                docker \
                postgresql \
                redis
    elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
        # macOS
        if ! command -v brew &> /dev/null; then
            log_error "请先安装 Homebrew (https://brew.sh/)"
        
        brew install \
            python@3.11 \
    
    log_success "系统依赖安装完成"

# 安装Python依赖
install_python_deps() {
    log_info "安装Python依赖..."
    
    # 创建虚拟环境
    python3 -m venv venv
    
    # 激活虚拟环境
    source venv/bin/activate
    
    # 升级pip
    pip install --upgrade pip
    
    # 安装依赖
    pip install -r requirements.trae.txt
    
    log_success "Python依赖安装完成"

# 设置环境变量
setup_environment() {
    log_info "设置环境变量..."
    
    if [ ! -f .env ]; then
        cp .env.example .env
        log_warning "已创建 .env 文件，请编辑文件设置必要的环境变量"
    else
        log_info ".env 文件已存在"
    
    # 设置默认环境变量
    export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs)
    
    log_success "环境变量设置完成"

# 初始化数据库
init_database() {
    log_info "初始化数据库..."
    
    # 检查Docker是否运行
    if ! docker info &> /dev/null; then
        log_error "Docker未运行，请先启动Docker"
    
    # 启动数据库服务
    docker-compose -f docker-compose.trae.yml up -d db redis
    
    # 等待数据库就绪
    log_info "等待数据库就绪..."
    sleep 10
    
    # 运行数据库迁移
    log_info "运行数据库迁移..."
    
    if [ -f scripts/migrate.py ]; then
        python scripts/migrate.py
        log_warning "数据库迁移脚本不存在，请手动运行迁移"
    
    log_success "数据库初始化完成"

# 安装浏览器自动化依赖
install_browser_deps() {
    log_info "安装浏览器自动化依赖..."
    
    
    # 安装Playwright
    pip install playwright
    
    # 安装浏览器
    python -m playwright install chromium
    python -m playwright install-deps
    
    log_success "浏览器自动化依赖安装完成"

# 设置Trae IDE集成
setup_trae_integration() {
    log_info "设置Trae IDE集成..."
    
    # 检查Trae CLI
    if ! command -v trae &> /dev/null; then
        log_warning "Trae CLI未安装，跳过Trae集成设置"
    
    # 登录Trae
    if [ -z "$TRAE_API_KEY" ]; then
        log_warning "未设置TRAE_API_KEY，跳过Trae登录"
        trae login --api-key $TRAE_API_KEY
    
    # 初始化项目
    if [ -f .trae-config.json ]; then
        trae project init --config .trae-config.json
    
    log_success "Trae IDE集成设置完成"

# 启动服务
start_services() {
    log_info "启动服务..."
    
    # 启动Docker服务
    docker-compose -f docker-compose.trae.yml up -d
    
    # 检查服务状态
    sleep 5
    
    log_info "服务状态:"
    docker-compose -f docker-compose.trae.yml ps
    
    # 测试API
    log_info "测试API连接..."
    if curl -f http://localhost:8000/health &> /dev/null; then
        log_success "API服务运行正常"
        log_warning "API服务可能尚未就绪，请稍后重试"
    
    log_success "服务启动完成"

# 显示部署信息
show_deployment_info() {
    echo "================================================"
    echo "    Coze AI智能体平台 部署完成!"
    echo "📊 部署信息:"
    echo "   API地址: http://localhost:8000"
    echo "   API文档: http://localhost:8000/docs"
    echo "   监控面板: http://localhost:3000"
    echo "🤖 可用智能体:"
    echo "   • OpenAI Operator: 代码生成和智能搜索"
    echo "   • Replit Agent: 代码执行和实时构建"
    echo "   • Browser Agent: 浏览器自动化"
    echo "🚀 快速开始:"
    echo "   1. 编辑 .env 文件设置API密钥"
    echo "   2. 访问 http://localhost:8000/docs 查看API文档"
    echo "   3. 运行测试: python -m pytest tests/"
    echo "🔧 管理命令:"
    echo "   • 启动服务: docker-compose up -d"
    echo "   • 停止服务: docker-compose down"
    echo "   • 查看日志: docker-compose logs -f"
    echo "   • 运行CLI: python -m src.main cli"
    echo "📞 支持:"
    echo "   • 文档: https://docs.coze.com"
    echo "   • GitHub: https://github.com/coze/ai-agent-platform"
    echo "   • 问题反馈: https://github.com/coze/ai-agent-platform/issues"

# 主函数
main() {
    log_info "开始部署 Coze AI智能体平台..."
    log_info "版本: 10.1.0"
    
    # 检查命令
    check_command pip3
    
    # 检查Python版本
    check_python_version
    
    # 安装依赖
    install_system_deps
    install_python_deps
    
    # 设置环境
    setup_environment
    
    # 初始化数据库
    init_database
    
    # 安装浏览器依赖
    install_browser_deps
    
    # 设置Trae集成
    setup_trae_integration
    
    # 启动服务
    start_services
    
    # 显示部署信息
    show_deployment_info
    
    log_success "部署完成!"

# 执行主函数
main "$@"

## 🚀 概述

Coze AI智能体协作平台是一个基于Trae-AI-IDE的全场景AI智能体协作开发平台，支持多个AI智能体之间的实时协作、代码生成、浏览器自动化和任务执行。

### 核心特性

- 🤖 **多AI智能体协作**: OpenAI Operator、Replit Agent、Browser Agent协同工作
- 💻 **代码智能生成**: 基于GPT-4的代码生成和优化
- 🚀 **实时构建执行**: 支持多种编程语言的实时编译和执行
- 🌐 **浏览器自动化**: 完整的Web自动化测试和数据提取
- 🔗 **API优先**: 完整的OpenAPI 3.0规范，易于集成
- 🐳 **容器化部署**: 支持Docker和Kubernetes部署
- 📊 **实时监控**: 完整的监控和日志系统
- 🔧 **Trae IDE集成**: 深度集成Trae-AI-IDE开发环境

    IDE --> Gateway

./scripts/setup.trae.sh

# 编辑 .env 文件设置API密钥

📖 使用指南
基本使用


url = "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/ai-agents/collaborations"
headers = {"X-API-Key": "your-api-key"}

data = {
    "agent_ids": ["openai_operator_001", "replit_agent_001"],
    "task_description": "开发一个简单的待办事项应用",
    "prompts": [
        "生成前端React组件",
        "实现后端API",
        "添加数据库存储"
    "timeout_minutes": 90

response = requests.post(url, json=data, headers=headers)
session = response.json()
执行单个智能体任务

url = "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/ai-agents/tasks/execute"

    "agent_id": "openai_operator_001",
    "prompt": "生成一个Python的FastAPI用户认证系统"

result = response.json()
获取协作状态

session_id = "your-session-id"
url = f"http://localhost:8000/api/v1/ai-agents/collaborations/{session_id}"

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
status = response.json()
命令行工具
平台提供完整的CLI工具：

# 查看帮助
coze-agent --help

# 启动API服务器
coze-agent serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

# 执行协作任务
coze-agent run-task "开发一个天气应用" \
  --agents openai_operator_001 replit_agent_001 \
  --timeout 60

# 浏览器自动化
coze-browser automate \
  --url https://example.com \
  --script "login_and_extract_data"

环境变量
# 基础配置
ENVIRONMENT=production
DEBUG=false

# 数据库
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/coze_db

# AI服务
OPENAI_API_KEY=your-openai-api-key
REPLIT_API_KEY=your-replit-api-key

# 安全
SECRET_KEY=your-secret-key
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES=30

# Trae集成
TRAE_API_KEY=your-trae-api-key
TRAE_WORKSPACE_ID=your-workspace-id
TRAE_PROJECT_ID=your-project-id

📚 API文档
完整的API文档可通过以下方式访问：

主要端点
端点	方法	描述
/health	GET	健康检查
/ai-agents	GET	获取智能体列表
/ai-agents/collaborations	POST	创建协作会话
/ai-agents/tasks/execute	POST	执行智能体任务
/ai-agents/stats/summary	GET	获取统计摘要

# 排序导入

🚨 故障排除
常见问题
API连接失败

检查环境变量配置，确保API密钥正确
检查网络连接，确保可以访问外部API
数据库连接失败

检查Docker服务是否运行
检查数据库连接字符串
检查数据库端口是否被占用
浏览器自动化失败

安装Playwright浏览器: python -m playwright install
增加SHM大小: docker run --shm-size=2gb
检查浏览器版本兼容性

from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional, Callable
from functools import wraps

# 配置日志
        logging.FileHandler('coze_workflow_engine.log'),
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class WorkflowStatus(Enum):
    """工作流状态枚举"""
    DRAFT = "draft"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    INACTIVE = "inactive"
    ARCHIVED = "archived"


class ExecutionStatus(Enum):
    """执行状态枚举"""
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


class StepType(Enum):
    """步骤类型枚举"""
    ACTION = "action"
    CONDITION = "condition"
    LOOP = "loop"
    PARALLEL = "parallel"
    HTTP = "http"
    DATABASE = "database"
    SCRIPT = "script"
    DELAY = "delay"
    NOTIFICATION = "notification"


class TriggerType(Enum):
    """触发器类型枚举"""
    SCHEDULE = "schedule"
    WEBHOOK = "webhook"
    EVENT = "event"
    MANUAL = "manual"
    API = "api"


class RetryConfig:
    """重试配置"""
    max_retries: int = 3
    retry_delay: int = 5  # 秒
    backoff_multiplier: float = 2.0
    max_delay: int = 60  # 秒
    
    def get_retry_delay(self, attempt: int) -> int:
        """计算重试延迟"""
        delay = self.retry_delay * (self.backoff_multiplier ** (attempt - 1))
        if self.max_delay and delay > self.max_delay:
            return self.max_delay
        return int(delay)


class StepDefinition:
    """步骤定义"""
    id: str
    name: str
    type: StepType
    action: Optional[str] = None
    parameters: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    inputs: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    outputs: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    on_success: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    on_failure: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    retry_config: Optional[RetryConfig] = None
    timeout: int = 300  # 秒


class TriggerDefinition:
    """触发器定义"""
    type: TriggerType
    config: Dict[str, Any]
    enabled: bool = True


class WorkflowDefinition:
    """工作流定义"""
    version: str = "1.0"
    triggers: List[TriggerDefinition] = field(default_factory=list)
    steps: List[StepDefinition] = field(default_factory=list)
    variables: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    error_handling: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


class WorkflowMetadata:
    """工作流元数据"""
    id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    description: str = ""
    version: str = "1.0.0"
    tags: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    created_by: str = ""
    status: WorkflowStatus = WorkflowStatus.DRAFT
    definition: WorkflowDefinition = field(default_factory=WorkflowDefinition)


class ExecutionContext:
    """执行上下文"""
    execution_id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    workflow_id: str = ""
    status: ExecutionStatus = ExecutionStatus.PENDING
    started_at: Optional[datetime] = None
    completed_at: Optional[datetime] = None
    initiated_by: str = ""
    errors: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    step_results: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)


class StepExecutor:
    """步骤执行器基类"""
    
    def __init__(self, step: StepDefinition, context: ExecutionContext):
        self.step = step
        self.context = context
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(f"StepExecutor.{step.id}")
    
    async def execute(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """执行步骤"""
            self.logger.info(f"开始执行步骤: {self.step.name}")
            
            # 处理输入参数
            inputs = self._resolve_inputs()
            
            # 执行具体操作
            result = await self._perform_action(inputs)
            
            # 处理输出
            outputs = self._process_outputs(result)
            
            # 记录结果
            self.context.step_results[self.step.id] = {
                "outputs": outputs,
            
            self.logger.info(f"步骤执行完成: {self.step.name}")
            return {"success": True, "outputs": outputs, "next_steps": self.step.on_success}
            
            self.logger.error(f"步骤执行失败: {self.step.name}, 错误: {str(e)}")
            
            # 记录错误
            self.context.errors.append({
                "step_id": self.step.id,
                "step_name": self.step.name,
            
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e), "next_steps": self.step.on_failure}
    
    def _resolve_inputs(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """解析输入参数"""
        inputs = {}
        for key, value in self.step.inputs.items():
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("{{") and value.endswith("}}"):
                # 从上下文解析变量
                var_name = value[2:-2].strip()
                inputs[key] = self._resolve_variable(var_name)
                inputs[key] = value
        return inputs
    
    def _resolve_variable(self, var_path: str) -> Any:
        """解析变量路径"""
        parts = var_path.split(".")
        value = self.context.variables
        
        for part in parts:
            if part in value:
                value = value[part]
                # 尝试从步骤结果中查找
                if "." in var_path:
                    step_id, output_key = var_path.split(".", 1)
                    if step_id in self.context.step_results:
                        step_result = self.context.step_results[step_id]
                        if output_key in step_result.get("outputs", {}):
                            value = step_result["outputs"][output_key]
                            raise ValueError(f"未找到变量: {var_path}")
                        raise ValueError(f"未找到步骤结果: {step_id}")
        
    
    async def _perform_action(self, inputs: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
        """执行具体操作（由子类实现）"""
    
    def _process_outputs(self, result: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """处理输出"""
        outputs = {}
        for output_key, output_path in self.step.outputs.items():
            if output_path == "$result":
                outputs[output_key] = result
            elif output_path.startswith("$result."):
                # 从结果中提取特定字段
                field_path = output_path[8:]  # 移除"$result."
                field_value = self._extract_field(result, field_path)
                outputs[output_key] = field_value
                outputs[output_key] = output_path
        
    
    def _extract_field(self, data: Any, field_path: str) -> Any:
        """从数据中提取字段"""
        if not field_path:
        
        parts = field_path.split(".")
        value = data
        
            if isinstance(value, dict) and part in value:
                    index = int(part)
                    if 0 <= index < len(value):
                        value = value[index]
                        raise IndexError(f"索引越界: {index}")
                    raise ValueError(f"无效的列表索引: {part}")
                raise ValueError(f"无法提取字段: {part}")
        


class HttpStepExecutor(StepExecutor):
    """HTTP步骤执行器"""
    
        
        method = inputs.get("method", "GET").upper()
        url = inputs["url"]
        headers = inputs.get("headers", {})
        data = inputs.get("data")
        params = inputs.get("params")
        
            async with session.request(
                url=url,
                json=data if method in ["POST", "PUT", "PATCH"] else None,
                params=params
            ) as response:
                response_data = await response.json() if response.content_type == "application/json" else await response.text()
                
                    "status": response.status,
                    "headers": dict(response.headers),
                    "data": response_data


class DatabaseStepExecutor(StepExecutor):
    """数据库步骤执行器"""
    
        import asyncpg  # 或其他异步数据库驱动
        
        connection_name = inputs["connection"]
        query = inputs["query"]
        params = inputs.get("params", [])
        
        # 获取数据库连接配置（实际项目中应从配置管理获取）
        db_config = self._get_db_config(connection_name)
        
        conn = await asyncpg.connect(**db_config)
            if query.strip().upper().startswith("SELECT"):
                result = await conn.fetch(query, *params)
                return [dict(record) for record in result]
                result = await conn.execute(query, *params)
                return {"affected_rows": result.split()[-1]}
            await conn.close()
    
    def _get_db_config(self, connection_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """获取数据库配置（示例）"""
        # 实际项目中应从配置中心获取
            "prod-db": {
                "host": "localhost",
                "port": 5432,
                "database": "production",
                "user": "admin",
                "password": "password"
        return configs.get(connection_name, {})


class WorkflowEngine:
    """工作流引擎"""
    
        self.workflows: Dict[str, WorkflowMetadata] = {}
        self.executions: Dict[str, ExecutionContext] = {}
        self.executor_registry: Dict[StepType, Callable] = {
            StepType.HTTP: HttpStepExecutor,
            StepType.DATABASE: DatabaseStepExecutor,
            # 注册其他执行器...
        self.logger = logging.getLogger("WorkflowEngine")
    
    def register_workflow(self, workflow: WorkflowMetadata) -> str:
        """注册工作流"""
        self.workflows[workflow.id] = workflow
        self.logger.info(f"工作流注册成功: {workflow.name} (ID: {workflow.id})")
        return workflow.id
    
    def update_workflow(self, workflow_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """更新工作流"""
        if workflow_id not in self.workflows:
            self.logger.error(f"工作流不存在: {workflow_id}")
        
        workflow = self.workflows[workflow_id]
        
        # 更新元数据
        for key, value in updates.items():
            if hasattr(workflow, key):
                setattr(workflow, key, value)
        
        workflow.updated_at = datetime.now()
        self.logger.info(f"工作流更新成功: {workflow.name}")
    
    async def execute_workflow(self, workflow_id: str, parameters: Dict[str, Any] = None, 
                              initiated_by: str = "system") -> str:
        """执行工作流"""
            raise ValueError(f"工作流不存在: {workflow_id}")
        
        
        # 创建执行上下文
        context = ExecutionContext(
            workflow_id=workflow_id,
            initiated_by=initiated_by,
            parameters=parameters or {},
            status=ExecutionStatus.RUNNING,
            started_at=datetime.now(),
            variables=workflow.definition.variables.copy()
        
        self.executions[context.execution_id] = context
        self.logger.info(f"开始执行工作流: {workflow.name} (执行ID: {context.execution_id})")
        
        # 异步执行
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute_workflow_internal(context, workflow))
        
        return context.execution_id
    
    async def _execute_workflow_internal(self, context: ExecutionContext, workflow: WorkflowMetadata):
        """内部执行工作流"""
            # 执行所有步骤
            for step_def in workflow.definition.steps:
                if context.status == ExecutionStatus.CANCELLED:
                
                await self._execute_step(step_def, context)
            
            # 更新执行状态
            if context.status == ExecutionStatus.RUNNING:
                context.status = ExecutionStatus.COMPLETED
                context.completed_at = datetime.now()
                
                # 收集输出
                self._collect_outputs(context, workflow)
                
                self.logger.info(f"工作流执行完成: {workflow.name} (执行ID: {context.execution_id})")
        
            context.status = ExecutionStatus.FAILED
            context.errors.append({
            self.logger.error(f"工作流执行失败: {workflow.name}, 错误: {str(e)}")
    
    async def _execute_step(self, step_def: StepDefinition, context: ExecutionContext):
        """执行单个步骤"""
        # 获取执行器
        executor_class = self.executor_registry.get(step_def.type)
        if not executor_class:
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的操作类型: {step_def.type}")
        
        executor = executor_class(step_def, context)
        
        # 执行步骤（带重试）
        max_retries = step_def.retry_config.max_retries if step_def.retry_config else 0
        
        for attempt in range(max_retries + 1):
                result = await executor.execute()
                
                    # 成功，继续执行后续步骤
                    for next_step_id in result.get("next_steps", []):
                        # 查找并执行下一个步骤
                        next_step = self._find_step_by_id(context.workflow_id, next_step_id)
                        if next_step:
                            await self._execute_step(next_step, context)
                    # 失败，检查是否需要重试
                    if attempt < max_retries:
                        retry_delay = step_def.retry_config.get_retry_delay(attempt + 1)
                        self.logger.info(f"步骤执行失败，等待 {retry_delay} 秒后重试...")
                        await asyncio.sleep(retry_delay)
                        # 重试次数用完，标记为失败
                        raise Exception(f"步骤执行失败: {step_def.name}")
            
                    self.logger.info(f"步骤执行超时，等待重试...")
                    await asyncio.sleep(step_def.retry_config.get_retry_delay(attempt + 1))
                    context.status = ExecutionStatus.TIMEOUT
                    raise Exception(f"步骤执行超时: {step_def.name}")
    
    def _find_step_by_id(self, workflow_id: str, step_id: str) -> Optional[StepDefinition]:
        """根据ID查找步骤"""
        workflow = self.workflows.get(workflow_id)
        if not workflow:
        
        for step in workflow.definition.steps:
            if step.id == step_id:
                return step
        
    
    def _collect_outputs(self, context: ExecutionContext, workflow: WorkflowMetadata):
        """收集输出结果"""
        for output_name, output_path in workflow.definition.outputs.items():
            if output_path.startswith("$"):
                # 特殊变量
                if output_path == "$execution_id":
                    context.results[output_name] = context.execution_id
                elif output_path == "$started_at":
                    context.results[output_name] = context.started_at.isoformat()
                elif output_path == "$completed_at":
                    context.results[output_name] = context.completed_at.isoformat()
                # 从步骤结果中提取
                    value = self._resolve_variable_from_context(context, output_path)
                    context.results[output_name] = value
                    self.logger.warning(f"无法解析输出路径 {output_path}: {str(e)}")
    
    def _resolve_variable_from_context(self, context: ExecutionContext, var_path: str) -> Any:
        """从上下文中解析变量"""
        
            raise ValueError(f"无效的变量路径: {var_path}")
        
        step_id = parts[0]
        field_path = ".".join(parts[1:])
        
        if step_id not in context.step_results:
        
        step_result = context.step_results[step_id]
        return self._extract_field_from_dict(step_result, field_path)
    
    def _extract_field_from_dict(self, data: Dict[str, Any], field_path: str) -> Any:
        """从字典中提取字段"""
        
                raise ValueError(f"未找到字段: {part}")
        
    
    def get_execution_status(self, execution_id: str) -> Optional[ExecutionContext]:
        """获取执行状态"""
        return self.executions.get(execution_id)
    
    def cancel_execution(self, execution_id: str) -> bool:
        """取消执行"""
        if execution_id not in self.executions:
        
        context = self.executions[execution_id]
        if context.status in [ExecutionStatus.RUNNING, ExecutionStatus.PENDING]:
            context.status = ExecutionStatus.CANCELLED
            self.logger.info(f"执行已取消: {execution_id}")

def _workflow_to_dict(workflow: WorkflowMetadata, include_definition: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """将工作流对象转换为字典"""
    result = {
        "id": workflow.id,
        "description": workflow.description,
        "version": workflow.version,
        "tags": workflow.tags,
        "updated_at": workflow.updated_at.isoformat(),
        "created_by": workflow.created_by,
    
    if include_definition:
        result["definition"] = _workflow_definition_to_dict(workflow.definition)
    


def _workflow_definition_to_dict(definition: WorkflowDefinition) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """将工作流定义对象转换为字典"""
        "version": definition.version,
        "triggers": [
                "type": trigger.type.value,
                "config": trigger.config,
                "enabled": trigger.enabled
            for trigger in definition.triggers
        "steps": [
                "id": step.id,
                "name": step.name,
                "type": step.type.value,
                "action": step.action,
                "parameters": step.parameters,
                "inputs": step.inputs,
                "outputs": step.outputs,
                "on_success": step.on_success,
                "on_failure": step.on_failure,
                "timeout": step.timeout
            for step in definition.steps
        "outputs": definition.outputs,
        "variables": definition.variables,
        "error_handling": definition.error_handling


def _convert_to_workflow_definition(definition_dict: Dict[str, Any]) -> WorkflowDefinition:
    """将字典转换为工作流定义对象"""
    triggers = []
    for trigger_dict in definition_dict.get("triggers", []):
        triggers.append(TriggerDefinition(
            type=TriggerType(trigger_dict["type"]),
            config=trigger_dict.get("config", {}),
            enabled=trigger_dict.get("enabled", True)
    
    steps = []
    for step_dict in definition_dict.get("steps", []):
        retry_config = None
        if "retry" in step_dict:
            retry_dict = step_dict["retry"]
            retry_config = RetryConfig(
                max_retries=retry_dict.get("max_retries", 3),
                retry_delay=retry_dict.get("retry_delay", 5),
                backoff_multiplier=retry_dict.get("backoff_multiplier", 2.0),
                max_delay=retry_dict.get("max_delay", 60)
        
        steps.append(StepDefinition(
            id=step_dict["id"],
            name=step_dict["name"],
            type=StepType(step_dict["type"]),
            action=step_dict.get("action"),
            parameters=step_dict.get("parameters", {}),
            inputs=step_dict.get("inputs", {}),
            outputs=step_dict.get("outputs", {}),
            on_success=step_dict.get("on_success", []),
            on_failure=step_dict.get("on_failure", []),
            retry_config=retry_config,
            timeout=step_dict.get("timeout", 300)
    
    return WorkflowDefinition(
        version=definition_dict.get("version", "1.0"),
        triggers=triggers,
        steps=steps,
        outputs=definition_dict.get("outputs", {}),
        variables=definition_dict.get("variables", {}),
        error_handling=definition_dict.get("error_handling", {})


# ==================== 插件管理实现 ====================
class PluginManager:
    """插件管理器"""
    
        self.plugins: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.logger = logging.getLogger("PluginManager")
    
    def install_plugin(self, plugin_definition: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """安装插件"""
            plugin_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            
            # 验证插件定义
            self._validate_plugin_definition(plugin_definition)
            
            # 注册插件
            plugin_definition["id"] = plugin_id
            plugin_definition["installed_at"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
            plugin_definition["status"] = "active"
            
            self.plugins[plugin_id] = plugin_definition
            self.logger.info(f"插件安装成功: {plugin_definition.get('name')}")
            
            return plugin_id
        
            self.logger.error(f"插件安装失败: {str(e)}")
    
    def uninstall_plugin(self, plugin_id: str) -> bool:
        """卸载插件"""
        if plugin_id not in self.plugins:
        
        del self.plugins[plugin_id]
        self.logger.info(f"插件卸载成功: {plugin_id}")
    
    def get_plugin(self, plugin_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """获取插件详情"""
        return self.plugins.get(plugin_id)
    
    def list_plugins(self, page: int = 1, limit: int = 20) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """列出插件"""
        plugins_list = list(self.plugins.values())
        
        # 分页
        paginated_data = plugins_list[start:end]
        
            "data": paginated_data,
            "pagination": {
                "total": len(plugins_list),
                "pages": (len(plugins_list) + limit - 1) // limit
    
    def _validate_plugin_definition(self, plugin_definition: Dict[str, Any]):
        """验证插件定义"""
        required_fields = ["name", "version", "type"]
        
            if field not in plugin_definition:
                raise ValueError(f"插件定义缺少必需字段: {field}")
        
        valid_types = ["workflow", "connector", "transformer", "action", "trigger"]
        if plugin_definition["type"] not in valid_types:
            raise ValueError(f"无效的插件类型: {plugin_definition['type']}")


# ==================== AI增强服务实现 ====================
class AIEnhancementService:
    """AI增强服务"""
    
        self.logger = logging.getLogger("AIEnhancementService")
    
    async def enhance(self, input_data: Any, enhancement_type: str, options: Dict[str, Any] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """执行AI增强"""
            start_time = datetime.now()
            
            # 根据增强类型选择处理方式
            if enhancement_type == "summarize":
                result = await self._summarize_text(input_data, options)
            elif enhancement_type == "translate":
                result = await self._translate_text(input_data, options)
            elif enhancement_type == "classify":
                result = await self._classify_text(input_data, options)
            elif enhancement_type == "extract":
                result = await self._extract_entities(input_data, options)
            elif enhancement_type == "generate":
                result = await self._generate_text(input_data, options)
            elif enhancement_type == "analyze":
                result = await self._analyze_sentiment(input_data, options)
                raise ValueError(f"不支持的增强类型: {enhancement_type}")
            
            processing_time = (datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()
            
                "enhanced_data": result,
                "processing_time": processing_time,
                "enhancement_type": enhancement_type,
        
            self.logger.error(f"AI增强处理失败: {str(e)}")

        """文本摘要"""

                d_model=config.hidden_size,

        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            module.weight.data.normal_(mean=0.0, std=self.config.initializer_range)
            if module.bias is not None:
                module.bias.data.zero_()
        elif isinstance(module, nn.Embedding):
            if module.padding_idx is not None:
                module.weight.data[module.padding_idx].zero_()

        # 嵌入层
        embeddings = self.embedding(input_ids)
        
        # 编码器层
        hidden_states = embeddings
        for encoder_layer in self.encoder_layers:
            hidden_states = encoder_layer(hidden_states, src_key_padding_mask=~attention_mask)
        
        # 池化（取第一个token）
        pooled_output = hidden_states[:, 0]
        pooled_output = self.dropout(pooled_output)

models/custom_model/tokenization.py

    vocab_files_names = {
        "vocab_file": "vocab.json",
        "merges_file": "merges.txt"
    
    def __init__(self, vocab_file, merges_file, **kwargs):
        
        # 加载词汇表
        with open(vocab_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        
        # 加载合并规则
        with open(merges_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            self.merges = f.read().split('\n')
        
        self.ids_to_tokens = {v: k for k, v in self.vocab.items()}

    def vocab_size(self):
        return len(self.vocab)

    def _tokenize(self, text):
        # 简单的空格分词 + BPE合并
        tokens = text.split()
        # 这里实现BPE合并逻辑
        return tokens

    def _convert_token_to_id(self, token):
        return self.vocab.get(token, self.vocab.get("<unk>"))

    def _convert_id_to_token(self, index):
        return self.ids_to_tokens.get(index, "<unk>")

    def convert_tokens_to_string(self, tokens):
        return " ".join(tokens)

    def save_vocabulary(self, save_directory):
        # 保存词汇表文件
        vocab_file = f"{save_directory}/vocab.json"
        with open(vocab_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(self.vocab, f, ensure_ascii=False)
        
        merges_file = f"{save_directory}/merges.txt"
        with open(merges_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write("\n".join(self.merges))
        
        return (vocab_file, merges_file)
3. 数据处理模块
scripts/data_processor.py
from datasets import Dataset, DatasetDict

    def __init__(self, data_dir, output_dir, seed=42):
        self.data_dir = Path(data_dir)
        self.label_map = {}
        
    def detect_encoding(self, file_path):
        """自动检测文件编码"""
        with open(file_path, 'rb') as f:
            raw_data = f.read(1024 * 1024)  # 读取前1MB
        return chardet.detect(raw_data)['encoding']
    
    def load_text_files(self, directory):
        """加载目录下的所有文本文件"""
        labels = []
        
        for label_dir in directory.iterdir():
            if label_dir.is_dir():
                label_name = label_dir.name
                if label_name not in self.label_map:
                    self.label_map[label_name] = len(self.label_map)
                
                for file_path in label_dir.glob("*.txt"):
                        encoding = self.detect_encoding(file_path)
                        with open(file_path, 'r', encoding=encoding, errors='replace') as f:
                        if text:
                            labels.append(self.label_map[label_name])
                        print(f"Error reading {file_path}: {e}")
        
        return texts, labels
    
    def create_dataset(self):
        """创建完整的数据集"""
        train_texts, train_labels = self.load_text_files(self.data_dir / "train")
        val_texts, val_labels = self.load_text_files(self.data_dir / "val")
        test_texts, test_labels = self.load_text_files(self.data_dir / "test")
        
        # 如果没有验证集/测试集，自动划分
        if not val_texts and not test_texts:
            train_texts, temp_texts, train_labels, temp_labels = train_test_split(
                train_texts, train_labels, test_size=0.2, random_state=self.seed, stratify=train_labels
            val_texts, test_texts, val_labels, test_labels = train_test_split(
                temp_texts, temp_labels, test_size=0.5, random_state=self.seed, stratify=temp_labels
        
        dataset = DatasetDict({
            "train": Dataset.from_dict({"text": train_texts, "label": train_labels}),
            "validation": Dataset.from_dict({"text": val_texts, "label": val_labels}),
            "test": Dataset.from_dict({"text": test_texts, "label": test_labels})
        
    
    def save_label_map(self):
        """保存标签映射"""
        with open(self.output_dir / "label_map.json", 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(self.label_map, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    
    def get_label_map(self):
        return self.label_map

class TextCleaner:
    """文本清洗工具类"""
    
    def clean_text(text):
        """基础文本清洗"""
        
        # 移除特殊字符但保留基本标点
        text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s.,!?;:]', '', text)
        # 合并多个空格
        text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)
        # 移除首尾空格
        
    
    def normalize_text(text):
        """文本标准化"""
        text = text.lower()

class DataAugmentor:
    """数据增强工具类"""
    
    def synonym_replacement(text, n=1):
        """同义词替换"""
        # 这里可以实现同义词替换逻辑
        # 使用NLTK或同义词词典
    
    def random_deletion(text, p=0.1):
        """随机删除"""
        import random
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) == 1:
        
        new_words = []
        for word in words:
            if random.random() > p:
                new_words.append(word)
        
        if len(new_words) == 0:
            return " ".join(words[random.randint(0, len(words)-1)])
        
        return " ".join(new_words)

        """分词处理数据集"""
                examples['text'],
                max_length=self.config['max_sequence_length'],
                padding=False
        
        tokenized_dataset = self.dataset.map(
            remove_columns=['text']
        
    
    def compute_metrics(self, eval_pred):
        """计算评估指标"""
        predictions, labels = eval_pred
        predictions = np.argmax(predictions, axis=1)
        
        accuracy = accuracy_score(labels, predictions)
        precision, recall, f1, _ = precision_recall_fscore_support(
            labels, predictions, average='weighted'
        
            'accuracy': accuracy,
            'precision': precision,
            'recall': recall,
            'f1': f1
    
    def setup_training_args(self):
        """设置训练参数"""
            output_dir=str(self.output_dir),
            learning_rate=self.config['learning_rate'],
            per_device_train_batch_size=self.config['batch_size'],
            per_device_eval_batch_size=self.config['batch_size'],
            num_train_epochs=self.config['num_epochs'],
            weight_decay=self.config.get('weight_decay', 0.01),
            evaluation_strategy=self.config.get('eval_strategy', 'epoch'),
            save_strategy=self.config.get('save_strategy', 'epoch'),
            logging_dir=str(self.output_dir / "logs"),
            logging_steps=self.config.get('logging_steps', 100),
            eval_steps=self.config.get('eval_steps', 500),
            save_steps=self.config.get('save_steps', 500),
            metric_for_best_model="accuracy",
            greater_is_better=True,
            fp16=self.config.get('fp16', False) and torch.cuda.is_available(),
            dataloader_num_workers=self.config.get('num_workers', 4),
            report_to="tensorboard"
    
        print("Starting training process...")
        
        # 分词处理
        tokenized_dataset = self.tokenize_dataset()
        
        # 设置训练参数
        training_args = self.setup_training_args()
        
        # 初始化Trainer
            train_dataset=tokenized_dataset['train'],
            eval_dataset=tokenized_dataset['validation'],
            data_collator=self.data_collator,
            compute_metrics=self.compute_metrics
        
        # 开始训练
        
        # 保存最终模型
        self.tokenizer.save_pretrained(self.output_dir)
        
        # 保存训练结果
        trainer.log_metrics("train", metrics)
        trainer.save_metrics("train", metrics)
        
        # 评估测试集
        test_metrics = trainer.evaluate(tokenized_dataset['test'])
        trainer.log_metrics("test", test_metrics)
        trainer.save_metrics("test", test_metrics)
        
        print("Training completed!")
        print(f"Final model saved to: {self.output_dir}")
        
        return trainer, metrics

    config_path = project_root / "configs" / "training_args.yaml"
    
        trainer = TextClassificationTrainer(config_path)
        
        print(f"Training failed: {e}")

from typing import List, Dict, Union
    pipeline

class TextClassifier:
    def __init__(self, model_path: str, device: str = None):
        self.model_path = Path(model_path)
        self.device = device or ('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
        self.load_model()
    
            # 加载标签映射
            label_map_path = self.model_path / "label_map.json"
            with open(label_map_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                self.label_map = json.load(f)
            self.id2label = {v: k for k, v in self.label_map.items()}
            
            # 加载分词器
            self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model_path)
            
            # 加载模型
                self.model_path
            
            # 创建pipeline
            self.classifier = pipeline(
                "text-classification",
                device=0 if self.device == 'cuda' else -1
            
            print(f"Model loaded successfully from {self.model_path}")
            
    
    def predict(self, text: str, top_k: int = None) -> Dict:
        """单条文本预测"""
            results = self.classifier(text, top_k=top_k)
            
            if not isinstance(results, list):
                results = [results]
            
            predictions = []
            for result in results:
                label_id = int(result['label'].split('_')[-1])
                predictions.append({
                    'label': self.id2label.get(label_id, 'unknown'),
                    'score': round(float(result['score']), 4),
                    'label_id': label_id
            
                'text': text,
                'predictions': predictions
            
                'error': str(e),
                'predictions': []
    
    def predict_batch(self, texts: List[str], batch_size: int = 32) -> List[Dict]:
        for i in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
            batch_texts = texts[i:i + batch_size]
            batch_results = [self.predict(text) for text in batch_texts]
            results.extend(batch_results)
        
    
    def get_model_info(self) -> Dict:
        """获取模型信息"""
            'model_path': str(self.model_path),
            'num_labels': len(self.label_map),
            'labels': list(self.label_map.keys()),
            'device': self.device,
            'model_type': type(self.model).__name__

class FastAPIApp:
    """FastAPI应用包装器"""
    
    def __init__(self, classifier: TextClassifier):
        self.classifier = classifier
    
    def create_app(self):
        """创建FastAPI应用"""
        from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
        from pydantic import BaseModel
        
        app = FastAPI(title="Text Classification API", version="1.0.0")
        
        class PredictionRequest(BaseModel):
            text: str
            top_k: int = 1
        
        class BatchPredictionRequest(BaseModel):
            texts: List[str]
        
            return {"message": "Text Classification API", "status": "running"}
        
        @app.get("/info")
        async def get_info():
            return self.classifier.get_model_info()
        
        @app.post("/predict")
        async def predict(request: PredictionRequest):
                result = self.classifier.predict(request.text, request.top_k)
        
        @app.post("/predict_batch")
        async def predict_batch(request: BatchPredictionRequest):
                results = self.classifier.predict_batch(request.texts, request.batch_size)
                return {"predictions": results}
        
            return {"status": "healthy"}
        
        return app

    """使用示例"""
    model_path = "models/trained_model"
    
    # 初始化分类器
    classifier = TextClassifier(model_path)
    
    # 单条预测示例
    sample_text = "This product is absolutely amazing! I love it."
    result = classifier.predict(sample_text)
    print("Single prediction:", json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    
    # 批量预测示例
    sample_texts = [
        "This is great!",
        "I don't like this at all.",
        "It's okay, nothing special."
    batch_results = classifier.predict_batch(sample_texts)
    print("Batch predictions:", json.dumps(batch_results, indent=2))
    
    # 启动API服务（可选）

# 基于HuggingFace的文本分类全流程实战指南

## 项目简介

本项目提供了一个完整的文本分类解决方案，基于HuggingFace生态系统，支持从数据准备到模型部署的全流程。项目采用模块化设计，易于扩展和维护。

## 主要特性

- 🔧 **模块化设计**: 每个组件独立且可复用
- 🚀 **高性能训练**: 支持混合精度训练、梯度累积等优化
- 📊 **完整评估**: 提供多种评估指标和可视化
- 🌐 **生产就绪**: 支持REST API部署
- 🔄 **自定义模型**: 支持集成自定义模型架构
- 📈 **监控日志**: 集成TensorBoard训练监控

## 快速开始

- Python 3.8+
- PyTorch 1.12+
- Transformers 4.20+

#!/usr/bin/env python3
文本分类系统主入口 - Trae-AI-IDE兼容版


# 添加项目根目录到路径

from src.training.config import TrainingConfig
from src.training.trainer import ClassificationTrainer
from src.inference.predictor import TextPredictor
from src.inference.api import FastAPIApp


class TextClassificationSystem:
    """文本分类系统主类"""
    
    def __init__(self, config_path=None):
        初始化系统
        
            config_path: 配置文件路径
        self.config = None
        self.predictor = None
        self.api_app = None
        
    def initialize(self):
        """初始化系统组件"""
            # 加载配置
            if self.config_path:
                self.config = TrainingConfig.from_yaml(self.config_path)
                self.config = TrainingConfig.default()
            
            logger.info(f"系统初始化完成 - 配置文件: {self.config_path or '默认配置'}")
            logger.info(f"模型: {self.config.model_name}")
            logger.info(f"数据目录: {self.config.data_dir}")
            logger.info(f"输出目录: {self.config.output_dir}")
            
            
            logger.error(f"系统初始化失败: {e}")
    
    def train(self, data_path=None):
        
            data_path: 训练数据路径
            if data_path:
                self.config.data_dir = data_path
            
            self.trainer = ClassificationTrainer(self.config)
            
            logger.info("开始模型训练...")
            metrics = self.trainer.train()
            
            logger.info("训练完成!")
            logger.info(f"训练指标: {metrics}")
            
            
            logger.error(f"训练失败: {e}")
    
    def evaluate(self, data_path=None):
        评估模型
        
            data_path: 评估数据路径
            
            logger.info("开始模型评估...")
            metrics = self.trainer.evaluate(data_path)
            
            logger.info(f"评估结果: {metrics}")
            
            logger.error(f"评估失败: {e}")
    
    def predict(self, texts, model_path=None):
        预测文本
        
            texts: 文本列表或单个文本
            model_path: 模型路径
            
            预测结果
            if not self.predictor:
                self.predictor = TextPredictor(
                    model_path or self.config.output_dir
            
            results = self.predictor.predict(texts)
            
            logger.error(f"预测失败: {e}")
    
    def serve_api(self, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000):
        
            host: 主机地址
            port: 端口号
            if not self.api_app:
                self.api_app = FastAPIApp(
                    model_path=self.config.output_dir,
                    port=port
            
            logger.info(f"启动API服务: http://{host}:{port}")
            self.api_app.serve()
            
            logger.error(f"API服务启动失败: {e}")
    
    def export_model(self, format="onnx", output_path=None):
        导出模型
        
            format: 导出格式 (onnx, torchscript, savedmodel)
            output_path: 输出路径
