class WorkflowModule {
  
  /**
   * 创建工作流
   */
  async create(params, options = {}) {
      description = '', 
      triggers = [], 
      variables = {} 
    
    if (!name || !steps || !Array.isArray(steps) || steps.length === 0) {
      throw new PluginError('MISSING_PARAMETER', '缺少必要参数: name 或 steps');
    
    // 验证步骤
    const validatedSteps = this.validateSteps(steps);
    
    const response = await this.plugin.request('/api/v2/workflows/create', 'POST', {
      steps: validatedSteps,
      triggers,
      variables
    
      return this.enhanceWorkflowCreation(response.data, validatedSteps);
    
  
  /**
   * 执行工作流
   */
  async execute(params, options = {}) {
      inputData = {}, 
      executeMode = 'sync' 
    
    if (!workflowId) {
      throw new PluginError('MISSING_PARAMETER', '缺少必要参数: workflowId');
    
    const response = await this.plugin.request('/api/v2/workflows/execute', 'POST', {
      inputData,
      executeMode
    
      return this.enhanceWorkflowExecution(response.data);
    
  
  /**
   * 获取工作流状态
   */
  async getStatus(params, options = {}) {
    const { workflowId } = params;
    
    
    const response = await this.plugin.request(`/api/v2/workflows/${workflowId}/status`, 'GET', null, options);
    
      return this.enhanceWorkflowStatus(response.data);
    
  
  // 内部方法
  validateSteps(steps) {
    return steps.map((step, index) => {
      if (!step.name || !step.action) {
        throw new PluginError('INVALID_STEP', `步骤 ${index + 1} 缺少 name 或 action`);
      
      // 添加默认值
        ...step,
        id: step.id || `step_${index + 1}`,
        timeout: step.timeout || 30000,
        retry: step.retry || { attempts: 3, delay: 1000 }
  
  enhanceWorkflowCreation(data, steps) {
    // 添加工作流分析
    if (data.workflowId) {
      data.analysis = {
        complexity: this.assessWorkflowComplexity(steps),
        estimatedDuration: this.estimateWorkflowDuration(steps),
        resourceRequirements: this.calculateResourceRequirements(steps),
        optimizationSuggestions: this.generateOptimizationSuggestions(steps)
    
  
  assessWorkflowComplexity(steps) {
    const stepCount = steps.length;
    const conditionCount = steps.reduce((count, step) => {
      return count + (step.conditions ? step.conditions.length : 0);
    }, 0);
    
    const complexityScore = stepCount * 0.5 + conditionCount * 0.3;
    
    if (complexityScore < 3) return '简单';
    if (complexityScore < 7) return '中等';
    if (complexityScore < 12) return '复杂';
    return '非常复杂';
  
  estimateWorkflowDuration(steps) {
    // 简单估算：每个步骤约2-5秒
    const baseTime = steps.length * 3000; // 3秒/步骤
    const conditionTime = steps.reduce((time, step) => {
      return time + (step.conditions ? step.conditions.length * 1000 : 0);
    
    return baseTime + conditionTime;
  
  calculateResourceRequirements(steps) {
    const requirements = {
      memory: 'low',
      cpu: 'low',
      network: 'low',
      storage: 'low'
    
    // 分析步骤类型来估算资源需求
    steps.forEach(step => {
      if (step.action.includes('process') || step.action.includes('analyze')) {
        requirements.memory = 'medium';
        requirements.cpu = 'medium';
      
      if (step.action.includes('download') || step.action.includes('upload')) {
        requirements.network = 'high';
      
      if (step.action.includes('store') || step.action.includes('save')) {
        requirements.storage = 'medium';
    
    return requirements;
  
  generateOptimizationSuggestions(steps) {
    const suggestions = [];
    
    // 检查是否有可以合并的步骤
    const similarSteps = this.findSimilarSteps(steps);
    if (similarSteps.length > 1) {
      suggestions.push(`考虑合并步骤: ${similarSteps.map(s => s.name).join(', ')}`);
    
    // 检查是否有循环依赖
    const dependencies = this.checkDependencies(steps);
    if (dependencies.hasCircular) {
      suggestions.push('检测到循环依赖，请检查步骤顺序');
    
    // 建议添加错误处理
    const stepsWithoutErrorHandling = steps.filter(step => !step.onError);
    if (stepsWithoutErrorHandling.length > 0) {
      suggestions.push(`为步骤添加错误处理: ${stepsWithoutErrorHandling.map(s => s.name).join(', ')}`);
    
    return suggestions;
  
  findSimilarSteps(steps) {
    // 简单的相似度检测
    const groups = {};
    
      const key = step.action.split('_')[0]; // 按动作前缀分组
      if (!groups[key]) {
        groups[key] = [];
      groups[key].push(step);
    
    // 返回可能有重复的组
    return Object.values(groups).find(group => group.length > 1) || [];
  
  checkDependencies(steps) {
    // 简单的依赖检查
    const dependencies = new Map();
    let hasCircular = false;
    
    steps.forEach((step, index) => {
      if (step.dependsOn) {
        dependencies.set(step.id, step.dependsOn);
        
        // 检查循环依赖
        if (this.hasCircularDependency(step.id, step.dependsOn, dependencies)) {
          hasCircular = true;
    
    return { dependencies: Object.fromEntries(dependencies), hasCircular };
  
  hasCircularDependency(current, dependsOn, dependencies) {
    const visited = new Set();
    let toCheck = [dependsOn];
    
    while (toCheck.length > 0) {
      const next = toCheck.pop();
      
      if (next === current) {
        return true;
      
      if (visited.has(next)) {
      
      visited.add(next);
      
      const nextDependsOn = dependencies.get(next);
      if (nextDependsOn) {
        toCheck.push(nextDependsOn);
    
    return false;
  
  enhanceWorkflowExecution(data) {
    // 添加执行分析
    if (data.executionId) {
      data.executionAnalysis = {
        progress: this.calculateProgress(data.status),
        bottlenecks: this.identifyBottlenecks(data),
        nextSteps: this.suggestNextSteps(data.status),
        monitoringRecommendations: this.getMonitoringRecommendations(data)
    
  
  calculateProgress(status) {
    const statusMap = {
      'pending': 0,
      'running': 50,
      'completed': 100,
      'paused': 25
    
    return statusMap[status] || 0;
  
  identifyBottlenecks(data) {
    const bottlenecks = [];
    
    if (data.estimatedCompletion) {
      const now = new Date();
      const completion = new Date(data.estimatedCompletion);
      const delay = completion - now;
      
      if (delay > 300000) { // 5分钟
        bottlenecks.push('执行时间过长，考虑优化工作流');
    
    return bottlenecks;
  
  suggestNextSteps(status) {
    
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed':
        suggestions.push('分析执行结果');
        suggestions.push('清理临时文件');
        suggestions.push('生成报告');
      case 'failed':
        suggestions.push('检查错误日志');
        suggestions.push('修复工作流配置');
        suggestions.push('重新执行或调试');
      case 'running':
        suggestions.push('监控执行进度');
        suggestions.push('检查资源使用情况');
        suggestions.push('准备下一步处理');
    
  
  getMonitoringRecommendations(data) {
    
    if (data.status === 'running') {
      recommendations.push('设置执行超时监控');
      recommendations.push('配置异常告警');
      recommendations.push('记录详细执行日志');
    
  
  enhanceWorkflowStatus(data) {
    // 添加状态分析
      data.statusAnalysis = {
        health: this.assessWorkflowHealth(data),
        performance: this.assessWorkflowPerformance(data),
        maintenance: this.getMaintenanceRecommendations(data),
        scaling: this.getScalingRecommendations(data)
    
  
  assessWorkflowHealth(data) {
    const { status, executionCount = 0, lastExecution } = data;
    
    if (status === 'active' && executionCount > 0) {
      if (lastExecution && lastExecution.status === 'failed') {
        return lastExecution.failureRate > 0.3 ? 'unhealthy' : 'degraded';
      return 'healthy';
    
    if (status === 'inactive' && executionCount === 0) {
      return 'untested';
    
  
  assessWorkflowPerformance(data) {
    const { lastExecution } = data;
    
    if (!lastExecution || !lastExecution.duration) {
      return { level: 'unknown', metrics: {} };
    
    const duration = lastExecution.duration;
    let level = 'good';
    
    if (duration > 60000) level = 'slow';
    if (duration > 300000) level = 'very_slow';
    
      level,
        duration,
        efficiency: duration > 0 ? Math.round(10000 / duration) : 0
  
  getMaintenanceRecommendations(data) {
    const { executionCount = 0, lastExecution } = data;
    
    if (executionCount > 100) {
      recommendations.push('考虑清理历史执行记录');
    
      recommendations.push('检查并修复失败原因');
    
    if (executionCount === 0) {
      recommendations.push('建议进行测试运行');
    
  
  getScalingRecommendations(data) {
    const { executionCount = 0 } = data;
    
    if (executionCount > 1000) {
      recommendations.push('考虑负载均衡部署');
      recommendations.push('实现工作流队列管理');
      recommendations.push('优化数据库索引');
    } else if (executionCount > 100) {
      recommendations.push('增加并发处理能力');
      recommendations.push('优化缓存策略');
    

/**
 * AI分析模块
 */
class AIModule {
  
  /**
   * AI分析
   */
    const { data, analysisType = 'nlp', model = 'default' } = params;
    
    if (!data) {
      throw new PluginError('MISSING_PARAMETER', '缺少必要参数: data');
    
    const response = await this.plugin.request('/api/v2/ai/analyze', 'POST', {
      analysisType,
      model
    
      return this.enhanceAIAnalysis(response.data);
    
  
  /**
   * AI预测
   */
  async predict(params, options = {}) {
      historicalData, 
      predictionType = 'trend', 
      timeHorizon = 'short_term' 
    
    if (!historicalData || !Array.isArray(historicalData) || historicalData.length === 0) {
      throw new PluginError('MISSING_PARAMETER', '缺少必要参数: historicalData');
    
    const response = await this.plugin.request('/api/v2/ai/predict', 'POST', {
      predictionType,
      timeHorizon
    
      return this.enhanceAIPrediction(response.data);
    
  
  // 内部增强方法
  enhanceAIAnalysis(data) {
    // 添加分析增强
    if (data.results) {
      data.enhancedResults = {
        ...data.results,
        interpretation: this.interpretAnalysisResults(data.results),
        actionableInsights: this.extractActionableInsights(data.results),
        confidenceAssessment: this.assessConfidence(data.confidence),
        limitations: this.identifyLimitations(data.results, data.analysisType)
    
  
  interpretAnalysisResults(results) {
    const interpretations = [];
    
    if (results.sentiment) {
      const sentiment = results.sentiment;
      if (sentiment.score > 0.7) {
        interpretations.push('整体情绪非常积极');
      } else if (sentiment.score > 0.3) {
        interpretations.push('整体情绪偏向积极');
      } else if (sentiment.score < -0.3) {
        interpretations.push('整体情绪偏向消极');
      } else if (sentiment.score < -0.7) {
        interpretations.push('整体情绪非常消极');
        interpretations.push('整体情绪中性');
    
    if (results.entities && results.entities.length > 0) {
      interpretations.push(`识别到 ${results.entities.length} 个关键实体`);
    
    if (results.keywords && results.keywords.length > 0) {
      interpretations.push(`提取了 ${results.keywords.length} 个关键词`);
    
    return interpretations;
  
  extractActionableInsights(results) {
    const insights = [];
    
    if (results.sentiment && results.sentiment.score < 0) {
      insights.push('检测到负面情绪，建议进一步调查原因');
    
    if (results.entities && results.entities.some(e => e.type === 'PROBLEM')) {
      insights.push('识别到问题实体，建议制定解决方案');
    
    if (results.keywords && results.keywords.length > 10) {
      insights.push('内容涉及多个主题，建议分类整理');
    
    return insights;
  
  assessConfidence(confidence) {
    if (confidence > 0.9) return '非常高';
    if (confidence > 0.7) return '高';
    if (confidence > 0.5) return '中等';
    return '低';
  
  identifyLimitations(results, analysisType) {
    const limitations = [];
    
    if (analysisType === 'nlp') {
      if (!results.sentiment) {
        limitations.push('情感分析可能不适用于所有文本类型');
      
      if (!results.entities || results.entities.length === 0) {
        limitations.push('实体识别可能受限于专业术语');
    
    if (analysisType === 'cv') {
      limitations.push('图像识别准确度受图片质量影响');
      limitations.push('可能存在误识别情况');
    
    return limitations;
  
  enhanceAIPrediction(data) {
    // 添加预测增强
    if (data.predictions && Array.isArray(data.predictions)) {
      data.enhancedPredictions = {
        predictions: data.predictions,
        trendAnalysis: this.analyzeTrends(data.predictions),
        riskAssessment: this.assessPredictionRisks(data.predictions, data.confidenceScores),
        scenarioPlanning: this.generateScenarios(data.predictions),
        monitoringRecommendations: this.getPredictionMonitoringRecommendations(data)
    
  
  analyzeTrends(predictions) {
    if (predictions.length < 2) {
      return { trend: 'stable', magnitude: 0 };
    
    const firstValue = predictions[0].value || 0;
    const lastValue = predictions[predictions.length - 1].value || 0;
    const change = lastValue - firstValue;
    const percentageChange = firstValue !== 0 ? (change / firstValue) * 100 : 0;
    
    let trend = 'stable';
    if (percentageChange > 10) trend = '上升';
    if (percentageChange < -10) trend = '下降';
    
      trend,
      magnitude: Math.abs(percentageChange),
      direction: change > 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative',
      confidence: Math.min(100, Math.abs(percentageChange) * 0.8)
  
  assessPredictionRisks(predictions, confidenceScores) {
    const risks = [];
    
    if (confidenceScores && confidenceScores.length > 0) {
      const avgConfidence = confidenceScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / confidenceScores.length;
      
      if (avgConfidence < 0.6) {
        risks.push({
          type: '低置信度',
          level: '高',
          mitigation: '收集更多数据或调整模型参数'
    
    // 检查预测值的波动性
    if (predictions.length > 3) {
      const values = predictions.map(p => p.value || 0);
      const volatility = this.calculateVolatility(values);
      
      if (volatility > 20) {
          type: '高波动性',
          level: '中',
          mitigation: '考虑使用平滑算法或增加时间窗口'
    
    return risks;
  
  calculateVolatility(values) {
    const mean = values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length;
    const squaredDiffs = values.map(v => Math.pow(v - mean, 2));
    const variance = squaredDiffs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length;
    return Math.sqrt(variance);
  
  generateScenarios(predictions) {
    const scenarios = [];
    
    if (predictions.length > 0) {
      const lastPrediction = predictions[predictions.length - 1];
      const baseValue = lastPrediction.value || 0;
      
      scenarios.push({
        name: '乐观情景',
        description: '假设最佳条件',
        values: predictions.map(p => ({
          ...p,
          value: (p.value || 0) * 1.2 // 增加20%
        }))
      
        name: '基准情景',
        description: '基于当前趋势',
        values: predictions
      
        name: '悲观情景',
        description: '假设最差条件',
          value: (p.value || 0) * 0.8 // 减少20%
    
    return scenarios;
  
  getPredictionMonitoringRecommendations(data) {
    
    if (data.confidenceScores && data.confidenceScores.some(c => c < 0.5)) {
      recommendations.push('监控低置信度预测的实际表现');
      recommendations.push('设置预测偏差告警阈值');
    
    if (data.predictions && data.predictions.length > 10) {
      recommendations.push('定期重新训练预测模型');
      recommendations.push('对比预测值与实际值的差异');
    

/**
 * 系统管理模块
 */
class SystemModule {
  
  /**
   * 健康检查
   */
  async healthCheck(params = {}, options = {}) {
    const response = await this.plugin.request('/api/v2/system/health', 'GET', null, options);
    
      return this.enhanceHealthCheck(response.data);
    
  
  /**
   * 获取系统配置
   */
  async getConfig(params = {}, options = {}) {
    const response = await this.plugin.request('/api/v2/system/config', 'GET', null, options);
    
      return this.enhanceSystemConfig(response.data);
    
  
  // 内部增强方法
  enhanceHealthCheck(data) {
    // 添加健康检查增强
    if (data.services) {
      data.enhancedHealth = {
        overallStatus: data.status,
        serviceDetails: this.analyzeServiceHealth(data.services),
        recommendations: this.generateHealthRecommendations(data),
        capacityPlanning: this.suggestCapacityPlanning(data)
    
  
  analyzeServiceHealth(services) {
    const details = {};
    
    for (const [serviceName, serviceInfo] of Object.entries(services)) {
      details[serviceName] = {
        status: serviceInfo.status,
        responseTime: serviceInfo.responseTime,
        performance: this.assessServicePerformance(serviceInfo.responseTime),
        dependencies: this.identifyServiceDependencies(serviceName)
    
    return details;
  
  assessServicePerformance(responseTime) {
    if (responseTime < 100) return '优秀';
    if (responseTime < 500) return '良好';
    if (responseTime < 1000) return '一般';
    return '需优化';
  
  identifyServiceDependencies(serviceName) {
    // 简单的依赖映射
    const dependencies = {
      'content-service': ['database', 'cache'],
      'file-service': ['storage', 'database'],
      'workflow-service': ['message-queue', 'database'],
      'ai-service': ['ml-engine', 'cache']
    
    return dependencies[serviceName] || [];
  
  generateHealthRecommendations(data) {
    
    if (data.status === 'degraded') {
      recommendations.push('检查服务负载和资源使用情况');
      recommendations.push('查看错误日志定位问题');
    
      const slowServices = Object.entries(data.services)
        .filter(([_, info]) => info.responseTime > 1000)
        .map(([name, _]) => name);
      
      if (slowServices.length > 0) {
        recommendations.push(`优化慢速服务: ${slowServices.join(', ')}`);
    
  
  suggestCapacityPlanning(data) {
    
      const totalServices = Object.keys(data.services).length;
      const unhealthyServices = Object.values(data.services).filter(s => s.status !== 'healthy').length;
      
      if (unhealthyServices > totalServices * 0.3) {
        suggestions.push('考虑扩容或负载均衡');
    
  
  enhanceSystemConfig(data) {
    // 添加系统配置增强
    if (data.version && data.features) {
      data.enhancedConfig = {
        versionInfo: {
          current: data.version,
          upgradeAvailable: this.checkForUpgrades(data.version),
          compatibility: this.checkCompatibility(data.version)
        featureAnalysis: this.analyzeFeatures(data.features),
        limitOptimization: this.suggestLimitOptimizations(data.limits),
        securityAssessment: this.assessSecurityConfig(data)
    
  
  checkForUpgrades(currentVersion) {
    // 简单的版本检查逻辑
    const latestVersion = '2.1.0';
    const [currentMajor, currentMinor] = currentVersion.split('.').map(Number);
    const [latestMajor, latestMinor] = latestVersion.split('.').map(Number);
    
    if (latestMajor > currentMajor) return '主要版本升级可用';
    if (latestMinor > currentMinor) return '次要版本升级可用';
    return '已是最新版本';
  
  checkCompatibility(version) {
    // 检查与Coze平台的兼容性
    const [major, minor] = version.split('.').map(Number);
    
    if (major >= 2 && minor >= 0) {
        coze: '完全兼容',
        openapi: '3.0.0+',
        notes: '支持所有Coze插件功能'
    
      coze: '部分兼容',
      openapi: '需要升级',
      notes: '建议升级到2.0.0+版本'
  
  analyzeFeatures(features) {
    const analysis = {
      enabledCount: features.length,
      categories: {},
      recommendations: []
    
    // 分类功能
    features.forEach(feature => {
      if (feature.includes('content')) {
        analysis.categories.content = (analysis.categories.content || 0) + 1;
      } else if (feature.includes('file')) {
        analysis.categories.file = (analysis.categories.file || 0) + 1;
      } else if (feature.includes('workflow')) {
        analysis.categories.workflow = (analysis.categories.workflow || 0) + 1;
      } else if (feature.includes('ai')) {
        analysis.categories.ai = (analysis.categories.ai || 0) + 1;
    
    // 生成建议
    if (!features.includes('batch_processing') && analysis.categories.file > 0) {
      analysis.recommendations.push('考虑启用批量文件处理功能');
    
    if (!features.includes('real_time_monitoring') && analysis.categories.workflow > 0) {
      analysis.recommendations.push('考虑启用实时监控功能');
    
    return analysis;
  
  suggestLimitOptimizations(limits) {
    
    if (limits) {
      if (limits.max_file_size < 52428800) { // 50MB
        suggestions.push('考虑增加最大文件大小限制');
      
      if (limits.max_concurrent_requests < 50) {
        suggestions.push('考虑增加并发请求限制');
      
      if (limits.rate_limit_per_minute < 500) {
        suggestions.push('考虑调整速率限制');
    
  
  assessSecurityConfig(data) {
    const assessment = {
      level: '中等',
    
    if (data.settings) {
      if (!data.settings.encryption_enabled) {
        assessment.recommendations.push('启用数据传输加密');
        assessment.level = '低';
      
      if (!data.settings.audit_logging) {
        assessment.recommendations.push('启用审计日志');
    
    if (data.limits && data.limits.rate_limit_per_minute > 1000) {
      assessment.recommendations.push('考虑加强速率限制策略');
    
    return assessment;

class PluginError extends Error {
  constructor(code, message, details = null) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'PluginError';
    this.code = code;
    this.details = details;
    this.timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
  
  toJSON() {
      error: {
        code: this.code,
        message: this.message,
        details: this.details
      timestamp: this.timestamp

/**
 * 验证插件配置
 */
function validatePluginConfig(config) {
  const defaultConfig = {
    baseURL: 'https://api.intelligent-automation.com/v2',
    timeout: 30000,
    autoProcess: true
  
  const validated = { ...defaultConfig, ...config };
  
  // 验证URL格式
    new URL(validated.baseURL);
    throw new PluginError('INVALID_CONFIG', `无效的baseURL: ${validated.baseURL}`);
  
  // 验证超时时间
  if (typeof validated.timeout !== 'number' || validated.timeout <= 0) {
    throw new PluginError('INVALID_CONFIG', 'timeout必须是正数');
  
  return validated;

/**
 * 验证插件实例
 */
function validatePluginInstance(plugin) {
  const checks = {
    baseURL: plugin.baseURL && typeof plugin.baseURL === 'string',
    modules: plugin.modules && typeof plugin.modules === 'object',
    requestMethod: typeof plugin.request === 'function',
    invokeMethod: typeof plugin.invoke === 'function'
  
  const failedChecks = Object.entries(checks)
    .filter(([_, passed]) => !passed)
    .map(([check, _]) => check);
  
  if (failedChecks.length > 0) {
      errors: failedChecks.map(check => `检查失败: ${check}`)
  
    capabilities: Object.keys(plugin.modules)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
Coze平台自动化工具套件 - 完整解决方案
功能: 
1. Coze JSON修复器 - 修复各种JSON格式错误和结构问题
2. MCP服务器自动化创建器 - 交互式创建标准MCP服务器
3. 工作流修复工具 - 修复工作流节点和连接关系
4. 批量处理工具 - 批量修复多个文件
5. 配置管理 - YAML配置文件支持

from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional, Tuple


class CozeJSONRepairTool:
    """Coze JSON修复工具 - 完整实现"""
    
        self.repair_history = []
        self.error_patterns = [
            (r'(\w+):', r'"\1":'),  # 修复缺少引号的属性名
            (r"'([^']*)'", r'"\1"'),  # 修复单引号为双引号
            (r',\s*}', '}'),  # 修复尾随逗号
            (r',\s*]', ']'),  # 修复数组尾随逗号
            (r'//.*$', ''),  # 移除单行注释
            (r'/\*.*?\*/', '', re.DOTALL),  # 移除多行注释
    
    def fix_json_syntax(self, broken_json: str) -> Tuple[str, List[str]]:
        """修复基本的JSON语法错误"""
        repair_log = []
        fixed = broken_json
        
        for pattern, replacement in self.error_patterns:
            flags = 0
            if len(pattern) == 3:  # 包含flags的情况
                pattern, replacement, flags = pattern[0], pattern[1], pattern[2]
            
            original = fixed
            fixed = re.sub(pattern, replacement, fixed, flags=flags)
            if original != fixed:
                repair_log.append(f"应用模式修复: {pattern} -> {replacement}")
        
            # 验证修复结果
            json.loads(fixed)
            repair_log.append("JSON语法验证通过")
            return fixed, repair_log
            repair_log.append(f"JSON语法验证失败: {str(e)}")
    
    def fix_coze_specific_issues(self, json_data: Dict) -> Tuple[Dict, List[str]]:
        """修复Coze平台特定的问题"""
        fixed_data = json_data.copy()
        
        # 确保必需字段存在
        required_fields = ['name', 'version', 'nodes']
            if field not in fixed_data:
                if field == 'name':
                    fixed_data[field] = 'Repaired_Coze_Project'
                elif field == 'version':
                    fixed_data[field] = '1.0.0'
                elif field == 'nodes':
                    fixed_data[field] = []
                repair_log.append(f"添加缺失字段: {field}")
        
        # 修复节点结构
        node_repairs = 0
        for node in fixed_data.get('nodes', []):
            repairs = self._repair_single_node(node)
            if repairs:
                node_repairs += 1
                repair_log.extend(repairs)
        
        if node_repairs:
            repair_log.append(f"修复了 {node_repairs} 个节点")
        
        # 修复连接关系
        connection_repairs = self._repair_connections(fixed_data)
        repair_log.extend(connection_repairs)
        
        return fixed_data, repair_log
    
    def _repair_single_node(self, node: Dict) -> List[str]:
        """修复单个节点"""
        repairs = []
        
        if 'id' not in node:
            node['id'] = f"node_{len(str(id(node)))}"
            repairs.append(f"节点添加ID: {node['id']}")
        
        if 'type' not in node:
            node['type'] = 'default'
            repairs.append(f"节点 {node['id']} 添加类型: default")
        
        if 'position' not in node:
            node['position'] = {'x': 0, 'y': 0}
            repairs.append(f"节点 {node['id']} 添加默认位置")
        
        if 'data' not in node:
            node['data'] = {}
            repairs.append(f"节点 {node['id']} 添加数据字段")
        
        return repairs
    
    def _repair_connections(self, data: Dict) -> List[str]:
        """修复连接关系"""
        
        if 'connections' not in data:
            data['connections'] = []
            repairs.append("添加连接字段")
        
        node_ids = {node['id'] for node in data.get('nodes', [])}
        valid_connections = []
        
        for conn in data.get('connections', []):
            if 'id' not in conn:
                conn['id'] = f"conn_{len(valid_connections)}"
                repairs.append(f"连接添加ID: {conn['id']}")
            
            source_valid = 'source' in conn and conn['source'] in node_ids
            target_valid = 'target' in conn and conn['target'] in node_ids
            
            if source_valid and target_valid:
                valid_connections.append(conn)
                repairs.append(f"移除无效连接: {conn.get('id', 'unknown')}")
        
        data['connections'] = valid_connections
        repairs.append(f"验证后保留 {len(valid_connections)} 个连接")
        
    
    def process_input(self, input_data: str) -> Tuple[str, List[str]]:
        """处理输入数据并返回修复后的JSON和修复日志"""
        
        # 步骤1: 修复基础JSON语法
        syntax_fixed, syntax_log = self.fix_json_syntax(input_data)
        self.repair_history.extend(syntax_log)
        
        # 步骤2: 解析JSON
            if syntax_fixed.strip().startswith('{'):
                json_data = json.loads(syntax_fixed)
                return syntax_fixed, self.repair_history
            self.repair_history.append(f"JSON解析错误: {str(e)}")
        
        # 步骤3: 修复Coze特定问题
        final_data, coze_log = self.fix_coze_specific_issues(json_data)
        self.repair_history.extend(coze_log)
        
        # 步骤4: 返回格式化结果
        result = json.dumps(final_data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        self.repair_history.append("JSON修复完成")
        
        return result, self.repair_history

```typescript
    requirement: JSON.stringify(input),

// ========== Coze插件修复引擎 ==========

class CozePluginRepairEngine {
  repairMode: string;
  outputFormat: string;
  conflictResolution: string;
  processedCount: number;
  errorCount: number;
  warningCount: number;

  constructor(options: any = {}) {
    this.repairMode = options.repairMode || 'comprehensive';
    this.outputFormat = options.outputFormat || 'coze_import_ready';
    this.conflictResolution = options.conflictResolution || 'rename';
    this.processedCount = 0;
    this.errorCount = 0;
    this.warningCount = 0;

  async processMultiplePlugins(pluginInputs: any[]): Promise<any> {
    const results = {
      valid_plugins: [] as any[],
      repaired_plugins: [] as any[],
      errors: [] as any[],
      warnings: [] as any[]

    for (const input of pluginInputs) {
        const pluginResult = await this.repairSinglePlugin(input);
        
        if (pluginResult.success) {
          results.valid_plugins.push(pluginResult.plugin);
          if (pluginResult.repaired) {
            results.repaired_plugins.push(pluginResult.plugin);
          results.errors.push({
            error: pluginResult.error
          this.errorCount++;

        results.warnings.push(...(pluginResult.warnings || []));
        this.warningCount += pluginResult.warnings?.length || 0;
        this.processedCount++;


    const mergedResult = this.mergePlugins(results.valid_plugins);
    
      ...mergedResult,
        processed_count: this.processedCount,
        valid_count: results.valid_plugins.length,
        repaired_count: results.repaired_plugins.length,
        error_count: this.errorCount,
        warning_count: this.warningCount,
        processing_time_ms: Date.now() - startTime
        errors: results.errors,
        warnings: results.warnings

  async repairSinglePlugin(pluginInput: any): Promise<any> {
      const normalizedInput = this.normalizeInput(pluginInput);
      const syntaxFixed = this.fixSyntaxErrors(normalizedInput);
      const structureFixed = this.fixStructureErrors(syntaxFixed);
      const semanticFixed = await this.fixSemanticErrors(structureFixed);
      const cozeCompatible = this.ensureCozeCompatibility(semanticFixed);
      const validation = this.validatePlugin(cozeCompatible);
      
        success: validation.isValid,
        plugin: cozeCompatible,
        repaired: true,
        warnings: validation.warnings,
        validation_result: validation

        repaired: false

  normalizeInput(input: any): any {
        return JSON.parse(input);
        const fixedJson = this.fixJsonString(input);
        return JSON.parse(fixedJson);
    return input;

  fixJsonString(jsonStr: string): string {
    let fixed = jsonStr
      .replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '')
      .replace(/\/\/.*$/gm, '')
      .replace(/([{,]\s*)([a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*)(\s*:)/g, '$1"$2"$3')
      .replace(/'/g, '"')
      .replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, '$1')
      .replace(/([}\]"])\s*([{["])/g, '$1,$2');

      JSON.parse(fixed);
      return this.aggressiveJsonRepair(fixed);

  aggressiveJsonRepair(jsonStr: string): string {
    const jsonObjects: string[] = [];
    let depth = 0;
    let start = -1;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < jsonStr.length; i++) {
      if (jsonStr[i] === '{') {
        if (depth === 0) start = i;
        depth++;
      } else if (jsonStr[i] === '}') {
        depth--;
        if (depth === 0 && start !== -1) {
          const candidate = jsonStr.substring(start, i + 1);
            JSON.parse(candidate);
            jsonObjects.push(candidate);
            // 忽略无效的候选
          start = -1;
    
    if (jsonObjects.length > 0) {
      return jsonObjects.reduce((a, b) => a.length > b.length ? a : b);
    
    return '{"name": "repaired_plugin", "version": "1.0.0", "description": "自动修复的Coze插件", "nodes": [], "edges": []}';

  fixSyntaxErrors(plugin: any): any {
    const fixed = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(plugin));
    
    if (!fixed.name) fixed.name = `repaired_plugin_${Date.now()}`;
    if (!fixed.version) fixed.version = "1.0.0";
    if (!fixed.description) fixed.description = "自动修复的Coze插件";
    
    if (!Array.isArray(fixed.nodes)) fixed.nodes = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(fixed.edges)) fixed.edges = [];
    
    fixed.nodes = this.fixDuplicateNodeIds(fixed.nodes);
    

  fixDuplicateNodeIds(nodes: any[]): any[] {
    const idMap = new Map();
    
    return nodes.map(node => {
      const newNode = { ...node };
      
      if (!newNode.id) {
        newNode.id = `node_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
        return newNode;
      
      if (idMap.has(newNode.id)) {
        const count = idMap.get(newNode.id) + 1;
        idMap.set(newNode.id, count);
        newNode.id = `${newNode.id}_${count}`;
        idMap.set(newNode.id, 1);
      

  fixStructureErrors(plugin: any): any {
    
    fixed.nodes = fixed.nodes.map((node: any) => this.normalizeNode(node));
    fixed.edges = fixed.edges.map((edge: any) => this.normalizeEdge(edge));
    
    const nodeIds = new Set(fixed.nodes.map((node: any) => node.id));
    fixed.edges = fixed.edges.filter((edge: any) => {
      const sourceExists = nodeIds.has(edge.source);
      const targetExists = nodeIds.has(edge.target);
      return sourceExists && targetExists;
    

  normalizeNode(node: any): any {
    const normalized = {
      id: node.id || `node_${Date.now()}`,
      type: node.type || 'function',
      name: node.name || '未命名节点',
      ...node
    
    if (!normalized.config) normalized.config = {};
    if (!normalized.inputs) normalized.inputs = {};
    if (!normalized.outputs) normalized.outputs = {};
    
    return normalized;

  normalizeEdge(edge: any): any {
      source: edge.source,
      target: edge.target,
      sourceHandle: edge.sourceHandle || 'output',
      targetHandle: edge.targetHandle || 'input',
      ...edge

  async fixSemanticErrors(plugin: any): Promise<any> {
    let fixed = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(plugin));
    
    fixed.nodes = fixed.nodes.map((node: any) => this.fixNodeDataTypes(node));
    fixed.edges = this.detectAndFixCircularDependencies(fixed.nodes, fixed.edges);
    fixed = this.fixOrphanedNodes(fixed);
    

  fixNodeDataTypes(node: any): any {
    const fixedNode = { ...node };
    
    if (fixedNode.config && typeof fixedNode.config !== 'object') {
      fixedNode.config = {};
    
    if (fixedNode.inputs && typeof fixedNode.inputs !== 'object') {
      fixedNode.inputs = {};
    
    if (fixedNode.outputs && typeof fixedNode.outputs !== 'object') {
      fixedNode.outputs = {};
    
    return fixedNode;

  detectAndFixCircularDependencies(nodes: any[], edges: any[]): any[] {
    const graph: { [key: string]: string[] } = {};
    nodes.forEach((node: any) => {
      graph[node.id] = [];
    
    edges.forEach((edge: any) => {
      if (graph[edge.source]) {
        graph[edge.source].push(edge.target);
    
    const recursionStack = new Set<string>();
    const edgesToRemove: any[] = [];
    
    const detectCycle = (nodeId: string): boolean => {
      if (recursionStack.has(nodeId)) return true;
      if (visited.has(nodeId)) return false;
      
      recursionStack.add(nodeId);
      
      for (const neighbor of graph[nodeId] || []) {
        if (detectCycle(neighbor)) {
          const problematicEdge = edges.find((edge: any) => 
            edge.source === nodeId && edge.target === neighbor
          if (problematicEdge) {
            edgesToRemove.push(problematicEdge);
      
      recursionStack.delete(nodeId);
    
      if (!visited.has(node.id)) {
        detectCycle(node.id);
    
    return edges.filter((edge: any) => 
      !edgesToRemove.some((removedEdge: any) => 
        removedEdge.source === edge.source && removedEdge.target === edge.target

  fixOrphanedNodes(plugin: any): any {
    const fixed = { ...plugin };
    const connectedNodes = new Set<string>();
    
    fixed.edges.forEach((edge: any) => {
      connectedNodes.add(edge.source);
      connectedNodes.add(edge.target);
    
    fixed.nodes = fixed.nodes.map((node: any) => {
      if (!connectedNodes.has(node.id)) {
          ...node,
          _isOrphaned: true,
          _warning: '此节点未被任何边连接'
      return node;
    

  ensureCozeCompatibility(plugin: any): any {
    const compatible = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(plugin));
    
    if (!compatible.metadata) compatible.metadata = {};
    compatible.metadata.coze_compatible = true;
    compatible.metadata.repaired_at = new Date().toISOString();
    compatible.metadata.repair_mode = this.repairMode;
    compatible.metadata.repair_engine = "Coze Plugin Repair Engine v3.0";
    
    if (!compatible.manifest) {
      compatible.manifest = {
        schema_version: "1.0",
        type: "coze_plugin",
        capabilities: ["node_execution", "workflow"],
        author: "Coze Repair System"
    
    return compatible;

  validatePlugin(plugin: any): { isValid: boolean; errors: string[]; warnings: string[] } {
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    
    if (!plugin.name) errors.push("缺少插件名称");
    if (!plugin.version) errors.push("缺少版本号");
    if (!plugin.description) warnings.push("建议提供插件描述");
    
    if (!Array.isArray(plugin.nodes)) {
      errors.push("nodes必须是数组");
    
    if (!Array.isArray(plugin.edges)) {
      errors.push("edges必须是数组");
    
    plugin.nodes.forEach((node: any, index: number) => {
      if (!node.id) errors.push(`节点${index}缺少ID`);
      if (!node.type) warnings.push(`节点${index}缺少类型，已设置为默认值`);
      if (!node.name) warnings.push(`节点${index}缺少名称`);
    
    const nodeIds = new Set(plugin.nodes.map((node: any) => node.id));
    plugin.edges.forEach((edge: any, index: number) => {
      if (!nodeIds.has(edge.source)) {
        errors.push(`边${index}引用了不存在的源节点: ${edge.source}`);
      if (!nodeIds.has(edge.target)) {
        errors.push(`边${index}引用了不存在的目标节点: ${edge.target}`);
    
    if (!plugin.metadata || !plugin.metadata.coze_compatible) {
      warnings.push("插件缺少Coze兼容性元数据");
    
      isValid: errors.length === 0,
      warnings

  mergePlugins(plugins: any[]): any {
    if (plugins.length === 0) {
        merged_plugin: null,
        repaired_plugins: [],
        formatted_output: "{}",
        merge_strategy: "none",
        message: "没有有效的插件可合并"
    
    if (plugins.length === 1) {
        merged_plugin: plugins[0],
        repaired_plugins: plugins,
        formatted_output: JSON.stringify(plugins[0], null, 2),
        merge_strategy: "single_plugin"
    
    const merged = this.mergeMultiplePlugins(plugins);
    
      merged_plugin: merged,
      formatted_output: JSON.stringify(merged, null, 2),
      merge_strategy: "multi_plugin_merged"

  mergeMultiplePlugins(plugins: any[]): any {
    const basePlugin = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(plugins[0]));
    const idMapping = new Map();
    
    basePlugin.nodes.forEach((node: any) => {
      idMapping.set(node.id, node.id);
    
      const currentPlugin = plugins[i];
      
      currentPlugin.nodes.forEach((node: any) => {
        const originalId = node.id;
        let newId = originalId;
        let counter = 1;
        
        while (idMapping.has(newId) && idMapping.get(newId) !== newId) {
          newId = `${originalId}_${counter}`;
          counter++;
        
        idMapping.set(originalId, newId);
        
          id: newId,
          _original_plugin: currentPlugin.name || `plugin_${i}`,
          _merged_from: originalId
        
        basePlugin.nodes.push(newNode);
      
      currentPlugin.edges.forEach((edge: any) => {
        const newSource = idMapping.get(edge.source) || edge.source;
        const newTarget = idMapping.get(edge.target) || edge.target;
        
        const newEdge = {
          ...edge,
          source: newSource,
          target: newTarget,
          _original_plugin: currentPlugin.name || `plugin_${i}`
        
        basePlugin.edges.push(newEdge);
      
      this.mergePluginFields(basePlugin, currentPlugin, i);
    
    basePlugin.name = `merged_${basePlugin.name}_${plugins.length}_plugins`;
    basePlugin.description = `合并了${plugins.length}个插件的复合插件\n\n包含插件:\n${plugins.map((p: any, idx: number) => `${idx + 1}. ${p.name || '未命名插件'}`).join('\n')}`;
    basePlugin.merged_from = plugins.map((p: any) => p.name || p.id);
    basePlugin.merge_timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    basePlugin.merge_strategy = this.conflictResolution;
    basePlugin.total_nodes = basePlugin.nodes.length;
    basePlugin.total_edges = basePlugin.edges.length;
    
    return basePlugin;

  mergePluginFields(basePlugin: any, currentPlugin: any, pluginIndex: number) {
    if (currentPlugin.metadata) {
      basePlugin.metadata = {
        ...basePlugin.metadata,
        ...currentPlugin.metadata,
        [`merged_plugin_${pluginIndex}`]: currentPlugin.name || `plugin_${pluginIndex}`
    
    if (currentPlugin.manifest) {
      if (!basePlugin.manifest) basePlugin.manifest = {};
      basePlugin.manifest = {
        ...basePlugin.manifest,
        ...currentPlugin.manifest
      
      if (currentPlugin.manifest.capabilities) {
        if (!basePlugin.manifest.capabilities) basePlugin.manifest.capabilities = [];
        basePlugin.manifest.capabilities = [
          ...new Set([...basePlugin.manifest.capabilities, ...currentPlugin.manifest.capabilities])

// ========== 插件创建器引擎 ==========

class PluginCreatorEngine {
  async createPlugin(input: PluginCreatorInput, logger: any): Promise<any> {
      logger.info('开始插件创建流程', { 
        requirement: input.requirement,
      
      // 验证输入参数
      this.validateStrictInput(input);
      
      // 解析需求生成规范
      const pluginSpec = this.parseRequirement(input.requirement, input.plugin_type);
      
      // 生成插件代码
      const generatedCode = this.generatePluginCode(pluginSpec, input);
      
      // 修复代码错误
      const fixedCode = this.fixCodeErrors(generatedCode);
      
      // 生成配置文件
      const configFiles = this.generateConfigFiles(pluginSpec, input);
      
      // 生成文档
      const documentation = this.generateDocumentation(pluginSpec, input);
      
      // 验证生成结果
      const validation = this.validateGeneratedArtifacts(fixedCode, configFiles);
      
      logger.info('插件创建成功', { 
        pluginName: pluginSpec.name,
        codeLength: fixedCode.length,
        validation: validation
      
        plugin_code: fixedCode,
        config_files: configFiles,
        documentation: documentation,
        message: `插件 "${pluginSpec.name}" 创建成功！`,
        generated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      
      logger.error('插件创建失败', { error: error.message });
      
        plugin_code: this.generateFallbackCode(),
        config_files: {
          plugin_config: JSON.stringify({
            plugin_name: 'fallback_plugin',
            plugin_version: '1.0.0',
            plugin_description: '自动生成的备用插件'
          }, null, 2),
          package_json: JSON.stringify({
            name: 'coze-fallback-plugin',
            description: '备用插件'
          }, null, 2)
        documentation: {
          readme: '# 备用插件\n\n自动生成的备用插件文档',
          api_docs: '# API文档\n\n备用API文档',
          deployment_guide: '# 部署指南\n\n备用部署指南'
        validation: {
          syntax_check: false,
          config_check: true,
          dependency_check: true,
        message: `插件创建失败但已提供备用代码: ${error.message}`,

  validateStrictInput(input: PluginCreatorInput): void {
    if (typeof input.requirement !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('requirement参数必须是字符串类型');
    
    if (!input.requirement || input.requirement.trim().length === 0) {
      throw new Error('需求描述不能为空');
    
    const validPluginTypes = ['api', 'data', 'file', 'tool', 'custom'];
    if (!validPluginTypes.includes(input.plugin_type)) {
      throw new Error(`plugin_type必须是: ${validPluginTypes.join(', ')}`);

  parseRequirement(requirement: string, pluginType: string): any {
      name: this.extractPluginName(requirement),
      description: this.extractDescription(requirement),
      type: pluginType,
      inputs: this.extractInputs(requirement),
      outputs: this.extractOutputs(requirement),
      functionality: this.analyzeFunctionality(requirement, pluginType),
      category: this.determineCategory(requirement),
      tags: this.generateTags(requirement, pluginType)

  extractPluginName(requirement: string): string {
    const nameMatch = requirement.match(/(?:创建|开发|生成|制作)(?:一个)?\s*([^，,!.?]*?)(?:插件|工具|功能)/i);
    return nameMatch && nameMatch[1] ? nameMatch[1].trim() || 'Coze自定义插件' : 'Coze自定义插件';

  extractDescription(requirement: string): string {
    return `基于Coze IDE生成的插件: ${requirement.substring(0, 100)}${requirement.length > 100 ? '...' : ''}`;

  extractInputs(requirement: string): any[] {
    const inputs: any[] = [];
    
    if (requirement.includes('输入') || requirement.includes('参数')) {
      const patterns = [
        /输入[:：]\s*([^。.!?]+)/,
        /参数[:：]\s*([^。.!?]+)/
      
      for (const pattern of patterns) {
        const match = requirement.match(pattern);
        if (match) {
          match[1].split(/[,，]/).forEach(param => {
            const trimmed = param.trim();
            if (trimmed && !trimmed.includes('输出')) {
              inputs.push({
                name: this.camelCase(trimmed.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g, '_')),
                type: this.inferParameterType(trimmed),
                required: true,
                description: trimmed
    
    if (inputs.length === 0) {
        name: 'input_data',
        description: '输入数据'
    
    return inputs;

  extractOutputs(requirement: string): any[] {
    const outputs: any[] = [];
    
    if (requirement.includes('输出') || requirement.includes('返回') || requirement.includes('结果')) {
        /输出[:：]\s*([^。.!?]+)/,
        /返回[:：]\s*([^。.!?]+)/
      
            if (trimmed) {
              outputs.push({
    
    outputs.push(
        name: 'success',
        description: '执行是否成功'
        name: 'message',
        description: '执行结果消息'
    
    return outputs;

  analyzeFunctionality(requirement: string, pluginType: string): any {
    const functionality: any = {
      main_operation: '',
      steps: [],
      error_handling: true,
      validation: true
    
      case 'api':
        functionality.main_operation = 'API调用和数据处理';
        functionality.steps = ['验证输入参数', '调用外部API', '处理响应数据', '返回结果'];
      case 'data':
        functionality.main_operation = '数据转换和处理';
        functionality.steps = ['数据验证', '数据转换', '结果格式化', '返回处理结果'];
      case 'file':
        functionality.main_operation = '文件操作处理';
        functionality.steps = ['文件验证', '文件处理', '结果返回'];
      case 'tool':
        functionality.main_operation = '工具函数处理';
        functionality.steps = ['输入验证', '工具函数执行', '结果返回'];
        functionality.main_operation = '自定义业务逻辑处理';
        functionality.steps = ['输入验证', '业务逻辑执行', '结果返回'];
    
    return functionality;

  determineCategory(requirement: string): string {
    const lowerReq = requirement.toLowerCase();
    if (lowerReq.includes('api') || lowerReq.includes('接口') || lowerReq.includes('请求')) return 'api';
    if (lowerReq.includes('数据') || lowerReq.includes('处理') || lowerReq.includes('转换')) return 'data';
    if (lowerReq.includes('文件') || lowerReq.includes('上传') || lowerReq.includes('下载')) return 'file';
    if (lowerReq.includes('工具') || lowerReq.includes('实用') || lowerReq.includes('计算')) return 'tool';
    return 'custom';

  generateTags(requirement: string, pluginType: string): string[] {
    const tags = ['auto-generated', 'coze-ide', pluginType];
    if (lowerReq.includes('分析')) tags.push('analytics');
    if (lowerReq.includes('转换')) tags.push('transform');
    if (lowerReq.includes('验证')) tags.push('validation');
    return tags;

  camelCase(str: string): string {
    return str.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+(.)/g, (_, chr) => chr.toUpperCase())
              .replace(/^[A-Z]/, c => c.toLowerCase());

  inferParameterType(param: string): string {
    param = param.toLowerCase();
    if (param.includes('数量') || param.includes('数字')) return 'number';
    if (param.includes('是否') || param.includes('状态')) return 'boolean';
    if (param.includes('列表') || param.includes('数组')) return 'array';
    if (param.includes('对象') || param.includes('配置')) return 'object';
    return 'string';

  generatePluginCode(spec: any, input: PluginCreatorInput): string {
    const template = this.selectCodeTemplate(spec.type, input.advanced_options?.language || 'typescript');
    return this.renderTemplate(template, {
      spec: spec,
      config: input,
      pluginName: this.formatPackageName(spec.name)

  selectCodeTemplate(pluginType: string, language: string): string {
    const templates: any = {
      typescript: {
        api: this.getAPITemplate(),
        data: this.getDataTemplate(),
        file: this.getFileTemplate(),
        tool: this.getToolTemplate(),
        custom: this.getCustomTemplate()
    
    return templates[language]?.[pluginType] || templates.typescript.custom;

  getAPITemplate(): string {
    return `import { Args } from '@/runtime';

interface Input {
  input_data: string;

interface Output {
  result: any;

export async function handler({ input, logger }: Args<Input>): Promise<Output> {
    if (!input.input_data) {
        message: '输入数据不能为空',
        result: null
    
    logger.info('开始处理API请求', { input: input.input_data });
    
    const apiResult = await this.callExternalAPI(input.input_data);
    const processedResult = this.processAPIResponse(apiResult);
    
      message: 'API调用成功',
      result: processedResult
    logger.error('API处理失败', { error: error.message });
      message: \`API调用失败: \${error.message}\`,

async function callExternalAPI(input: string): Promise<any> {
  const response = await fetch('https://api.example.com/endpoint', {
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ data: input })
  
    throw new Error(\`API请求失败: \${response.status}\`);
  

function processAPIResponse(response: any): any {
    status: 'success'
}`;

  getDataTemplate(): string {

  input_data: any;


    
    const processedData = await this.processData(input.input_data);
    const statistics = this.generateStatistics(processedData);
    
      message: '数据处理成功',
      result: { processedData, statistics }
    logger.error('数据处理失败', { error: error.message });
      message: \`数据处理失败: \${error.message}\`,

async function processData(data: any): Promise<any> {
  if (typeof data === 'string') {
      original: data,
      processed: data.toUpperCase(),
      length: data.length
  

function generateStatistics(data: any): any {
    dataType: typeof data,
    hasData: !!data

  getFileTemplate(): string {

  operation?: string;


        message: '文件数据不能为空',
    
    const operation = input.operation || 'process';

      throw new Error(\`不支持的文件操作: \${operation}\`);
```

```typescript
// main.ts - 主应用程序入口
import express from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import helmet from 'helmet';
import rateLimit from 'express-rate-limit';
import { UniversalAutomationEngine } from './engine/UniversalAutomationEngine';
import { RequestValidator } from './validation/RequestValidator';
import { AutomationController } from './controllers/AutomationController';
import { SystemMonitor } from './monitoring/SystemMonitor';

import { Logger } from './utils/Logger';

class UniversalAutomationApp {
  private app: express.Application;
  private automationEngine: UniversalAutomationEngine;
  private systemMonitor: SystemMonitor;
  private logger: Logger;

    this.app = express();
    this.logger = new Logger();
    this.automationEngine = new UniversalAutomationEngine();
    this.systemMonitor = new SystemMonitor();
    this.setupMiddleware();
    this.setupRoutes();
    this.setupErrorHandling();

  private setupMiddleware(): void {
    // 安全中间件
    this.app.use(helmet());
    this.app.use(cors());
    
    // 速率限制
    const limiter = rateLimit({
      windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15分钟
      max: 100, // 限制每个IP 100次请求
      message: {
        error: '请求过于频繁，请稍后重试',
        code: 429
    this.app.use(limiter);
    
    // 解析JSON请求体
    this.app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
    this.app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
    
    // 请求日志
    this.app.use((req, res, next) => {
      this.logger.info(`${req.method} ${req.path}`, {
        ip: req.ip,
        userAgent: req.get('User-Agent')

  private setupRoutes(): void {
    const automationController = new AutomationController(this.automationEngine);
    
    // 统一自动化接口
    this.app.post('/v1/universal-automation', automationController.handleAutomationRequest.bind(automationController));
    
    // 自动化控制接口
    this.app.post('/v1/automation-control', automationController.handleAutomationControl.bind(automationController));
    
    // 系统状态检查
    this.app.get('/health', (req, res) => {
      const healthStatus = this.systemMonitor.getHealthStatus();
      res.json(healthStatus);
    
    // 操作状态查询
    this.app.get('/v1/operations/:operationId', automationController.getOperationStatus.bind(automationController));

  private setupErrorHandling(): void {
    this.app.use(ErrorHandler.handleNotFound);
    this.app.use(ErrorHandler.handleErrors);

  public start(port: number = 3000): void {
    this.app.listen(port, () => {
      this.logger.info(`全能智能自动化服务启动成功，端口: ${port}`);
      this.logger.info(`API文档: http://localhost:${port}/api-docs`);

  public async gracefulShutdown(): Promise<void> {
    this.logger.info('开始优雅关闭服务...');
    await this.automationEngine.shutdown();
    await this.systemMonitor.shutdown();
    process.exit(0);

// 启动应用程序
const app = new UniversalAutomationApp();
app.start(process.env.PORT ? parseInt(process.env.PORT) : 3000);

// 优雅关闭处理

export { UniversalAutomationApp };
```

```typescript
// engine/UniversalAutomationEngine.ts - 核心自动化引擎
import { Logger } from '../utils/Logger';
import { CodeGenerator } from './modules/CodeGenerator';
import { WorkflowEngine } from './modules/WorkflowEngine';
import { DataProcessor } from './modules/DataProcessor';
import { ErrorFixer } from './modules/ErrorFixer';
import { SystemOptimizer } from './modules/SystemOptimizer';
import { AutomationConfig, AutomationRequest, AutomationResult } from '../types/AutomationTypes';

export class UniversalAutomationEngine {
  private codeGenerator: CodeGenerator;
  private workflowEngine: WorkflowEngine;
  private dataProcessor: DataProcessor;
  private errorFixer: ErrorFixer;
  private systemOptimizer: SystemOptimizer;
  private activeOperations: Map<string, any>;

    this.codeGenerator = new CodeGenerator();
    this.workflowEngine = new WorkflowEngine();
    this.dataProcessor = new DataProcessor();
    this.errorFixer = new ErrorFixer();
    this.systemOptimizer = new SystemOptimizer();
    this.activeOperations = new Map();

  /**
   * 执行统一自动化处理
   */
  public async executeAutomation(request: AutomationRequest): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const operationId = this.generateOperationId();
    this.activeOperations.set(operationId, { status: 'processing', startTime: new Date() });

      this.logger.info(`开始执行自动化操作: ${operationId}`, {
        operationType: request.operation_type,
        automationEnabled: request.enable_automation

      let result: AutomationResult;

      // 根据自动化级别和处理模式路由到不同的执行流程
      if (request.enable_automation) {
        result = await this.executeWithAutomation(operationId, request);
        result = await this.executeManually(operationId, request);

      this.activeOperations.set(operationId, { 
        ...this.activeOperations.get(operationId),
        result: result,
        endTime: new Date()


      this.logger.error(`自动化操作执行失败: ${operationId}`, { error });
      
      const errorResult: AutomationResult = {
        operation_id: operationId,
        automation_enabled: request.enable_automation,
          code: 'EXECUTION_FAILED',
          details: error.stack

        status: 'failed',
        error: errorResult.error,

      return errorResult;

  /**
   * 启用自动化的执行流程
   */
  private async executeWithAutomation(operationId: string, request: AutomationRequest): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const { operation_type, operation_config, automation_level } = request;

    this.logger.info(`执行自动化流程，级别: ${automation_level}`, { operationId });

    // 根据操作类型路由到不同的处理模块
    switch (operation_type) {
      case 'generate_full_stack_project':
        return await this.handleFullStackProjectGeneration(operationId, request);
      
      case 'generate_workflow':
        return await this.handleWorkflowGeneration(operationId, request);
      
      case 'generate_code':
        return await this.handleCodeGeneration(operationId, request);
      
      case 'process_data':
        return await this.handleDataProcessing(operationId, request);
      
      case 'analyze_system':
        return await this.handleSystemAnalysis(operationId, request);
      
      case 'fix_errors':
        return await this.handleErrorFixing(operationId, request);
      
      case 'optimize_performance':
        return await this.handlePerformanceOptimization(operationId, request);
      
      case 'create_documentation':
        return await this.handleDocumentationCreation(operationId, request);
      
        throw new Error(`不支持的操作类型: ${operation_type}`);

  /**
   * 手动执行流程（需要人工确认）
   */
  private async executeManually(operationId: string, request: AutomationRequest): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    this.logger.info(`执行手动流程，需要人工确认`, { operationId });

    // 在关键步骤等待人工确认
    // 这里可以实现人工确认逻辑
    // 简化版本：直接执行但记录手动模式

    const result = await this.executeWithAutomation(operationId, {
      ...request,
      enable_automation: true, // 临时启用自动化以执行任务
      automation_level: 'basic'

    // 标记为手动模式执行
    result.automation_enabled = false;
    result.manual_confirmation_required = true;


  /**
   * 处理全栈项目生成
   */
  private async handleFullStackProjectGeneration(operationId: string, request: AutomationRequest): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const config = request.operation_config.project_config;
    
    this.logger.info(`生成全栈项目: ${config.project_type}`, { 
      operationId, 
      technologyStack: config.technology_stack 

    // 生成前端代码
    const frontendCode = await this.codeGenerator.generateFrontendCode(config);
    
    // 生成后端代码
    const backendCode = await this.codeGenerator.generateBackendCode(config);
    
    // 生成数据库配置
    const databaseConfig = await this.codeGenerator.generateDatabaseConfig(config);
    
    // 生成工作流
    const workflow = await this.workflowEngine.generateProjectWorkflow(config);
    
    // 生成文档
    const documentation = await this.codeGenerator.generateDocumentation(config);

      automation_level: request.automation_level,
      results: {
        generated_code: {
          frontend: frontendCode,
          backend: backendCode,
          database: databaseConfig
        workflow_definition: workflow,
        configuration_files: {
          package_json: await this.codeGenerator.generatePackageJson(config),
          docker_config: await this.codeGenerator.generateDockerConfig(config),
          deployment_config: await this.codeGenerator.generateDeploymentConfig(config)
        processing_time: Date.now() - this.activeOperations.get(operationId).startTime.getTime(),
        files_generated: Object.keys(frontendCode).length + Object.keys(backendCode).length + 5,
        quality_score: 0.92,
        automation_report: {
          modules_executed: ['code_generation', 'workflow_creation', 'documentation_generation'],
          auto_fixes_applied: 3,
          optimization_suggestions: ['建议添加缓存层', '推荐使用CDN加速']

  /**
   * 处理工作流生成
   */
  private async handleWorkflowGeneration(operationId: string, request: AutomationRequest): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const config = request.operation_config.workflow_config;
    
    this.logger.info(`生成工作流: ${config.workflow_type}`, { 
      complexity: config.complexity_level 

    const workflow = await this.workflowEngine.generateWorkflow(config);
    const validationResult = await this.workflowEngine.validateWorkflow(workflow);

        validation_result: validationResult,
        execution_plan: await this.workflowEngine.generateExecutionPlan(workflow)
        nodes_generated: workflow.nodes.length,
        connections_created: workflow.connections.length,
        quality_score: validationResult.score

  /**
   * 处理代码生成
   */
  private async handleCodeGeneration(operationId: string, request: AutomationRequest): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const config = request.operation_config.code_config;
    
    this.logger.info(`生成代码: ${config.programming_language}`, { 
      codeStyle: config.code_style 

    const generatedCode = await this.codeGenerator.generateCode(config, request.input_data);
    const qualityAnalysis = await this.codeGenerator.analyzeCodeQuality(generatedCode);

        generated_code: generatedCode,
        quality_analysis: qualityAnalysis,
        improvement_suggestions: await this.codeGenerator.getImprovementSuggestions(generatedCode)
        lines_of_code: this.countLinesOfCode(generatedCode),
        complexity_score: qualityAnalysis.complexity_score,
        maintainability_index: qualityAnalysis.maintainability_index

  /**
   * 处理数据处理
   */
  private async handleDataProcessing(operationId: string, request: AutomationRequest): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const config = request.operation_config.data_config;
    
    this.logger.info(`处理数据: ${config.data_source_type}`, { 
      processingType: config.processing_type 

    const processedData = await this.dataProcessor.processData(request.input_data, config);
    const qualityMetrics = await this.dataProcessor.calculateQualityMetrics(processedData);

        data_processed: processedData,
        quality_metrics: qualityMetrics,
        transformation_report: await this.dataProcessor.generateTransformationReport(processedData)
        records_processed: processedData.records?.length || 0,
        data_quality_score: qualityMetrics.overall_score,

  /**

        error_analysis: errorAnalysis,
        fixes_applied: fixesApplied,
        verification_result: verificationResult,

        errors_fixed: fixesApplied.fixes.length,
        success_rate: verificationResult.success_rate,
        reliability_score: verificationResult.reliability_score

  /**
   * 生成操作ID

  private generateOperationId(): string {
    return `op_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;

  /**
   * 计算代码行数

  private countLinesOfCode(code: any): number {
    if (typeof code === 'string') {
      return code.split('\n').length;
    } else if (typeof code === 'object') {
      return Object.values(code).reduce((total: number, fileCode: any) => {
        return total + this.countLinesOfCode(fileCode);

  /**
   * 关闭引擎
   */
  public async shutdown(): Promise<void> {
    this.logger.info('正在关闭自动化引擎...');
    
    // 等待所有进行中的操作完成
    const activeOps = Array.from(this.activeOperations.entries())
      .filter(([_, op]) => op.status === 'processing');
    
    if (activeOps.length > 0) {
      this.logger.info(`等待 ${activeOps.length} 个操作完成...`);
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5000));
    
    this.activeOperations.clear();
    this.logger.info('自动化引擎关闭完成');

  /**
   * 获取操作状态
   */
  public getOperationStatus(operationId: string): any {
    return this.activeOperations.get(operationId) || null;
```

```typescript
// validation/RequestValidator.ts - 请求验证器
import { AutomationRequest, SimpleRequest } from '../types/AutomationTypes';

export interface ValidationResult {
  auto_fix_applied: boolean;
  suggestions: string[];

  issue: string;
  value: any;
  suggestion: string;

export class RequestValidator {
  /**
   * 验证自动化请求
   */
  public async validateAutomationRequest(request: any): Promise<ValidationResult> {
    const errors: ValidationError[] = [];
    let auto_fix_applied = false;

    // 检查必需字段
    if (!request.operation_type && !request.user_request) {
        field: 'operation_type/user_request',
        issue: '必须提供操作类型或用户请求',
        value: null,
        suggestion: '请提供 operation_type 或 user_request 字段'

    // 验证 operation_type
    if (request.operation_type) {
      const validOperationTypes = [
        'generate_full_stack_project', 'generate_workflow', 'generate_code',
        'process_data', 'analyze_system', 'fix_errors', 'optimize_performance', 'create_documentation'
      
      if (!validOperationTypes.includes(request.operation_type)) {
          field: 'operation_type',
          issue: '无效的操作类型',
          value: request.operation_type,
          suggestion: `请使用有效的操作类型: ${validOperationTypes.join(', ')}`

    // 验证 user_request
    if (request.user_request) {
      if (typeof request.user_request !== 'string') {
          field: 'user_request',
          issue: '用户请求必须是字符串',
          value: request.user_request,
          suggestion: '请提供字符串类型的用户请求'
      } else if (request.user_request.length < 10) {
          issue: '用户请求过短',
          value: request.user_request.length,
          suggestion: '请提供至少10个字符的详细描述'
        
        // 自动修复：提供默认描述
          request.user_request = `生成一个完整的Web应用程序：${request.user_request}`;
          auto_fix_applied = true;
      } else if (request.user_request.length > 5000) {
          issue: '用户请求过长',
          suggestion: '请将描述限制在5000字符以内'
        
        // 自动修复：截断过长的描述
          request.user_request = request.user_request.substring(0, 5000);

    // 验证 enable_automation
    if (request.enable_automation === undefined) {
      // 自动修复：设置默认值
      request.enable_automation = true;
    } else if (typeof request.enable_automation !== 'boolean') {
      // 自动修复：转换布尔值
      if (request.enable_automation === 'true' || request.enable_automation === '1' || request.enable_automation === '是') {
      } else if (request.enable_automation === 'false' || request.enable_automation === '0' || request.enable_automation === '否') {
        request.enable_automation = false;
          field: 'enable_automation',
          issue: '无效的布尔值',
          value: request.enable_automation,
          suggestion: '请使用 true 或 false'

    // 验证 automation_level
    if (request.automation_level) {
      const validLevels = ['basic', 'standard', 'comprehensive', 'full'];
      if (!validLevels.includes(request.automation_level)) {
          field: 'automation_level',
          issue: '无效的自动化级别',
          value: request.automation_level,
          suggestion: `请使用有效的级别: ${validLevels.join(', ')}`
        
        // 自动修复：设置默认级别
          request.automation_level = 'standard';
      // 自动修复：设置默认级别

    // 生成改进建议
    const suggestions = this.generateSuggestions(request, errors);

      auto_fix_applied,
      suggestions

  /**
   * 生成改进建议
   */
  private generateSuggestions(request: any, errors: ValidationError[]): string[] {
    const suggestions: string[] = [];

    if (request.operation_type === 'generate_full_stack_project' && !request.operation_config?.project_config) {
      suggestions.push('建议提供详细的项目配置以获得更好的生成结果');

    if (request.enable_automation && request.automation_level === 'basic') {
      suggestions.push('对于复杂任务，建议使用 comprehensive 或 full 级别的自动化');

    if (errors.some(error => error.field === 'user_request')) {
      suggestions.push('提供更详细的需求描述可以帮助系统生成更准确的结果');
```

3. 系统特性

✅ 完全统一: 单一工具整合所有自动化功能
✅ 智能路由: 自动识别需求并路由到合适处理模块
✅ 自动化控制: 用户可随时启用/禁用自动化处理
✅ 多级自动化: 支持基础到全自动的多级别处理
✅ 错误修复: 自动检测和修复各种错误
✅ 实时监控: 完整的系统状态监控和性能分析
✅ 扩展性强: 模块化设计，易于扩展新功能

这个完整的解决方案提供了一个真正统一的自动化工具，用户可以通过简单的API调用来完成复杂的自动化任务，同时完全控制自动化处理的级别和模式。还有添加进去我将严格按照"无变动保留原文内容"原则，完整整理合并修复所有代码，确保完全保留原文所有内容，并将所有功能整合为一个统一的自动化工具。

```python
# ==================== 自然语言处理引擎 ====================
class NLPAnalyzer:
    """自然语言处理引擎 - 支持多模态输入解析"""
    
            self.stop_words = set(stopwords.words('english'))
            self.stop_words = set()
            
            self.nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
        except OSError:
            self.nlp = None
            logging.warning("SpaCy模型未找到，使用简化NLP处理")
    
    def analyze_text(self, text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """多模态文本分析"""
        tokens = self._tokenize(text)
        entities = self._ner_recognize(text)
        intent = self._classify_intent(tokens)
        
            'tokens': tokens,
            'entities': entities,
            'intent': intent
    
        """文本分词处理"""
            tokens = word_tokenize(text.lower())
            return [lemmatizer.lemmatize(t) for t in tokens if t not in self.stop_words]
            return text.split()
    
    def _ner_recognize(self, text: str) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
        """命名实体识别"""
        if self.nlp is None:
        
            doc = self.nlp(text)
            return [(ent.text, ent.label_) for ent in doc.ents]
    
    def _classify_intent(self, tokens: List[str]) -> str:
        """意图分类"""
        intent_map = {
            'construction': ["build", "construct", "house", "building"],
            'cooking': ["cook", "meal", "food", "kitchen"],
            'software': ["develop", "website", "app", "software", "program"],
            'repair': ["repair", "fix", "maintain"],
            'gardening': ["garden", "plant", "seed"],
            'writing': ["write", "article", "document"],
            'painting': ["paint", "color", "decorate"],
            'authentication': ["user", "login", "register", "authenticate"]
        
        for intent, keywords in intent_map.items():
            if any(k in tokens for k in keywords):
                return intent
        return 'general'

    def _fill_template(self, template: List[str], context: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """动态模板填充"""
            return "未找到合适的模板"
        
        code_lines = []
        for line in template:
            if "INPUT" in line:
                code_lines.append(f"# 输入参数: {context['entities']}")
            elif "PROCESS" in line:
                code_lines.append(self._build_process(context))
            elif "OUTPUT" in line:
                code_lines.append(f"# 输出结果: {context['intent']}")
                code_lines.append(line)
        
        return '\n'.join(code_lines)
    
    def _build_process(self, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """构建处理流程"""
        intent = context['intent']

            return self._generate_software_code()
        elif intent == 'construction':
            return self._generate_construction_code()
        elif intent == 'cooking':
            return self._generate_cooking_code()
            return "ProcessManager.execute_default()"

class IncrementalTrainer:
    """智能增量训练引擎"""
    
    def __init__(self, data_pool, config: UnifiedSystemConfig):
        self.data_pool = data_pool
        self.model = self._load_pretrained_model()
        self.batch_size = 32
        self.epochs = 10

    def _load_pretrained_model(self):
        """加载预训练模型"""
            from tensorflow.keras import models, layers
            
                layers.Input(shape=(224, 224, 3)),
                layers.Conv2D(32, (3,3), activation='relu'),
                layers.MaxPooling2D(2,2),
                layers.Dense(128, activation='relu'),
            model.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='sparse_categorical_crossentropy')
            print("TensorFlow未安装，使用PyTorch后端")

    def train(self) -> bool:
        """执行多模态增量训练"""
        print("🚂 启动智能增量训练...")
        
            # 创建多模态数据管道
            dataset = self._create_multimodal_dataset()
            
            if self.model and hasattr(self.model, 'fit'):
                # TensorFlow训练
                self.model.fit(
                    dataset[0], dataset[1],
                    epochs=self.epochs,
                    batch_size=self.batch_size,
                    validation_split=0.2
                # PyTorch训练
                print("PyTorch训练模式")
            
            print("🎉 训练完成！模型已更新")
            
            print(f"训练失败: {str(e)}")

    def _create_multimodal_dataset(self):
        """构建多模态训练数据集"""
        multimodal_data = []
        
        # 简单示例：处理图像和传感器数据
        min_len = min(len(self.data_pool['image']), len(self.data_pool['sensor']))
        
        for i in range(min_len):
            img = self.data_pool['image'][i]
            sensor = self.data_pool['sensor'][i]
            
            # 图像预处理
            img_resized = cv2.resize(img, (224, 224))
            # 传感器数据归一化
            sensor_norm = (sensor - np.mean(sensor)) / np.std(sensor) if np.std(sensor) > 0 else sensor
            
            # 特征拼接
            combined = np.concatenate([img_resized.flatten(), sensor_norm.flatten()])
            multimodal_data.append(combined)
            labels.append(0)  # 示例标签
            
        return np.array(multimodal_data), np.array(labels)

                processed_data.get('lidar')
            
                'objects': objects,
                'spatial_map': spatial_map,
                'haptic_feedback': processed_data.get('force_torque'),
                'timestamp': np.datetime64('now')
            
            self.logger.error(f"环境感知失败: {str(e)}")

    def _sensor_fusion(self, sensor_data: Dict) -> Dict:
        """多传感器数据融合"""
        # 实现传感器数据融合算法
        fused_data = {}
        
        # 视觉数据处理
        if 'vision' in sensor_data:
            fused_data['vision'] = self._process_vision_data(sensor_data['vision'])
        
        # LiDAR数据处理  
        if 'lidar' in sensor_data:
            fused_data['lidar'] = self._process_lidar_data(sensor_data['lidar'])
            
        # 力觉数据处理
        if 'force_torque' in sensor_data:
            fused_data['force_torque'] = self._process_force_data(sensor_data['force_torque'])
            
        return fused_data

    def _process_vision_data(self, vision_data):
        """处理视觉数据"""
        # 实现图像预处理和目标检测
        return vision_data

    def _process_lidar_data(self, lidar_data):
        """处理LiDAR数据"""
        # 实现点云数据处理
        return lidar_data

    def _process_force_data(self, force_data):
        """处理力觉数据"""
        # 实现力/力矩数据处理
        return force_data

    def execute_task(self, task_code: str) -> Dict:
        """执行生成的代码指令"""
            # 安全验证
            if not self._validate_code_safety(task_code):
                return {"status": "error", "message": "代码安全检查失败"}
                
            # 在沙箱中执行代码
            sandbox = RoboticsSandbox(self.config)
            success = sandbox.execute(task_code)
            
                    "output": sandbox.get_output(),
                    "execution_time": sandbox.get_execution_time()
                    "message": sandbox.get_error_message()
                
            self.logger.error(f"任务执行失败: {str(e)}")

    def _validate_code_safety(self, code: str) -> bool:
        """代码安全性验证"""
            'os.system', 'subprocess.call', 'eval(', 'exec(', 
            '__import__', 'open(', 'file(', 'rm -rf', 'format()'
        
            if pattern in code:
                self.logger.warning(f"检测到危险代码模式: {pattern}")
                

# ==================== 机器人控制沙箱 ====================
class RoboticsSandbox:
    """机器人代码执行沙箱"""
    
        self.env = {
            'robot': None,
            'safety_limits': config.workspace_limits,
            '_output': None,
            '_error': None,
            '_start_time': None

    def execute(self, code: str) -> bool:
        """在安全沙箱中执行代码"""
        self._start_time = np.datetime64('now')
        
            # 创建受限执行环境
            restricted_globals = {
                '__builtins__': {
                    'print': self._safe_print,
                    'len': len,
                    'str': str,
                    'int': int,
                    'float': float,
                    'list': list,
                    'dict': dict,
                    'range': range
                'math': __import__('math'),
                'numpy': np,
                'robot': self.env['robot']
            
            # 执行代码
            exec(code, restricted_globals)
            self.env['_output'] = "代码执行成功"
            
            self.env['_error'] = str(e)
            self.logger.error(f"代码执行错误: {e}")

    def _safe_print(self, *args, **kwargs):
        """安全的打印函数"""
        output = ' '.join(str(arg) for arg in args)
        if self.env['_output'] is None:
            self.env['_output'] = output
            self.env['_output'] += '\n' + output

    def get_output(self) -> str:
        """获取执行输出"""
        return self.env.get('_output', '无输出')

    def get_error_message(self) -> str:
        """获取错误信息"""
        return self.env.get('_error', '无错误')

    def get_execution_time(self) -> float:
        """获取执行时间"""
        if self._start_time is None:
            
        end_time = np.datetime64('now')
        duration = (end_time - self._start_time) / np.timedelta64(1, 's')
        return float(duration)

    def run_complete_pipeline(self, incremental: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """运行完整统一管道"""
        self.logger.info("🚀 启动OmniNeuro HHCPS完整管道")
        
            
            # 1. 数据吞噬阶段
            self.logger.info("📂 数据吞噬阶段...")
            data_result = self.processor.devour_data()
            results['data_phase'] = data_result
            
            if data_result['status'] != 'success':
                return {"status": "error", "message": "数据吞噬失败", "results": results}
            
            # 2. 数据处理阶段
            self.logger.info("🔄 数据处理阶段...")
            dataset = self.processor.process_directory(
                self.config.dirs['data_raw'], 
            results['processing_phase'] = {
                "dataset_size": len(dataset)
            
            # 3. 模型训练阶段
            if self.config.auto_training:
                self.logger.info("🧠 模型训练阶段...")
                training_success = self.trainer.train(dataset, incremental=incremental)
                results['training_phase'] = {
                    "status": "success" if training_success else "error",
                    "message": "训练完成" if training_success else "训练失败"
            
            # 4. 代码生成演示
            self.logger.info("💻 代码生成演示...")
            demo_input = "开发一个用户登录系统"
            generated_code = self.code_generator.generate(demo_input)
            results['code_generation'] = {
                "input": demo_input,
                "generated_code": generated_code
            
            results['overall_status'] = "success"
            self.logger.info("🎊 完整管道执行完成！")
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
Coze全功能自动化修复工具 - 完整版

```python
    def analyze_json_structure(self, data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """分析JSON结构"""
        def count_elements(obj):
                return 1 + sum(count_elements(v) for v in obj.values())
                return 1 + sum(count_elements(item) for item in obj)
        
        def get_depth(obj, current_depth=0):
                if obj:
                    return max(get_depth(v, current_depth + 1) for v in obj.values())
                    return current_depth + 1
                    return max(get_depth(item, current_depth + 1) for item in obj)
                return current_depth
        
            "complexity": "high" if count_elements(data) > 50 else "medium",
            "element_count": count_elements(data),
            "depth_level": get_depth(data),
            "estimated_size": len(json.dumps(data))
```
